item.title: Xavi pleased with first week as Netherlands coach, but wants more
item.description: Netherlands coach Xavi Hernández is pleased with his first week in charge but now wants his side to show an even more attacking game in their next two Nations League fixtures.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Netherlands coach Xavi Hernández is pleased with his first week in charge but now wants his side to show an even more attacking game in their next two Nations League fixtures. The Spanish World Cup winner wants the Dutch side playing with more of the attacking intensity that paid off last Thursday when their persistent forays forced a late equaliser against Germany in Amsterdam. This was followed by their first victory under Xavi, a 2-1 defeat of Serbia on Sunday. “It is always most important to get the three points, I’m happy that we managed to do that. But we do need to play better, because, especially in the first half, we did not press well," he said. “Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied after a week of work.” Xavi singled out AZ Alkmaar striker Mexx Meerdink, who made his a debut as a substitute against Germany and then marked his first start for the Dutch by scoring both goals against Serbia. “Mexx is a very hard worker who understands how we want to play," Xavi said. “He helped the team with more than just his goals, although those certainly helped. The work he did for the team was fantastic.” The Dutch side face Greece next, in Thessaloniki on Thursday, then entertain Serbia in Eindhoven on Sunday. Xavi was clear about where improvements on last week were needed. “For example, there were many moments when we needed to attack the spaces, but we didn’t do it. That is something we need to improve. But also things such as making the pitch wider and moving the ball around more quickly," he said. “But the most important thing is that we are creating a lot of chances. The players feel comfortable on the pitch with the structure we are playing in, so a lot of things are also going well."

item.title: 食品警告表示、インド政府は迅速対応を 最高裁が要求
item.description:
Aditya Kalra
[ニューデリー ２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Aditya Kalra

[ニューデリー ２８日 ロイター] - インド最高裁は２８日、包装食品への警告表示の導入に先立ち、改めて一般市民や業界から意見を募ろうとする政府の方針に疑問を呈した。「なぜそれほど時間を無駄にしたいのか」と指摘し、食品表示を巡る速やかな対応を迫った。

活動家らはインド政府が長年にわたり検討や意見公募を重ねながら、包装前面の表示により厳しい規則を導入していないことに懸念を示し、訴えを起こした。

規制当局は先週、警告表示の厳格化に向けた告示と意見公募に４カ月、その後の施行までにさらに１年が必要だと説明した。

パルディワラ最高裁判事は審理で「われわれが健康問題を懸念しているのに、なぜそれほど時間を無駄にしたいのか」と問いかけた。「当局がわれわれの命令を受け入れることを期待している。失望させないでほしい」と述べた。最高裁はこの問題について、近く最終的な命令を出すとした。

政府は塩分、糖分、脂肪分の多い食品について、包装に赤い六角形の警告表示を義務付ける措置を打ち出した。

国内外の食品大手数十社を代表する全インド食品加工業協会は、審理に先立ち、警告に使う色や記号は「インドの事情を踏まえ、慎重に検討する必要がある」と述べた。

ロイターが確認した最高裁への新たな提出書面で、「インドの一般的な消費者は赤色を見ると、表示が義務付けられている非菜食食品の識別マークを連想しがちだ」と指摘した。「目立つ赤い警告記号をもう一つ導入すれば、消費者が混乱する恐れがある」と規制当局に警告していたと説明した。

同協会は包装前面の警告表示そのものには反対しなかった。ただ提案された基準値を「一律に適用すること」に異議を唱え、基準値を科学的な方法で決めるよう求めた。

item.title: 財務省、中長期国債の追加供給減提示＝10―12月期は毎月5000億円
item.description: ［東京 ２８日 ロイター］ - 財務省は２８日の国債市場特別参加者（プライマリーディーラー、ＰＤ）会合で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
財務省、中長期国債の追加供給減提示＝10―12月期は毎月5000億円 17:13 配信

2022年11月21日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

［東京　２８日　ロイター］ - 財務省は２８日の国債市場特別参加者（プライマリーディーラー、ＰＤ）会合で、５年超１１年以下を対象とする流動性供給入札の減額案を提示した。１０―１２月期は毎月５０００億円とし、前四半期から月１５００億円の減額とする。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：ジャクソンホール、切望されるウォーシュＦＲＢ議長の明確な政策説明 アングル：米国債、投資家はより高いリターンを要求 コラム：米長期金利上昇、相反するトランプ氏とベセント氏の思惑 コラム：協調介入が示す二つのリスク、米国債投げ売りと日本国債発の世界的混乱 焦点：米長期金利が金融危機以来の水準目前、「語らぬ」ＦＲＢ議長で高まる不確実性 最終更新: 9/28(月) 17:13 ロイター

item.title: Las bolsas europeas suben gracias al repunte de las constructoras británicas
item.description: Las bolsas europeas subían ligeramente el lunes, impulsadas por el repunte de las constructoras británicas, aunque las ganancias se vieron limitadas por la subida de los precios del petróleo y los elevados rendimientos de los bonos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas europeas subían ligeramente el lunes, impulsadas por el repunte de las constructoras británicas, aunque las ganancias se vieron limitadas por la subida de los precios del petróleo y los elevados rendimientos de los bonos. El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) subía un 0,3%, hasta los 640,43 puntos, a las 0725 GMT. La mayoría de las principales bolsas regionales también cotizaban al alza. Las acciones de las constructoras británicas se disparaban después de que el Gobierno anunciara que confirmaría un nuevo programa de préstamos participativos para compradores de primera vivienda en los presupuestos del próximo mes, reactivando así una política destinada a impulsar la adquisición de vivienda en propiedad y apoyar la construcción de viviendas. Las acciones de Persimmon (PSN.L) , Barratt Redrow (BTRW.L) , Taylor Wimpey (TW.L) y Vistry (VTYV.L) subían entre un 13% y un 17%. Sin embargo, las ganancias generales del mercado se vieron frenadas por un repunte de más del 3% en los precios del crudo Brent , después de que el presidente de EEUU, Donald Trump, rechazara una propuesta iraní para reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz y poner fin al conflicto, lo que mantuvo el foco de atención en las tensiones de Oriente Medio. Las acciones del sector energético europeo (.SXEP) avanzaban un 0,5%, aunque las mineras (.SXPP) se desplomaban un 2% ante el descenso de los metales cotizados en dólares a raíz del fortalecimiento de la divisa estadounidense. La atención de los inversionistas se centrará también en los discursos de la presidenta del Banco Central Europeo, Christine Lagarde, y del vicegobernador del Banco de Inglaterra, Dave Ramsden, que tendrán lugar a lo largo del día, especialmente ahora que los mercados descuentan nuevas medidas de endurecimiento por parte de los principales bancos centrales para frenar las presiones inflacionistas. Entre los valores individuales, Akzo Nobel (AKZO.AS) avanzaba aproximadamente un 1% después de que JPMorgan reanudara su cobertura con una calificación de "sobreponderar".

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-インタビュー：為替円安、過小評価は問題とする日米認識「非常にクリア」＝三村財務官
item.description:
Makiko Yamazaki Leika Kihara Takaya Yamaguchi
［東京 ２８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Makiko Yamazaki　Leika Kihara　Takaya Yamaguchi

［東京　２８日　ロイター］ - 財務省の三村淳財務官は２８日、円の過小評価は問題とする意向を日米両政府が共有したメッセージは「非常にクリア」との認識を示した。都内でロイターとのインタビューに応じた。三村財務官は「市場が素直に受け止めてくれればいい」との考えも述べた。

インタビューに先立つ日本時間２５日夜、片山さつき財務相はベセント米財務長官と改めて電話会談し、両財務相の間で「円の過小評価は問題」との認識を再確認していた。

為替政策を巡り、三村財務官は「首脳だけで議論していくことにはならない。今後とも、為替の話は財務大臣、私のレベルでやっていくことに変わりない」と言及。先の日米首脳会談や財務相会談などでの議論を踏まえ「しっかり対応していく」と述べた。

７月末の日米協調介入後に自身が発言した「日米通貨同盟の完成形」という主旨について、三村氏は「大事なのは日米間、日米財務省間というのは、為替も極めて重要だが、為替だけでつながっているわけではない」と説明した。

その上で「（日米間では）経済安全保障面も含めたやり取りをして互いにカバーし合う存在。財務以外も含めた関係のなかでこそ成り立っている」と指摘。「為替だけなら同盟にはならないが、為替以外も含めて日米間はいい関係ができている」と語った。

日本政府は７月末の協調介入などに先立つ４月３０日と５月４、６両日にも為替介入を行った。年間介入額は２７兆１３４２億円となり、過去最大だった２００３年の年間介入額（２０兆４２５０億円）をすでに上回っている。

さらなる介入対応について、三村財務官は「今後の動きについて申し上げることはない」と述べるにとどめた。

金利上昇を伴う為替円安にどう対処するかは、年初からの課題になっている。市場では、米長期金利が５％を突破したことへの警戒感も強い。

これに対し、三村財務官は「国債市場と為替市場、株も含めて影響し合うことがある。３つの市場は互いが連動しながら日本、米国、欧州が連動しながら動いている」と指摘。「全体をみながら、米国に限らず、絶えず相談しながら、対応を考えている」とした。

米長期金利が節目の５％を突破したことに関しては「特定の数字を超えたらどう、超えなかったらどうということでは必ずしもない。日々の動きをみて、その背景にある状況をみながら考えている」と語った。

その上で、三村財務官は「すべての金融市場における安定をしっかりと維持、確保していくことが仕事。日本としてもやっていくし、米国も同じ考えだろう。日米だけに限らないが、絶えず必要に応じて連携しながら協力しながらやっている」と述べ、引き続き緊密に連携していく考えを改めて示した。

先の会談で、米長期金利が５％を超えたことが議論に上がったかどうかは「大臣同士の個別の交渉。我々が申し上げている以上に、何か中身のことを申し上げることはしない」と明言を避けた。

item.title: India's SP Group eyes dollar-rupee debt route for fresh funding, sources say
item.description: India's Shapoorji Pallonji Group plans to repeat a recent fundraising strategy to meet a payment obligation at a group company after seeking an extension to a debt repayment deadline, two sources familiar with the matter said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Dharamraj Dhutia, Khushi Malhotra
item.content:encoded: India's Shapoorji Pallonji Group plans to repeat a recent fundraising strategy to meet a payment obligation at a group company after seeking an extension to a debt repayment deadline, two sources familiar with the matter said on Monday. Group subsidiary Porteast Investment faces a 35 billion rupee ($365 million) payment on debt raised in May 2025. SP Group has sought to extend the September 30 deadline to October 31. The conglomerate plans to raise U.S. dollar-denominated debt and use the proceeds to buy rupee-based securities issued by another group entity, the sources said. "Foreign investors are currently showing interest for the group's dollar-denominated papers, encouraging the group to replicate this format again," one of the sources said. The transaction would replicate a debut $650 million debt sale executed in July through its unit [USN:L4N43F08D TEXT:"Mercury Finance"], which carried a 14.50% yield. In that deal, the dollar proceeds were invested in rupee bonds issued by [USN:L4N43J0Q9 TEXT:"Eqyizen Investment"], which raised 213.50 billion rupees via three-year zero-coupon rupee-denominated bonds at 18.95% yield. Eqyizen Investment had a greenshoe option to raise additional funds that it did not exercise at the time. The group now plans to use that option, the sources said. The sources declined to be identified as they were not authorised to speak to the media. SP Group did not respond to a Reuters request for comment. Eqyizen's bonds are secured by SP Group's stake in Tata Sons, held through Cyrus Investments. The outlook for SP Group's debt has [USN:L4N45D0JZ TEXT:"improved"] after Tata Trusts, Tata Sons' controlling shareholder, said earlier this month that SP Group had proposed selling 250 billion rupees worth of its stake. The sale would provide liquidity to manage more than 500 billion rupees of high-interest debt maturing over the next few years. ($1 = 95.9525 Indian rupees)

item.title: Tribunale kazako boccia ricorso operatore petrolifero Kashagan su multa da 5 mld
item.description: Un tribunale kazako ha respinto il ricorso presentato dal gestore del giacimento petrolifero offshore di Kashagan, in Kazakistan, che mirava a ribaltare la decisione di avviare azioni esecutive per riscuotere una sanzione ambientale di circa 5 miliardi di dollari. Lo ha riferito oggi l’agenzia di stampa russa Interfax.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un tribunale kazako ha respinto il ricorso presentato dal gestore del giacimento petrolifero offshore di Kashagan, in Kazakistan, che mirava a ribaltare la decisione di avviare azioni esecutive per riscuotere una sanzione ambientale di circa 5 miliardi di dollari. Lo ha riferito oggi l’agenzia di stampa russa Interfax. La North Caspian Operating Company (Ncoc) è coinvolta da tempo in una controversia legale con il governo kazako, che la accusa di violazioni ambientali legate allo stoccaggio dello zolfo e le ha inflitto la pesante sanzione. La Ncoc, di cui fanno parte Shell (SHEL.L) , Eni (ENI.MI) , TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) ed Exxon Mobil (XOM.N) , respinge insieme ai propri appaltatori la multa e le accuse su cui si basa; il caso è attualmente al vaglio di un arbitrato internazionale. A inizio settembre il ministero della Giustizia del Kazakistan ha detto che i procedimenti esecutivi erano stati temporaneamente sospesi, ma che intendeva comunque riscuotere la sanzione. Kashagan è uno dei più grandi giacimenti petroliferi del Kazakistan.

item.title: Britain seeks compromise over blocked Orange Order march in Northern Ireland
item.description: Britain's Northern Ireland minister will on Monday meet residents who blocked a Protestant parade from marching through a Catholic area of a Northern Irish town, and hopes to find a compromise to reduce tension.
item.dc:creator: Amanda Ferguson
item.content:encoded: Britain's Northern Ireland minister will on Monday meet residents who blocked a Protestant parade from marching through a Catholic area of a Northern Irish town, and hopes to find a compromise to reduce tension. A local lawmaker warned of "profound" consequences if the parade did not proceed in the next two days. About 2,000 protesters including Northern Ireland First Minister Michelle O'Neill and Claire Hanna, the leader of Irish nationalist party SDLP, [USN:L1N45J00A TEXT:"blocked the route"] on Sunday. This led to a standoff, with both sides declining to disperse and police between them. The attempt to hold the parade from Portadown to the nearby hamlet of Drumcree followed Friday's lifting of an almost 30-year ban on the route. The parade had triggered unrest across British-run Northern Ireland in the run-up to a 1998 peace deal. The head of the Garvaghy Road Residents' Coalition told protesters late on Sunday that he would meet Northern Ireland Minister Chris Bryant and the chief of police after receiving commitments that the march would not proceed overnight. He asked that a small number of volunteers remain on the road through the night to ensure the commitments were not broken, the BBC reported. "We've stopped them once, the process now is to stop them permanently," Breandán Mac Cionnaith told the protesters. Northern Ireland's Parades Commission, set up during the original Drumcree dispute to regulate marches, permitted a smaller-than-usual parade after its initial decision to continue the ban was quashed by the High Court in August over a procedural error. EFFORTS TO REDUCE TENSION Bryant has the power to revoke the Parades Commission's ruling at the request of Northern Ireland's police, but said he had received no such request. "I've made it very clear that I think it's important that we get to a resolution and we need to find some kind of compromise. Nobody wants to perpetuate this tension and this anger," Bryant told reporters after meeting political parties on Sunday night. The dispute has created new tension in Northern Ireland's compulsory power-sharing devolved government led by Sinn Fein and pro-British rivals, the Democratic Unionist Party. The DUP says the parade must go ahead. "He (Bryant) has 24 to 48 hours to ensure the rule of law is upheld and the parade proceeds," DUP lawmaker Carla Lockhart wrote on social media after the party met the minister. "If that does not happen, the consequences will be profound. Mob rule cannot defeat the rule of law."

item.title: Aeroporto Catania, voli restano sospesi fino a mezzanotte per ceneri Etna
item.description: I voli all’aeroporto di Catania sono sospesi fino alla mezzanotte, per il terzo giorno consecutivo, a causa del rilascio di cenere vulcanica nell’atmosfera dovuta all'attività dell'Etna.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I voli all’aeroporto di Catania sono sospesi fino alla mezzanotte, per il terzo giorno consecutivo, a causa del rilascio di cenere vulcanica nell’atmosfera dovuta all'attività dell'Etna. Lo comunica Sac, il gestore dello scalo siciliano che è il quinto in termini di traffico passeggeri in Italia. "I passeggeri sono pregati di verificare con la compagnia aerea lo stato del proprio volo prima di recarsi in aeroporto. Seguiranno aggiornamenti", si legge sul sito dell'aeroporto.

item.title: Tim in calo dopo che Poste non ha raggiunto quota per delisting
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sull'andamento della Borsa di Milano:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sull'andamento della Borsa di Milano: 9.50 - TIM (TLIT.MI) cede il 2,64%, mentre POSTE (PST.MI) perde lo 0,66% dopo la conclusione dell'Opas, che ha visto Poste raggiungere una quota dell'85,82% di Telecom Italia, mancando la soglia del 90% che avrebbe consentito di procedere al delisting di Tim. Un trader segnala che il titolo è venduto perché si allontana la prospettiva del delisting a breve termine, anche se l'obiettivo di Poste resta quello di revocare le azioni dal listino milanese. 9.40 - Avvio di seduta da piatto a in lieve rialzo a Piazza Affari in un contesto internazionale ancora teso. I prezzi del petrolio sono nuovamente in salita, con il futures sul Brent intorno a 107 dollari al barile, alimentati dall'incertezza sulla possibilità che gli Usa e Iran raggiungano un accordo in tempi brevi. Secondo un trader, i mercati sono ingessati in trading range e questa situazione potrebbe durare almeno fino alle elezioni di midterm negli Stati Uniti ai primi di novembre. L'indice Ftse Mib (.FTMIB) guadagna lo 0,21%.

item.title: Cina e Usa concordano tagli dazi reciproci su 60 mld dlr di merci
item.description: Cina e Stati Uniti hanno concordato di ridurre reciprocamente i dazi su beni importati per 60 miliardi di dollari, in relazione a una vasta gamma di prodotti che vanno dal mais statunitense ai cosmetici, dagli elettrodomestici cinesi ai giocattoli.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cina e Stati Uniti hanno concordato di ridurre reciprocamente i dazi su beni importati per 60 miliardi di dollari, in relazione a una vasta gamma di prodotti che vanno dal mais statunitense ai cosmetici, dagli elettrodomestici cinesi ai giocattoli. Nell’ambito del Comitato commerciale Usa-Cina, entrambi i paesi hanno raccomandato, ciascuno per un valore di 30 miliardi di dollari, un trattamento tariffario più favorevole per i beni non sensibili, ha dichiarato ieri in un comunicato il rappresentante commerciale degli Stati Uniti Jamieson Greer. Per gli Stati Uniti, ciò significa "sbloccare un migliore accesso al mercato" per circa il 30% delle esportazioni statunitensi verso la Cina, ha detto Greer. La riduzione reciproca dei dazi doganali e la proroga della tregua commerciale sono tra i principali risultati del secondo vertice di quest’anno tra i presidenti Xi Jinping e Donald Trump, tenutosi a Washington la scorsa settimana. ESTESA TREGUA COMMERCIALE Il ministero del Commercio cinese ha dichiarato oggi che una proroga di due mesi della tregua commerciale con gli Stati Uniti, fino al 10 gennaio, offrirà a entrambe le parti il tempo necessario per valutare l’accordo in corso volto a risolvere le questioni economiche e commerciali, valutando al contempo come compiere progressi su tali fronti. La proroga, dice il ministero, garantisce anche un "contesto politico relativamente stabile e prevedibile" per la cooperazione tra le imprese e il proseguimento di colloqui attivi. I team economici e commerciali dei due Paesi condurranno dialoghi regolari incentrati sulle potenziali opportunità e barriere agli investimenti al fine di migliorare la trasparenza e la prevedibilità delle politiche e di rispondere alle ragionevoli preoccupazioni delle imprese, ha aggiunto. AGRICOLTURA E CARBONE Nell'ambito del Comitato commerciale, entrambi i Paesi istituiranno un gruppo di lavoro sull'agricoltura, che terrà la sua prima riunione entro la fine dell'anno per discutere dell'accesso reciproco al mercato e della regolamentazione dei prodotti agricoli. Il vertice ha inoltre portato alla firma di un accordo sul commercio del carbone, che consentirà alla Cina di importare carbone statunitense nel 2027 e nel 2028. "L’importazione di carbone statunitense non solo costituisce un’integrazione vantaggiosa per il mercato interno cinese del carbone, ma garantisce anche entrate economiche stabili e occupazione all’industria carbonifera statunitense", ha affermato il ministero cinese. IA, SOCIETÀ FINANZIARIE E VOLI DIRETTI Sul fronte dell'intelligenza artificiale, le due parti hanno concordato l'istituzione di un canale di comunicazione per la segnalazione di incidenti e terranno un dialogo di follow-up entro la fine di novembre. La Cina si è impegnata inoltre a esaminare e approvare società di servizi finanziari straniere, incluse quelle a capitale Usa, affinché possano operare e aprire filiali nel Paese. Proseguirà inoltre il dialogo sull’aumento dei voli tra i due Paesi.

item.title: Taiwán responde tras el intento de Xi de ganarse a Trump con su versión de la Segunda Guerra Mundial
item.description: Taiwán está plantando cara a lo que considera un intento de Pekín de reescribir la historia de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, después de que el presidente chino, Xi Jinping, y el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, destacaran la alianza entre sus países durante la guerra en una cumbre celebrada la semana pasada.
item.dc:creator: Ben Blanchard
item.content:encoded: Taiwán está plantando cara a lo que considera un intento de Pekín de reescribir la historia de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, después de que el presidente chino, Xi Jinping, y el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, destacaran la alianza entre sus países durante la guerra en una cumbre celebrada la semana pasada. Esto ha inquietado a Taipéi, que teme que Washington pueda acabar aceptando la interpretación de la historia que hace Pekín, lo que podría reducir el apoyo a la isla por parte de su principal proveedor de armas. Taiwán, isla gobernada democráticamente y reclamada por China como parte de su territorio, afirma que la versión de los hechos que promueve Pekín está distorsionada, dado que la República de China era el Gobierno en aquel momento y luchaba junto a los Aliados. El Gobierno de la República de China huyó a Taiwán en 1949 tras perder una guerra civil contra los comunistas de Mao Zedong y conserva el nombre oficial hasta el día de hoy. Pekín afirma que, durante la guerra, las fuerzas guerrilleras comunistas actuaron como la "columna vertebral" de los combates en China, y su historia oficial apenas menciona a las fuerzas republicanas. En la cena de Estado celebrada el jueves en Washington, tanto Xi como Trump elogiaron cómo sus países lucharon juntos en la guerra. Una nota informativa de la Casa Blanca tras la cumbre indicaba que Trump y Xi recordaron que Estados Unidos y China "fueron aliados en la Segunda Guerra Mundial y lucharon codo con codo para ganar la guerra". Shen Yu-chung, subdirector del Consejo de Asuntos Continentales de Taiwán, encargado de la política respecto a China, afirmó que Xi "intenta continuamente orientar la narrativa histórica de la Segunda Guerra Mundial para que esté liderada por la República Popular China". Taiwán seguirá transmitiendo mensajes a EEUU para que "comprenda correctamente que, durante todo el transcurso de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, la República de China fue un aliado inquebrantable de Estados Unidos", añadió. Ni la Casa Blanca, ni el Departamento de Estado de EEUU, ni la Oficina de Asuntos de Taiwán de China respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios. El viceministro de Asuntos Exteriores de Taiwán, François Wu, dijo que Pekín quería reescribir la "verdadera historia". "China está intentando sustituir el papel de la República de China durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial", señaló. "Creo que esto es algo que debería entristecernos mucho". "ENORMES RECURSOS PROPAGANDÍSTICOS" El año pasado, con motivo del 80.º aniversario del fin de la guerra, la embajada de facto de EEUU en Taipéi afirmó que China estaba difundiendo narrativas "falsas" sobre la Segunda Guerra Mundial para presionar a Taiwán. Chen Fang-yu, profesor asociado de la Universidad Soochow de Taipéi, señaló que Taiwán se enfrentaba al problema de cómo contrarrestar las narrativas de China ante la opinión pública estadounidense. "Nos enfrentamos a los enormes recursos propagandísticos de los comunistas chinos y a sus continuos intentos, a través de diversos medios, de lavar el cerebro e influir en la opinión pública estadounidense", dijo el domingo en un foro celebrado en Taipéi. Incluso dentro de Taiwán se discute el legado de la guerra, dado que la propia isla fue una colonia japonesa entre 1895 y 1945 y que el Partido Democrático Progresista, actualmente en el poder, defiende tradicionalmente la identidad y la historia de Taiwán como algo distinto de China. El mayor partido de la oposición de Taiwán, el Kuomintang (KMT), que fue el partido gobernante de la República de China durante la guerra, afirmó que, si bien el Gobierno había expuesto correctamente la historia, arremetía contra Pekín únicamente por su propio interés político. El Gobierno del presidente Lai Ching-te solo se refiere a la historia de la República de China anterior a 1949 cuando le conviene, "resucitando la República de China de 1945 cuando necesita enfrentarse a Pekín y competir por el control de la narrativa", señaló el KMT.

item.title: Exclusive-Japan top FX diplomat urges markets to heed 'very clear' warning on yen
item.description: TOKYO, Sept 28 : Japan's top currency diplomat Atsushi Mimura said on Monday markets should take at face value the "very clear" message Tokyo and Washington delivered last week on the yen, signalling his resolve to act against excessive falls in the currency.US President Donald Trump raised concerns about yen
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Business

Exclusive-Japan top FX diplomat urges markets to heed 'very clear' warning on yen

Japan's Vice Finance Minister for International Affairs and top currency diplomat Atsushi Mimura poses in front of an electronic board showing the Japanese yen's exchange rate against the US dollar and other currency rates and stock indices, after an interview with Reuters in Tokyo, Japan, September 28, 2026. REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

FAST

TOKYO, Sept 28 : Japan's top currency diplomat Atsushi Mimura said on Monday markets should take at face value the "very clear" message Tokyo and Washington delivered last week on the yen, signalling his resolve to act against excessive falls in the currency. US President Donald Trump raised concerns about yen weakness at a summit with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, Japan's Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Friday, offering an unusually detailed account of the leaders' talks on currencies. "Japan's prime minister, finance minister and the US have sent a very clear message. Markets should take that message at face value," Mimura said in an interview with Reuters on the yen's recent declines. "I will be watching closely whether markets will continue to take (the message) at face value." While he declined to comment on whether Japan could intervene again to prop up the yen, Mimura said he remained neither satisfied nor reassured over the yen's recent moves - suggesting that Tokyo remained on guard against the risk of renewed declines in the currency. In a sign of Tokyo and Washington's shared determination to address the weak yen, Katayama and her US counterpart Scott Bessent reaffirmed that the yen's undervaluation is a matter of concern in phone talks on Friday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Volcanic ash halts Italy's Catania airport for third day in a row
item.description: Flights at Italy's Catania airport will remain suspended on Monday for a third consecutive day after volcanic ash emissions from Mount Etna disrupted operations, the Sicilian airport's operator said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Flights at Italy's Catania airport will remain suspended on Monday for a third consecutive day after volcanic ash emissions from Mount Etna disrupted operations, the Sicilian airport's operator said. All flight operations at the airport, Italy's fifth-busiest by passenger traffic, have been suspended until 2159 GMT on Monday, according to an updated notice from operator SAC. Passengers were advised to check the status of their flights with their airlines before traveling to the airport. The operator said further updates would follow. Mount Etna, Europe's highest and most-active volcano, frequently disrupts flights at Catania, and ash emissions have been particularly intense this summer, affecting thousands of travelers during the peak holiday season this summer.

item.title: South African rand slips as US-Iran stalemate pushes oil prices higher
item.description: The South African rand slipped half a percent in early trade on Monday as the US-Iran standoff continued to drive oil prices higher, weighing on risk-sensitive currencies in oil-importing economies.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The South African rand slipped half a percent in early trade on Monday as the US-Iran standoff continued to drive oil prices higher, weighing on risk-sensitive currencies in oil-importing economies. At 0734 GMT the rand traded at 16.40 against the dollar , about 0.5% weaker than its previous close. Oil prices climbed more than 3% on Monday with Brent crude futures last above $107 a barrel, after US President Donald Trump [USN:L6N45J004 TEXT:"rejected"] a peace deal with Iran to resolve their conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. South Africa imports most of its fuel, leaving the economy vulnerable to swings in global oil prices since the Iran conflict began in late February. "Volatility in the rand could be elevated this week as the data calendar is jam-packed with data out of the US, culminating in the US non-farm payrolls on Friday," said Andre Cilliers at TreasuryONE. On the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, the Top-40 index (.JTOPI) fell 1.7% in early trade. Gold Fields (GFIJ.J) led losses, dropping about 13% after Australia's Northern Star Resources (NST.AX) said it had [USN:L1N45K003 TEXT:"rejected"] an unsolicited A$38.7 billion ($27.1 billion) takeover approach. South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond also weakened, as the yield rose 5.5 basis points to 8.855%.

item.title: Swedish opposition leader Andersson says she cannot form government in current situation
item.description: Swedish Social Democrat leader Magdalena Andersson said on Monday she would tell the speaker of parliament that she was unable to form a government in the current situation, after an election earlier this month gave her centre-left bloc a narrow majority.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Swedish Social Democrat leader Magdalena Andersson said on Monday she would tell the speaker of parliament that she was unable to form a government in the current situation, after an election earlier this month gave her centre-left bloc a [USN:L1N455016 TEXT:"narrow majority"]. Her decision came after the Left Party said over the weekend it would back a candidate for parliament speaker from the rival Moderate Party, which Andersson said undercut her attempt to build a government. "Of course, I take the Left Party's message seriously, and based on that and the conversations I have had, I can conclude that there is currently no possibility for me to form a government," she told a press conference. The centre-left won 176 seats to 173 seats for the incumbent right bloc in a vote widely seen as a referendum on Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson's promise to form a coalition with the far-right [USN:L1N40K0GO TEXT:"Sweden Democrats"]. The speaker will now decide to whom to hand the task to seek to secure backing for a government, potentially Kristersson.

item.title: Taylor Swift hace historia en los VMA y dedica el premio a Dolly Parton
item.description: El vídeo "The Fate of Ophelia" de Taylor Swift, inspirado en las coristas de cabaret, se alzó con el premio más prestigioso en la gala anual de los Video Music Awards de la MTV celebrada el domingo, y la cantante dedicó el galardón a la recientemente fallecida leyenda de la música "country" Dolly Parton.
item.dc:creator: Lisa Richwine
item.content:encoded: El vídeo "The Fate of Ophelia" de Taylor Swift, inspirado en las coristas de cabaret, se alzó con el premio más prestigioso en la gala anual de los Video Music Awards de la MTV celebrada el domingo, y la cantante dedicó el galardón a la recientemente fallecida leyenda de la música "country" Dolly Parton. Swift se llevó a casa tres premios en los VMA de este año, lo que eleva el total de su carrera a la cifra inigualable de 33. Anteriormente estaba empatada con Beyoncé con 30 premios cada una. "The Fate of Ophelia", el primer sencillo del álbum "The Life of a Showgirl", de 2025, que batió récords, fue nombrado vídeo del año. Mientras sostenía la estatuilla del premio que acababa de recibir, Swift elogió a Parton como "la 'showgirl' por excelencia", que contaba historias "tan vivas y tan ricas". "Creo que todos hemos tenido mucha suerte de compartir este planeta con Dolly Parton durante un tiempo", dijo Swift. Parton, galardonada cantante de "country", compositora y empresaria, falleció en agosto a los 80 años. Al principio de la ceremonia, Swift recibió el primer premio MTV VMA Artist Director Honors, un nuevo galardón que reconoce a los artistas musicales cuyo trabajo detrás de la cámara ha supuesto una innovación en los vídeos musicales. La artista, de 36 años, ha escrito y dirigido 18 de los aproximadamente 60 vídeos que ha realizado a lo largo de su carrera. El más reciente, correspondiente a su nuevo sencillo, "Patient Zero", se estrenó durante la ceremonia. El vídeo estaba protagonizado por Dakota Johnson y Colin Farrell, que interpretaban a una pareja en una relación tóxica. "La razón principal por la que me encanta tanto escribir y dirigir vídeos musicales es porque vosotros, los fans, lo hacéis tan, tan divertido", dijo Swift. "Os importa de verdad lo que estamos creando". También ganó el premio a la mejor dirección por su vídeo "Opalite". Los VMA se retransmitieron en directo por las cadenas estadounidenses CBS y MTV, y se emitieron en línea a través de Paramount+ (PSKY.O) , con Snoop Dogg como presentador. Los ganadores de las categorías principales fueron seleccionados mediante los votos de los fans. La leyenda de la música pop Madonna encabezó la lista de ganadores de este año con siete premios, entre ellos el de artista del año y el de mejor vídeo de baile por "Confessions II — The Film". Recordó su actuación de 1984 con "Like a Virgin" en la primera edición de los VMA, que, según dijo, se consideró demasiado provocativa para la televisión por cable en aquella época. "Creo que la mayoría de vosotros probablemente aún no habíais nacido", dijo la artista de 68 años al público antes de explicar que tuvo que recuperarse rápidamente durante aquella actuación tras un percance con un zapato. "Me tiré al suelo del escenario para intentar parecer mona y sexy", comentó. "Se me veía una nalga. En aquella época, no se solían ver las nalgas (…). Mi representante me dijo que mi carrera había terminado". Al hablar del álbum "Confessions II", Madonna describió cómo había pasado los últimos 18 meses: "Encontrándome a mí misma, creyendo en mí misma y creando de verdad la música que quería hacer". "Para mí, esa es realmente la definición de ser artista", dijo. Madonna inauguró el espectáculo con una actuación llena de energía en la que interpretó dos de sus colaboraciones más recientes. Sabrina Carpenter se unió a ella para interpretar "Bring Your Love" —una canción que más tarde fue nombrada mejor colaboración— y Charli XCX subió al escenario para interpretar "Danceteria Afterhours", rodeada de bailarines en un decorado que parecía el baño de una discoteca. En un momento más tranquilo, Kacey Musgraves rindió homenaje a Parton interpretando la intemporal "I Will Always Love You". Lisa, miembro del grupo Blackpink, ganó el VMA al mejor vídeo pop por su trabajo en solitario "Dream". Luciendo un conjunto negro con grandes mangas con flecos blancos, habló entre lágrimas mientras daba las gracias a sus fans, conocidos como "Lillies". "No estaría aquí sin vosotros", dijo. "Muchísimas gracias por vuestro cariño y apoyo". La cantante y compositora inglesa Sienna Spiro, que combina pop, "jazz" y "soul", fue nombrada mejor artista revelación.

item.title: Madrid housing protests enter third day after pensioner's eviction
item.description: Protesters on Monday began a third day camped outside the administration of the Madrid region to object to the eviction of an octogenarian and demand stronger protection for tenants in the face of a lack of housing and soaring rents.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Protesters on Monday began a third day camped outside the administration of the Madrid region to object to the eviction of an octogenarian and demand stronger protection for tenants in the face of a lack of housing and soaring rents. Protests [USN:L8N45F0PQ TEXT:"boiled over"] last week after police evicted 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal on a stretcher from her Madrid home of more than seven decades because of an eviction order secured by the investment fund that bought her apartment. Hundreds of people outside the block clashed with police, while the leftist central government condemned the centre-right regional administration that had failed to prevent the eviction. By Monday, hundreds of tents filled the central Puerta del Sol square, echoing the protests of 2011 when it was occupied for a month by activists demonstrating against austerity measures adopted during the global financial crisis. TENS OF THOUSANDS MARCH THROUGH MADRID On Saturday, some 30,000 people marched through Madrid to object to the treatment of Maricarmen and others forced from their homes by investment funds. Marchers shook keys and bore banners with slogans including "Speculators go home" and "Housing is for living". As night fell on Puerta del Sol, home to the office of Isabel Diaz Ayuso, centre-right president of the Madrid region, dozens of activists put up tents, and their number has steadily grown since. Blanca, a student, said young Spaniards were struggling to move out of their parents' homes. "Politicians not only do nothing but make it worse," she said. "We've decided to put our foot down, so let’s hope they hear us." Further protests were set to take place across Spain on Monday, according to the Tenants' Union, which has been co-ordinating the protests. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on Sunday said the government was working to enact a decree on housing in parliament by Tuesday that would bring immediate relief for tenants. Rents have on average doubled over the past decade, far outpacing salary growth. Spain has a deficit of 750,000 homes, according to the central bank. Only about 120,000 are built each year, a sixth of the level before the 2008 financial crisis. Ayuso on Friday blamed Sanchez's government for failing to address the housing issue in its eight years in power.

item.title: 中国宇宙ステーションで初の外国人活動へ、「宇宙外交」でパキスタン人候補が訓練中
item.description:
Saad Sayeed Ariba Shahid
［カラチ ２８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Saad Sayeed　Ariba Shahid

［カラチ　２８日　ロイター］ - 中国・北京の中国航天員科研訓練センター（中国宇宙飛行士訓練センター）。ここでパキスタンの宇宙飛行士候補２人が、中国の宇宙ステーション「天宮」で活動するため、数カ月前から訓練を受けている。最終的に宇宙船に乗船できるのは１人。実現すれば、パキスタンにとって初めての宇宙飛行となると同時に、中国にとっても初の外国人宇宙飛行士の搭乗となる。

今回の宇宙飛行計画は、２０１９年に両国が構想した。パキスタンは独自のロケットや有人宇宙船を持っていない。中国の支援で衛星を打ち上げたり、中国版全地球測位システム（ＧＰＳ）「北斗」を軍の測位システムに取り入れている。

候補２人のうちどちらが、いつ飛行するのか、中国は明らかにしていない。パキスタンの宇宙・上層大気研究委員会（ＳＵＰＡＲＣＯ）で有人宇宙飛行の協力を統括するアメル・ギラニ氏は、最終的な選抜結果は１０月中旬から下旬に決まる見通しだと述べた。

ＳＵＰＡＲＣＯのＡＩ（人工知能）担当ディレクター、ウザイル・アンサリ氏によれば、選ばれた１人は宇宙で科学実験を行う「ペイロードスペシャリスト」として活動する。

ギラニ氏によると、ＳＵＰＡＲＣＯは１年がかりの募集活動で、カラチ、ラホール、イスラマバードの大学から３００件を超える提案を受け付けた。中国側が今回の飛行向けに４件を選んだ。いずれも、食料不安や気候変動への対策に役立つバイオテクノロジーの実験だという。アンサリ氏は、パキスタンの技術が国際的な場で検証される珍しい例だと述べた。

パキスタン飛行士の滞在期間は約１週間で、中国人飛行士の標準的な滞在期間である約６カ月に比べるとごく短い。今年５月に天宮に到着した中国人３人のうち、１年間滞在する予定の１人を除く２人と一緒に帰還する予定。

２８年ごろに予定される中国の月探査機「嫦娥８号」のミッションには、パキスタン製の探査車が搭載される予定だ。

同じ協力の枠組みでパキスタン宇宙飛行士を月に送る約束を中国から取り付けたのかとの質問に、ギラニ氏は「この件について公式な約束や協議はない」と答えた。その上で、今後どうなるかは「われわれの最初のミッション」の結果次第だとした。

パキスタン人候補の２人は、パイロットのジーシャン・アリ氏とクラム・ダウド氏。パイロットと科学者で構成する当初の候補者から絞り込まれた約２０人の最終候補の中から選ばれた。現在、宇宙船システムの習得のほか、宇宙空間では中国語でやりとりするため中国語の集中講義も受けている。

item.title: Airbus probes A321neo flaw as repair plan eases disruption
item.description: Airbus and Italy's Leonardo are investigating a glitch at a privately held coatings firm that triggered a quality alert affecting 500 of the planemaker's best-selling A321neo jets, people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Tim Hepher, Giulia Segreti
item.content:encoded: Airbus (AIR.PA) and Italy's Leonardo (LDOF.MI) are investigating a glitch at a privately held coatings firm that triggered a quality alert affecting 500 of the planemaker's best-selling A321neo jets, people familiar with the matter said. The flaw, which Airbus [USN:L1N45H06S TEXT:"confirmed on Friday"] following a report in the Air Current, was discovered when one of the planemaker's technicians scraped paint from a fuselage part only to find gaps in the protective primer underneath, they said. Teams of engineers from Airbus and Leonardo are now working at coatings supplier TESI, a Leonardo sub-contractor south of Naples, to support recovery efforts and find the cause of the problem, which has yet to be identified, the sources said. TESI did not reply to requests for comment. Airbus declined to name suppliers. Leonardo has confirmed TESI is a supplier but has not said whether it is involved in its work for Airbus. The problem involves strengthening rods called stringers in one section of the forward fuselage of the A321neo and has raised fresh questions over quality controls and points of vulnerability embedded in the supply chain, analysts say. Airbus has two suppliers for that section, Leonardo and its own in-house supplier Airbus Atlantic, formerly known as Stelia, which also has overall charge of the front part of the aircraft. However, Leonardo has one supplier for the coatings, they said. SHORTER MAINTENANCE CYCLE Airbus has said about 500 planes are involved including 250 at various stages of production and that safety is unaffected. Airlines continuing to take delivery will be given two years to repair the affected part - rather than the usual four-year maintenance cycle - with work expected to take up to nine days including 2-3 days for the core repair job, the sources said. That is less than some analysts had feared since the parts will not need to be removed from the fuselage panel. The primer is designed to prevent corrosion that can appear over time in the lowest point of a plane's fuselage known by the nautical term "bilge" - an area where moisture builds up. Its absence does not pose an immediate safety risk on a new jet but analysts have said the second fuselage glitch in less than a year could put new pressure on Airbus' efforts to speed up deliveries and meet targets in the second half of the year. "The supply chain is still not under control; we thought it was but it isn't," aviation analyst Rob Morris said. "It just takes one company and suddenly you have a problem." Airbus on Friday reaffirmed its 2026 delivery target.

item.title: UK housebuilders stocks rally on homebuyer loan revival
item.description: British housebuilder stocks surged on Monday after the government confirmed plans to introduce a new equity loan programme for first-time buyers in next month's budget, a move that could boost home sales and revive a sector that has struggled in recent years.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British housebuilder stocks surged on Monday after the [USN:L6N45I066 TEXT:"government confirmed"] plans to introduce a new equity loan programme for first-time buyers in next month's budget, a move that could boost home sales and revive a sector that has struggled in recent years. Shares in Persimmon (PSN.L) , Barratt Redrow (BTRW.L) , Taylor Wimpey (TW.L) , Vistry (VTYV.L) and Berkeley Group (BKGH.L) rose between 6% and 23%, leading gains across London's indices. The British homebuilders' index (.FTNMX402020) jumped 16% to hit its highest level since March 2026. The policy, a revival of the "Help to Buy" scheme which expired in 2023, is aimed at injecting growth into the economy by increasing demand for house building, as well as assisting first-time buyers. Homebuilders like Bellway, Berkeley and Taylor Wimpey have [USN:L4N4530GA TEXT:"urged"] Andy Burnham's government to revive incentives for first-time buyers grappling with affordability concerns amid rising mortgage rates and geopolitical uncertainty. Peel Hunt analyst Sam Cullen said it expects about 20% of deals to be supported by the scheme and a 10% uplift in volumes in 2028. Shares in UK building materials suppliers also rallied on the news, with Ibstock (IBST.L) , Forterra (FORT.L) , Marshalls (MSLH.L) , Breedon (BREE.L) , Topps Tiles (TPT.L) up between 5% and 20%. London's FTSE 250 midcap index (.FTMC) , which contains a number of construction company shares, was up 1%, making it one of the top-performing indexes in Europe on Monday.

item.title: Philippines accuses Chinese vessel of spoofing location in northern waters
item.description: The Philippine Coast Guard accused a Chinese research vessel on Monday of spoofing its location while loitering off Batanes, the country's northernmost island group near Taiwan, saying its movements were consistent with unauthorised marine scientific research.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Philippine Coast Guard accused a Chinese research vessel on Monday of spoofing its location while loitering off Batanes, the country's northernmost island group near Taiwan, saying its movements were consistent with unauthorised marine scientific research. The coast guard said in a statement that a seabed survey vessel concealing its whereabouts while holding its position in waters between the Philippines and Taiwan raised "serious concerns about the security of the country's undersea communications infrastructure and the potential military use of any data collected." PCG said the Chinese-flagged research vessel JIA HAI KE 7 was detected about 38 nautical miles northwest of Itbayat in Batanes. Itbayat lies about 160 km from Taiwan. The Coast Guard said the vessel ignored repeated radio challenges to identify its intentions and cease any unauthorised activity. PCG said the vessel was loitering and holding its position rather than proceeding on a steady course that would have indicated innocent passage. The PCG said the vessel appeared to be broadcasting false AIS positions, with tracking data showing it moving from the coast of Xiamen in southeast China to a location off Papua New Guinea on the same day. It later appeared northwest of Itbayat, a timeframe that would have been physically impossible, the agency said. The vessel's behaviour was consistent with marine scientific research activity rather than transit, PCG added. The vessel is a 2,000-ton, 70-metre survey ship designed to conduct marine geological surveys and capable of precise station-keeping, according to open-source information cited by the coast guard. Waters off Batanes and the Luzon Strait host key submarine cable corridors linking the Philippines with Northeast Asia and the wider Indo-Pacific. PCG said it would continue monitoring the vessel. The Chinese Embassy in Manila did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Chinese scholars at Jinan University have previously argued that Batanes [USN:L6N43X0RF TEXT:"belonged to China"].

item.title: インドネシア中銀、スポット市場での為替介入を30％に縮小＝総裁
item.description: [ジャカルタ ２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ジャカルタ ２８日 ロイター] - インドネシア中央銀行のデストリ総裁は２８日、為替介入全体に占めるスポット市場での介入の割合を３０％に引き下げたと明らかにした。コストがかかり過ぎるためだという。

議会公聴会で「コストの高いスポット市場での介入を大幅に減らした。現在は全体の約３０％にとどまっている」と述べた。

ノンデリバラブル・フォワード（ＮＤＦ）市場での介入の方が効果的で、外貨準備を取り崩す必要も少なくなることが確認されたと説明した。またルピア相場を安定させるには実体経済への投資も増やす必要があると述べた。

item.title: European shares rise as British homebuilders surge on buyer support scheme
item.description: European shares edged higher on Monday, supported by a rally in British housebuilders, although gains were capped by a rebound in oil prices and elevated bond yields.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: European shares edged higher on Monday, supported by a rally in British housebuilders, although gains were capped by a rebound in oil prices and elevated bond yields. The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) was up 0.3% at 640.43 points by 0725 GMT. Most major regional bourses also traded higher. [USN:L8N45K0AN TEXT:"British housebuilders"]' stocks surged after the government said it would confirm a new equity loan programme for first-time buyers in next month's budget, reviving a policy designed at boosting home ownership and supporting home construction. Shares of Persimmon (PSN.L) , Barratt Redrow (BTRW.L) , Taylor Wimpey (TW.L) , Vistry (VTYV.L) rose between 13% and 17%. However, broader market gains were restrained by a more than 3% jump in Brent crude prices after US President Donald Trump rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the conflict, keeping Middle East tensions in focus. European energy shares (.SXEP) inched 0.5% higher, although miners (.SXPP) slumped 2% as greenback-priced metals fell on the back of a stronger dollar. Investors' focus will also be on speeches from European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde and Bank of England Deputy Governor Dave Ramsden later in the day, especially as markets price in further tightening by major central banks to tame inflationary pressures. Among individual stocks, Akzo Nobel (AKZO.AS) gained roughly 1% after JPMorgan reinstated coverage with an "overweight" rating.

item.title: India's top court says need to fix accountability over Delhi rape cases, media reports
item.description: The Supreme Court of India on Monday pushed for accountability over a recent spate of rape cases in the national capital and neighbouring districts, saying they reflected a "failure of law enforcement", local media reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Supreme Court of India on Monday pushed for accountability over a recent spate of rape cases in the national capital and neighbouring districts, saying they reflected a "failure of law enforcement", local media reported. Hundreds of students [USN:L6N45F0FP TEXT:"protested in Delhi"] last week demanding better safety for women after a teenager said she was gang-raped by three men at a park in the city. Last month, a 17-year-old girl was allegedly gang-raped in a moving bus by the driver and conductor, local media reported. The Supreme Court said public spaces, including parks and buses, could not become "high-risk" zones because of poor lighting and surveillance, and other basic facilities, legal news website Live Law reported. The court said fixing accountability was necessary and directed its administration to file a public interest petition on the issue for the court to pursue, legal news website Bar and Bench said. Sexual violence is a [USN:L4N43F0CM TEXT:"major problem across India"], with more than 80 rapes reported to police every day, according to the National Crime Records Bureau. Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta told a TV channel last week that there had been lapses and vowed to improve security, while Delhi Police said it had increased "visible policing" and intensified patrolling.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
カカクコムとＫＤＤＩが資本提携解消、第2位株主の地位変わらず 16:39 配信

[東京 ２８日 ロイター] - カカクコムは２８日、ＫＤＤＩとの資本提携の解消すると発表した。ＫＤＤＩが指名する取締役候補の受け入れなどに関する合意が失効する。同時に業務提携の継続でも合意し、ＫＤＤＩはカカクコムの発行済株式の１７．７０％を保有する第２位株主の地位を維持する。

両社は２０１８年８月に資本提携契約を締結。現在カカクコム株に対して行われている公開買い付け（ＴＯＢ）など資本構造の変化や今後の経営方針を巡る協議を重ね、今回、円満解消で合意した。ＫＤＤＩから派遣されていた社外取締役はすでに６月開催の定時株主総会終結をもって退任している。

新規サービスの共同開発・提供やインターネット広告・デジタルマーケティング事業の推進に向けた協業・連携など、業務上の提携は継続する。

カカクコムは、資本提携解消が２０２７年３月期の連結業績に与える直接的な影響は軽微としている。

item.title: Ireland's top private landlord IRES open to $827 million takeover bid from Barings
item.description: Irish Residential Properties REIT , Ireland's largest private residential landlord, said on Monday it would be inclined to recommend a possible all-cash takeover offer from asset manager Barings at €1.386 per share, implying an equity value of about €726.88 million ($827.12 million).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Irish Residential Properties REIT (IRES.I) , Ireland's largest private residential landlord, said on Monday it would be inclined to recommend a possible all-cash takeover offer from asset manager Barings at €1.386 per share, implying an equity value of about €726.88 million ($827.12 million). The board said it had received five proposals from Barings, the first on August 5, and had unanimously concluded it would back a firm offer at the latest price if one were made. The offer represents a premium of 30.75% to the stock's close on Friday. Under Irish Takeover Rules, Barings has until November 9 to announce a firm intention to bid or walk away, unless the deadline is extended. IRES, which provides private residential rental accommodation in and around Dublin, has seen strong demand for quality rental homes amid Ireland's housing shortage. ($1 = 0.8788 euros)

item.title: Kazakh court rejects Kashagan oil operator's bid to block enforcement of $5 bln fine
item.description: A Kazakh court has dismissed a lawsuit by the operator of Kazakhstan's offshore Kashagan oilfield that sought to overturn a decision to begin enforcement actions to collect an environmental fine of around $5 billion, Russia's Interfax news agency reported on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Kazakh court has dismissed a lawsuit by the operator of Kazakhstan's offshore Kashagan oilfield that sought to overturn a decision to begin enforcement actions to collect an environmental fine of around $5 billion, Russia's Interfax news agency reported on Monday. The North Caspian Operating Company (NCOC) has been mired in a lengthy legal [USN:L1N43I05M TEXT:"standoff"] with the Kazakh government, which accuses it of environmental violations related to sulphur storage and imposed the large fine. NCOC, which includes Shell (SHEL.L) , Eni (ENI.MI) , TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) and Exxon Mobil (XOM.N) , and its contractors reject the fine and the allegations behind it, and the case is currently being heard in international arbitration. In early September, Kazakhstan's Justice Ministry said enforcement proceedings had been temporarily suspended, but that it [USN:L8N4510OJ TEXT:"still intended"] to collect the fine. Kashagan is one of Kazakhstan's largest oilfields.

item.title: Rain-hit Asian Games battles scheduling logjam
item.description: Asian Games organisers faced multiple scheduling headaches on Monday as persistent rain disrupted several competitions at the sprawling multi-sport event.
item.dc:creator: Ian Ransom
item.content:encoded: Asian Games organisers faced multiple scheduling headaches on Monday as persistent rain disrupted several competitions at the sprawling multi-sport event. Tennis, surfing and cricket were among sports hit by poor weather on day nine of full competition. Both the men's cricket quarter-finals between Pakistan-Hong Kong and India-Afghanistan were washed out after the playing field was drenched at Korogi Athletic Park on the outskirts of Nagoya. With no contingency built into the schedule, Pakistan and India advanced to the semi-finals of the T20 tournament by virtue of their higher ranking. It was a bitter pill for Afghanistan, which saw the gold medal go to India due to the rankings rule three years ago when their Hangzhou Games final was abandoned due to rain. "The rain started yesterday, so hard luck for us," said Afghanistan opener Mohammed Akram. "We would have been happy to play here with India – our players are in form. "But unfortunately the rain has ruined everything." Powerful typhoon Surigae lashed Japan's southern Okinawa prefecture on Monday and was projected to track northeast toward central Japan and the Tokyo region by midweek, raising the prospect of strong winds and heavy rain further disrupting the Games. Typhoon Dujuan hit the Games early on week one, causing [USN:L6N45D0HJ TEXT:"equestrian events in Tokyo"] to be suspended, though most competitions were unaffected. The continental sporting showpiece is mainly based in the city of Nagoya and Aichi Prefecture but Tokyo is also hosting diving events while Osaka has soccer matches. The rain saw several tennis matches scrapped on Sunday and caused match delays on Monday. Fans hoping to catch Filipino headliner Alex Eala's opening match against Thai opponent Patcharin Cheapchandej were repeatedly frustrated at the Higashiyama Park Tennis Centre. Eala, the women's top seed, had her match shifted off centre court amid the scheduling logjam but was yet to start by mid-afternoon. Poor wave conditions saw the surfing called off early at the Long Beach venue southeast of Nagoya, with medal finals having already been pushed into the final scheduled day on Tuesday. India's Kishore Kumar Anbarasu was able to complete his heat before it was abandoned, beating China's Ma Wensong to make it into the quarter-finals on the sport's Asian Games debut. “It was not the easiest conditions. It was very hard to find the good waves," said Anbarasu. The Asian Games run until October 4.

item.title: UK police question five men held at airbase used by US to attack Iran
item.description: British police were questioning five men on Monday on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offences after they were detained near an air base that has been used by the US to strike Iran.
item.dc:creator: Toby Shepheard
item.content:encoded: British police were questioning five men on Monday on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offences after they were detained near an air base that has been used by the US to strike Iran . Officers detained the five men in the early hours of Sunday after they received a tip-off that three large white vans had been seen heading to the [USN:L1N45J01J TEXT:"military airfield of RAF Fairford"] in the west of England. US President Donald Trump said the suspects had been looking to do "big damage" and had been under investigation by British and US authorities. However, a local farmer said she had tipped off police after seeing a group of "hooded and masked men" running into the fields. British counterterrorism detectives have not yet publicly stated who they assessed was involved but a source familiar with the investigation said an [USN:L1N43P14J TEXT:"Iranian-linked motive"] was considered the most likely, while a [USN:L8N45H0EB TEXT:"Russian sabotage operation"] or an Islamist plot were also being looked at as possibilities. Defence minister Wes Streeting told BBC News on Monday that he would not speculate about motives of a live investigation. But he added on the general Iranian threat to the country: "We know that Iran and their proxies wish to do us harm. We know that they hate our democracy, and we know that we regularly have to thwart Iranian attempts to threaten either our interests or indeed our allies." In May, Britain sanctioned 12 individuals and entities linked to Iran, accusing them of [USN:L8N41O1H0 TEXT:"involvement in hostile activity"] including plotting attacks and providing financial services to groups seeking to destabilise the UK and other countries. Iran has repeatedly denied involvement in attacks or plots in the UK and elsewhere. BASE CORDONED OFF The British government had given authorisation to the US to use bombers based at Fairford to strike Iranian missile sites that were attacking ships in the Strait of Hormuz. The government has said Prime Minister Andy Burnham is being regularly updated on the incident and he cancelled attending at least two events at his Labour Party's annual conference on Sunday. Iran's Revolutionary Guards had warned Britain in July not to allow US bombers to fly from Fairford, saying any base used to launch attacks would be a legitimate target. In Fairford, police have imposed a 400-metre cordon around the base and evacuated residents from 85 homes. A bomb disposal robot could be seen on Sunday operating around the three white vans, while security was stepped up around the base. Armed police stood guard at the main entrance while large machinery was used to block other access points. Security was also stepped up at other US bases in Britain.

item.title: ULTIM'ORA-UCRAINA: Russia sta pianificando altri atti di sabotaggio in Europa - Kallas
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina: 9.00 - I rapporti di intelligence indicano che la Russia sta pianificando ulteriori atti di sabotaggio in Europa, ha detto l'alta rappresentante dell'Unione europea per gli Affari esteri, Kaja Kallas. "Dobbiamo essere vigili, perché dalle informazioni di intelligence emerge che la Russia sta pianificando altri atti di sabotaggio e attacchi contro la nostra democrazia per dividere le nostre società e intimidirle affinché smettano di sostenere l'Ucraina", ha detto Kallas prima della riunione dei ministri della Difesa dell'Ue a Bruxelles.

item.title: Missione navale Ue in Mar Rosso ha bisogno di più navi - Kallas
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente: 8.45 - L'alta rappresentante dell'Unione europea per gli Affari esteri, Kaja Kallas, ha detto che la missione Aspides, avviata per proteggere le navi nel Mar Rosso, necessita di un maggior numero di unità navali per diventare pienamente operativa. Intervenendo all'arrivo alla riunione dei ministri della Difesa dell'Ue a Bruxelles, Kallas ha detto di aver esortato gli Stati membri a contribuire maggiormente alla missione, senza tuttavia avere ricevuto finora nuovi impegni concreti. 7.40 - Il ministro degli Esteri saudita, il principe Faisal bin Farhan, è arrivato a Washington per un incontro con il segretario di Stato Usa Marco Rubio. Lo ha riferito l'agenzia di stampa ufficiale saudita, mentre si intensificano le ostilità tra Riyadh e gli Houthi yemeniti. Questo mese il principe ereditario saudita Mohammed bin Salman aveva chiesto agli Stati Uniti un sostegno militare contro gli Houthi, sostenuti dall'Iran, ma Washington aveva respinto l'ipotesi di condurre attacchi diretti, accettando tuttavia di fornire supporto in termini di intelligence e identificazione degli obiettivi, secondo quanto riferito da fonti a Reuters. 7.00 - L'Iran ha ribadito domenica che solo la diplomazia può risolvere il conflitto con gli Stati Uniti e Israele, dopo che il presidente statunitense Donald Trump ha affermato di aver respinto una proposta iraniana volta a riaprire lo Stretto di Hormuz e a porre fine ai combattimenti.

item.title: Ölpreisanstieg und fallende Tech-Werte machen Dax-Anleger vorsichtig
item.description: Nach der Erholung am Freitag zeigen sich die Dax-Anleger zum Auftakt der neuen Woche vorsichtig. Der deutsche Leitindex notierte zur Eröffnung am Montag knapp im Plus bei 25.443,98 Punkten. "Die Anleger stehen derzeit mit einem Fuß auf dem Gaspedal und mit dem anderen auf der Bremse", kommentierte Timo Emden, Chefanalyst beim Broker CapTrader.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nach der [USN:L8N45H166 TEXT:"Erholung"] am Freitag zeigen sich die Dax (.GDAXI) -Anleger zum Auftakt der neuen Woche vorsichtig. Der deutsche Leitindex notierte zur Eröffnung am Montag knapp im Plus bei 25.443,98 Punkten. "Die Anleger stehen derzeit mit einem Fuß auf dem Gaspedal und mit dem anderen auf der Bremse", kommentierte Timo Emden, Chefanalyst beim Broker CapTrader. Für maue Stimmung sorgte ein erneuter Anstieg beim Ölpreis. Nordsee-Rohöl Brent und US-Leichtöl WTI verteuerten sich um drei und zwei Prozent. US-Präsident Donald Trump hatte am Wochenende die Bedingungen des Irans zur Wiederöffnung der für Energietransporte wichtigen Straße von Hormus [USN:L6N45K01P TEXT:"abgelehnt"]. "Auch wenn die Aussicht auf weitere Gespräche zwischen dem Iran und den USA einen kompletten Stimmungsabbruch verhindert, dürfte die Anspannung hochbleiben", sagte Emden. Die geopolitischen Risiken in der Region blieben Experten zufolge auch wegen anhaltender Angriffe der Huthi-Rebellen auf Saudi-Arabien hoch. Bei den Einzelwerten gerieten vor allem Technologiewerte unter Druck. Die Aktien von Infineon (IFXGn.DE) , Aixtron (AIXGn.DE) und Elmos Semiconductor (ELGG.DE) gaben zwischen 1,3 und 2,6 Prozent nach. "Die angekündigte Trainingspause von OpenAI bei seinem neuesten KI-Modell wirft die Frage auf, ob sich die enorme Geschwindigkeit der vergangenen Jahre tatsächlich fortsetzen lässt", sagte Andreas Lipkow, Chefanalyst beim Broker CMC Markets. Zugleich ließen die enormen Investitionen in den Ausbau von KI-Rechenzentren erneut Zweifel aufkommen, ob sich die hohen Ausgaben schnell genug rentieren. "Genau hier könnte die nächste Phase der KI-Euphorie entschieden werden."

item.title: アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（28日）
item.description: ソウル株式市場は大幅下落。休場期間の他市場動向を追跡する取引となり、高い債券利回りへの懸念から半導体株が下げ、２週間ぶり...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（28日） 16:19 配信

ソウル株式市場は大幅下落。休場期間の他市場動向を追跡する取引となり、高い債券利回りへの懸念から半導体株が下げ、２週間ぶりの大幅安となった。

総合株価指数（ＫＯＳＰＩ）は２．７０％安で終了。４営業日続伸で約２カ月ぶりの高値を付けていたが９月１４日以来の大幅な下落率となった。韓国金融市場は２４・２５日、休場だった。

米国株式市場は前週末、マイクロソフトなど人工知能（ＡＩ）関連ハイテク株に支えられて上昇して終了した。ただ、原油高と米国債利回りの上昇で投資家は神経質になった。

ユジン投資証券のアナリストは「債券利回りの上昇を受け、外国人売りは半導体セクターに集中した。ただ、値上がり銘柄が値下がり銘柄を上回っており、高債券利回りで投資家心理が幅広く弱くなっているとは言い難い」と述べた。韓国銀行（中央銀行）は２８日、金融・外国為替市場を注意深く監視するとの方針を示した。財政相も、金融市場の監視と対応で中銀との協力を強化するとした。

アナリストによると、投資家の焦点は今週後半に発表される韓国の輸出統計と米マイクロン・テクノロジーの決算で、ＡＩ主導の半導体ブームの手掛かりを探る。

騰落銘柄数は値上がり６１１、値下がり２４９。外国人は３兆２０００億ウォン（２３億５０００万ドル）の売り越しだった。

シドニー株式市場は金融株主導で上昇。

Ｓ＆Ｐ／ＡＳＸ２００指数は依然として２００日移動平均を約１．６％下回っている。

ロイターの調査によると、オーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行、ＲＢＡ）は２９日に２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）利上げし、４．６０％とすることが広く見込まれている。スワップ市場ではその後さらに約４０ｂｐの引き締めが織り込まれている。

ＫＣＭトレードのチーフマーケットアナリスト、ティム・ウォーターラー氏は、利上げはほぼ織り込み済みで、焦点はＲＢＡがさらなる引き締めを示唆するのか、それともより慎重でデータ次第の姿勢に転じるかだと指摘。「よりタカ派的な道筋を示唆すれば金利敏感セクターが圧迫される可能性がある一方、抑制的なメッセージであれば市場は最近の水準を維持しやすくなる。タカ派的な発言なら株式のモメンタムに急ブレーキがかかりかねない」と述べた。

金利敏感な金融株指数は１．２％高と、約１週間半ぶりの大幅高となった。

鉄鉱石価格の下落を受けて鉱業株は３営業日続落し１．５％安。

金相場下落で産金株指数は１．６％下落したが、最大手のノーザンスター・リソーシズは南アフリカのゴールド・フィールズによる買収提案を拒否したことを受けて６．２％上昇した。

item.title: El crecimiento de los beneficios industriales de China se ralentiza aún más en agosto
item.description: El crecimiento de los beneficios industriales de China se ralentizó aún más en agosto, en un mes en que la fortaleza del sector tecnológico —impulsada por el auge de la inteligencia artificial— se vio contrarrestada por una demanda interna persistentemente débil.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El crecimiento de los beneficios industriales de China se ralentizó aún más en agosto, en un mes en que la fortaleza del sector tecnológico —impulsada por el auge de la inteligencia artificial— se vio contrarrestada por una demanda interna persistentemente débil. Las empresas tienen cada vez más dificultades para mantener su poder de fijación de precios debido al débil consumo y al exceso de capacidad en algunos sectores. Las fábricas dependen de los mercados extranjeros para obtener mejores beneficios, un cambio que corre el riesgo de agravar la dependencia de China de las exportaciones en un momento de intensas tensiones geopolíticas y de mayor escrutinio de su superávit comercial. China y EEUU acordaron reducir los aranceles sobre 30.000 millones de dólares en mercancías y mantener un diálogo sobre los riesgos y beneficios de la inteligencia artificial durante la visita del presidente chino, Xi Jinping, a Washington la semana pasada, pero persisten las tensiones subyacentes en la relación. Los beneficios de las empresas industriales chinas en agosto aumentaron un 4,2% con respecto al año anterior, por debajo del 11,2% registrado en julio, mientras que en los primeros ocho meses del año aumentaron un 15,7%, lo que supone una desaceleración respecto al 17,6% registrado en el periodo de enero a julio, según datos de la Oficina Nacional de Estadística publicados el lunes. Los beneficios en la fabricación de equipos informáticos, de comunicaciones y otros equipos electrónicos lideraron las ganancias, con un aumento del 110% en los primeros ocho meses, según un desglose de los datos de la Oficina Nacional de Estadística. Por el contrario, la industria de fabricación de vinos, bebidas y té refinado se situó entre las que obtuvieron peores resultados, con una caída de los beneficios del 34,7%. "De cara al futuro, impulsar los ingresos y el consumo de los hogares y ampliar la demanda interna será crucial para mantener un crecimiento constante de los beneficios de las empresas industriales", dijo Ding Meng, economista jefe de China CITIC Bank International. Este mes, un asesor del banco central advirtió de que la inteligencia artificial podría agravar y prolongar el desequilibrio existente en China entre una oferta sólida y una demanda moderada, lo que reforzó los llamamientos a adoptar medidas para impulsar el gasto de los consumidores y fortalecer los balances en toda la economía. Las cifras de beneficios industriales incluyen a las empresas con unos ingresos anuales de al menos 20 millones de yuanes (2,98 millones de dólares) procedentes de sus actividades principales. (1 dólar = 6,7002 yuanes chinos)

item.title: China dice que la prórroga de la tregua comercial con EEUU permitirá avanzar en las negociaciones
item.description: China dijo el lunes que una prórroga de dos meses de la tregua comercial con Estados Unidos daría margen a ambas partes para evaluar la aplicación de su acuerdo destinado a resolver las cuestiones económicas y comerciales, mientras considera cómo avanzar en esos frentes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China dijo el lunes que una prórroga de dos meses de la tregua comercial con Estados Unidos daría margen a ambas partes para evaluar la aplicación de su acuerdo destinado a resolver las cuestiones económicas y comerciales, mientras considera cómo avanzar en esos frentes. Al confirmar la prórroga hasta el 10 de enero, el Ministerio de Comercio de China señaló que esta también proporciona un "entorno de políticas relativamente estable y predecible" para la cooperación entre empresas y la continuación de las conversaciones activas. La prórroga fue uno de los principales resultados de la segunda cumbre de este año entre el presidente Xi Jinping y el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, celebrada en Washington la semana pasada. Entre las primeras medidas que se adoptarán en el marco del consejo comercial que ambas partes han acordado crear, figura el debate sobre una reducción recíproca de los aranceles sobre productos por valor de 30.000 millones de dólares, con el objetivo de mantener unas relaciones económicas y comerciales bilaterales estables. Esto también crearía mejores condiciones para la exportación de productos chinos relacionados a Estados Unidos, señaló el ministerio en su comunicado. Los equipos económicos y comerciales de ambas partes mantendrán conversaciones periódicas centradas en las posibles oportunidades y barreras de inversión, en la mejora de la transparencia y la previsibilidad de las políticas, y en dar respuesta a las preocupaciones razonables de las empresas, dijo. Una lista publicada por la Casa Blanca reveló que China tenía previsto reducir los aranceles sobre diversos productos agrícolas estadounidenses y otras categorías, entre las que se incluyen equipos médicos, materias primas y productos alimenticios. AGRICULTURA Y CARBÓN Según el comunicado de la Casa Blanca, las reducciones arancelarias propuestas por China para los 30.000 millones de dólares en mercancías se centran principalmente en productos agrícolas, como el maíz, el trigo, los lácteos y la carne, [USN:L6N45K09T TEXT:"pero no la soja"]. La selección de productos parece diseñada para ayudar a China a cumplir lo que, según la Casa Blanca, es un compromiso de 17.000 millones de dólares para la compra de productos agrícolas. China ya ha reanudado la compra a gran escala de soja estadounidense en el marco de un acuerdo alcanzado el año pasado para adquirir 25 millones de toneladas métricas al año. Ambos países crearán un grupo de trabajo sobre agricultura en el marco del consejo comercial, que celebrará su primera reunión antes de que termine el año para debatir el acceso recíproco al mercado y la regulación de los productos agrícolas, informó el Ministerio de Comercio de China. La cumbre presidencial también dio lugar a un acuerdo para que China importe 10 millones de toneladas métricas de carbón al año desde Estados Unidos en 2027 y 2028, según se desprende del comunicado de la Casa Blanca. Esa cantidad equivale aproximadamente al 2% de las importaciones anuales de carbón de China. El gas natural licuado y el petróleo no figuraban en la lista. "La importación de carbón estadounidense no solo supone un complemento beneficioso para el mercado nacional del carbón de China, sino que también aporta ingresos económicos estables y empleo al sector del carbón de Estados Unidos", dijo el ministerio chino. IA, EMPRESAS FINANCIERAS Y VUELOS DIRECTOS En materia de inteligencia artificial, ambas partes han acordado un canal de comunicación para incidentes y mantendrán un diálogo de seguimiento antes de diciembre. China también examinará y aprobará a entidades de servicios financieros extranjeras, incluidas aquellas con capital estadounidense, para que operen y abran sucursales en China. Asimismo, se mantendrá la comunicación sobre el aumento de los vuelos entre China y Estados Unidos, según el comunicado del ministerio.
