item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ブバネシュワル（インド） ２４日 ロイター] - インドで、学校の周辺５０メートル圏内における高脂質・高糖質食品の販売制限に向けた動きが進んでいる。 子どもの肥満が深刻化する中、ジャンクフードの消費を抑える狙いがある。

この規則により、インド国内の学校１５０万校の近くで、甘い清涼飲料水や塩味のポテトチップスから、脂っこいサモサやピザ、ハンバーガーまで、さまざまな食品を販売する家族経営の商店、レストラン、屋台が影響を受けることになる。

ペプシコやコカ・コーラ、モンデリーズ、ネスレといった多国籍企業にとっては、さらなる足かせとなりそうだ。各社はすでに脂質、塩分、糖質の多い「ＨＦＳＳ食品」（High in Fat, Salt and Sugar）に赤い警告ラベルを付ける規制案への対応を迫られている。より厳しい食品安全規制を導入しているチリやメキシコに、インドも足並みをそろえる形だ。

学校周辺の国内企業や食料品店のオーナーの中には、すでに不安を抱いている人もいる。東部のブバネシュワル市で事業を営む十数人の店主が、売上が３分の１以上減少する可能性があると述べた。

ある店では１５歳のプリヤンシュ・パレイさんが、ペプシコの人気ポテトチップス「アンクル・チップス」を２袋買い、リュックサックに入れて登校していった。「休み時間に食べる」と言い、母親が用意したご飯とレンズ豆のシチューの弁当よりも、このスナックを好んでいた。

インドが断ち切りたいのは、まさにこうした習慣だ。

改革を主導するインド食品安全基準局のラジット・プナニ局長によれば、学校で「安全な食品」を提供するこの計画は、子供らを早い段階で不健康な習慣から遠ざけることが目的だという。

同局長は「子供らによるこうした食品の摂取を抑えなければならない。こうした食品を避ける習慣を身につけさせる必要がある」と主張。「企業に大きな影響を与えることはないだろう。ＨＦＳＳ食品でなければ販売できるのだから」とも述べ、規制によって企業に商品の成分を見直すよう促し、より健康的な商品への転換を図るのが狙いだと説明した。

２０２０年に初めて提出されたこの規制案について、具体的な施行時期は決まっていない。全国的な食品安全対策の強化が進む中、当局は８月に、学校周辺や校内での販売を制限する脂肪、塩分、糖分の含有量に関する基準値を公表。１０月６日までパブリックコメントを募集している。

＜子供の肥満が急増＞

インドでは近年、レイズのポテトチップスからキャドバリーのチョコレート、マギーの麺類まで、様々な外国製品の人気が高まっている。低所得層の国民の中には、外国ブランドの商品を購入することを生活水準向上の象徴と捉える人もおり、同時に価格の安さにも魅力を感じている。２３年には、ドミノ・ピザがインドで世界最安値のピザを発売し、わずか４９ルピー（約８１円）で販売した。

食生活の変化に伴い、５―１９歳の肥満または過体重とみなされる子供の数も増加している。世界肥満連盟のデータによると、１５年の２８００万人から２５年には約５０％増の４１００万人に達し、４０年には５６００万人に増える見通しだ。

インドの連邦法が学校付近の店舗に対し、児童生徒へのＨＦＳＳ製品の販売および広告のみを禁止することを目的としているのに対し、ムンバイのある西部マハラシュトラ州はより厳格な対応を取っている。州食品安全委員のトゥカラム・ムンデ氏によると、学校から５０メートル以内の店舗では該当商品の取り扱い自体が一切禁止される。

「学校周辺にはこうした店が何百軒もある。児童生徒に販売しているかどうかを、どう監視するのか。店側はこういった商品を棚に置くことすらできなくなる」とムンデ氏は述べた。

ロイターが入手した同州のデータによると、これまでに学校から５０メートル以内の１３３の店舗で違反が発覚し、そのうち５１店舗が営業停止を命じられた。

＜業界の苦境＞

機密扱いの意見書草案によると、インド食品貿易産業連盟は、多くの学校が一般市民向けの混み合う市場の近くにあるため、規制順守は困難だとの懸念を表明した。同連盟は問い合わせに対し回答していない。

文書は、規制によって「商売が成り立たなくなり、生活が脅かされる」と懸念を示し、制限は校内のみに適用されるべきだと主張している。

「レイズ」ブランドを展開するペプシコは取材に対し、校内での販売を制限する世界共通の社内規定があると説明した。即席麺「マギー」を製造するネスレは、自社の世界基準に基づき、一定の栄養条件を満たす製品に限って小中学校で販売していると回答した。

コカ・コーラと、キャドバリーの親会社であるモンデリーズは、ロイターの問い合わせに回答しなかった。

インドの法律事務所ＲＡＫＬａｗで食品規制を専門とするラフル・カンナ氏は、クライアント、特に子供を「重要な顧客層」とする菓子メーカーの間で「懸念の波」が広がっていると述べた。具体的な企業名は明らかにしなかった。

米ノースカロライナ大学の研究者によると、世界中で５カ国が学校周辺での販売制限を提案または実施しており、校内でのジャンクフード販売を規制している国は４８カ国に及ぶという。

１６年に警告ラベルの義務化に踏み切ったチリでは、校内でのジャンクフードの販売や宣伝も禁止された。今年発表された医学誌「ランセット」の論文によると、規制導入から１年半で女児の肥満率が２．８５％ポイント、男児は２．４％ポイント低下したという。

この規制を受け、メーカー側はチリ国内で扱う多くの製品について成分の見直しを迫られた。

同国のアドルフォ・イバニェス・ビジネススクールのギレルモ・パラヘ教授はこう指摘した。「もしこの法律に効果がなく、消費者の買い方も変わらないのなら、メーカーがここまで反発するわけがない。法律ができれば、嫌でも成分の変更を迫られることは目に見えているからだ」

item.title: Miles de personas se refugian en Bangkok tras las graves inundaciones en Tailandia
item.description: Miles de personas se refugiaban el lunes en centros de evacuación de la capital tailandesa, de la que algunas zonas seguían inundadas tras los estragos causados por las intensas lluvias del fin de semana, mientras que el desbordamiento de los embalses en una provincia del este provocó que se ordenara a más personas abandonar sus hogares.
item.dc:creator: Napat Wesshasartar, Panarat Thepgumpanat
item.content:encoded: Miles de personas se refugiaban el lunes en centros de evacuación de la capital tailandesa, de la que algunas zonas seguían inundadas tras los estragos causados por las intensas lluvias del fin de semana, mientras que el desbordamiento de los embalses en una provincia del este provocó que se ordenara a más personas abandonar sus hogares. Barrios enteros quedaron inundados y la red de alcantarillado se desbordó tras caer 320 milímetros de lluvia durante dos o tres días la semana pasada, una cantidad casi igual a la que suele recibir esta extensa ciudad de baja altitud en todo el mes de septiembre. "Más de 80.000 residentes que viven en zonas inundadas no pueden abandonar sus hogares", dijo Unsit Sampuntharat, secretario permanente del Ministerio del Interior, en un comunicado, que añadió que se estaban movilizando cocinas móviles y embarcaciones para las labores de socorro. "El objetivo es proporcionar tres comidas al día a todos los residentes durante todo el período de inundaciones y durante al menos otros siete días después de que bajen las aguas", añadió, mientras seguían produciéndose chubascos intermitentes el lunes. AL MENOS OCHO MUERTOS Y MÁS DE 580.000 HOGARES AFECTADOS Bangkok es una de las 41 provincias de Tailandia afectadas por las inundaciones desde el 16 de septiembre, que han causado la muerte de al menos ocho personas y han afectado a más de 580.000 hogares, informó el ministerio. Las inundaciones podrían causar un perjuicio económico de al menos 11.000 millones de baht (327 millones de dólares) en todo el país, y es probable que las pérdidas aumenten a menos que la situación mejore, dijo Aat Pisanwanich, del departamento de Economía de la Universidad de Rangsit. "Se prevé que las inundaciones reduzcan en 0,3 puntos porcentuales el crecimiento del PIB de este año, situándolo en el 2,1%, y que recorten el crecimiento del tercer trimestre en unos 0,5 puntos porcentuales, hasta el 1,7%", dijo a Reuters. La segunda economía más grande del sudeste asiático, que se ha quedado rezagada respecto a sus homólogas regionales desde la pandemia de COVID-19, creció un 1,9% interanual en el segundo trimestre del año, aunque esta cifra supone un fuerte descenso con respecto al crecimiento del 2,8% registrado en el trimestre anterior. Es probable que Bangkok y la región oriental sean las más afectadas, sobre todo el comercio mayorista y minorista, mientras que la industria y la agricultura se verán perjudicadas en el resto del país, añadió Aat. (1 dólar = 33,5800 baht)

item.title: France's Hollande says may run in 2027 if victory looks attainable, paper says
item.description: Former French Socialist President Francois Hollande may decide to run for president in 2027, but only if he sees a real chance of winning, he told Italian daily la Repubblica on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former French Socialist President Francois Hollande may decide to run for president in 2027, but only if he sees a real chance of winning, he told Italian daily la Repubblica on Monday. "Running for the presidency is not a decision to be taken lightly, all the more so for a former head of state like myself," Holland said in the interview. He added he would consider running only under exceptional circumstances and only if there was a realistic chance of reaching the runoff and ultimately win. Hollande, 72, was France's president from 2012 to 2017. The French presidential election will be held in the spring of 2027. French far-right leader Marine Le Pen maintained her lead for the first-round of the presidential election and far-left rival Jean-Luc Melenchon was second in most tested scenarios, [USN:L1N45507C TEXT:"according to a poll"] released two weeks ago. Macron’s former Prime Minister Édouard Philippe is the only centre-right candidate to come ahead of Mélenchon in one of the scenarios tested, and to tie with him in another. The other candidates would finish behind Mélenchon in all scenarios. "The France of 2027 bears little resemblance to the one I governed. We are facing a more threatening, more dangerous and harsher world, and a European continent that has become a target for powers such as the United States, China and Russia. Europe is confronting an existential crisis," former president Hollande also said.

item.title: Temasek acquisisce 9% di Fsi e si impegna in futuri investimenti
item.description: Temasek, fondo sovrano di Singapore, ha acquisito una quota del 9% nella società di investimento italiana Fsi, impegnandosi a stanziare ulteriori capitali per investimenti futuri.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Temasek, fondo sovrano di Singapore, ha acquisito una quota del 9% nella società di investimento italiana Fsi, impegnandosi a stanziare ulteriori capitali per investimenti futuri. Lo hanno detto oggi le due società in un comunicato congiunto. L'operazione rafforza la presenza di Temasek in Italia e consolida la partnership con Fsi, che gestisce circa 5 miliardi di euro con un focus sulle medie imprese italiane. Temasek sta intensificando il proprio impegno in Europa, Medio Oriente e Africa, con l’obiettivo di investire da 14 a 17 miliardi di euro nella regione entro il 2029 e, nei due esercizi finanziari chiusi al 31 marzo 2026, ha già destinato alla regione circa 13 miliardi di euro. L’investitore di Singapore, che gestisce un portafoglio da 518 miliardi di dollari singaporiani (406 miliardi di dollari), è presente in Italia da oltre dieci anni, con partecipazioni in società quali i gruppi del lusso Ermenegildo Zegna , Golden Goose e Moncler (MONC.MI) . Temasek aveva già investito in fondi di Fsi. Secondo quanto precisato da Fsi, Temasek parteciperà anche a futuri veicoli di investimento, compresi quelli dedicati alle piccole e medie imprese italiane ad alta crescita. I termini finanziari dell'operazione non sono stati resi noti. (1 dollaro = 1,2772 dollari di Singapore) (1 dollaro = 0,8779 euro)

item.title: From pickups to idle plants: automakers seek lifeline from defence boom
item.description: Western automakers are chasing a defence spending boom as a way to sell more vehicles and make use of underemployed factories, though executives say military work will not make up for slowing car sales and growing Chinese competition.
item.dc:creator: Nick Carey, Gilles Guillaume, Kalea Hall
item.content:encoded: Western automakers are chasing a defence spending boom as a way to sell more vehicles and make use of underemployed factories, though executives say military work will not make up for slowing car sales and growing Chinese competition. Automakers including Ford (F.N) , General Motors (GM.N) and Jaguar Land Rover are bidding for military contracts using modified versions of pickup trucks and off-road vehicles they already produce, while others are selling underused plants to defence manufacturers expanding capacity. The industry is tapping into rising Western defence spending, but executives and analysts told Reuters the opportunities to materially boost revenue remain limited. "In reality all of these opportunities will have very little financial impact," said Jefferies auto analyst Vanessa Jeffriess, adding that automakers face slowing demand and intensifying competition from Chinese rivals, putting them under pressure to at least show investors they are trying to diversify. GM, the biggest US automaker, expects its defence division to generate revenue of $700 million this year and grow by 30% annually for several years. But that would put revenue at about $1.5 billion in 2029, less than 1% of group revenue of $185 billion in 2025. Traditional US and European automakers are losing market share in China to home-grown rivals like BYD (002594.SZ) and Geely (GEELY.UL), while Chinese brands are expanding rapidly into Europe and emerging markets to offset weak domestic demand, squeezing profit margins and leaving Western manufacturers with excess capacity. Most major automakers ditched military contracts decades ago, but as governments from Europe to North America ramp up military spending, defence has emerged as one of the few growth sectors for the industry. ALREADY PRODUCING AT SCALE Analysts see the most realistic opportunities in assets that automakers already have. Ford's European head Jim Baumbick said providing the military with vehicles fits with the company's existing strengths of providing "tough vehicles with high payloads". Ford, GM and Britain's JLR are among companies bidding for a £900 million ($1.2 billion) UK Ministry of Defence vehicle contract, initially for 3,000 vehicles, using modified versions of trucks and off-road vehicles they already make. Ford is bidding with its Ranger pickup truck, while two models in GM's bid are retrofitted Chevrolet Silverado pickup trucks which will be modified for UK military use. JLR, a unit of India's Tata Motors (TAMO.NS) , is bidding with its off-road Defender model, and all are betting that decades of engineering, manufacturing scale and global supply chains can give them the edge over specialist defence firms. "They're such capable trucks from the beginning, that's not a heavy lift," said Gilbert Nelson, GM Defense's vice president for international sales and marketing, referring to the modifications required for military use. JLR North America CEO and former head of the Defender brand Mark Cameron said the automaker has also had discussions "with lots of countries across Europe... and further afield" about similar tenders due in the next 12 to 18 months. Cameron said using a vehicle JLR already makes at scale was "strategically valuable" though the company was not dependent on it. FINDING BUYERS FOR FACTORIES Another attractive proposition for the auto industry is being able to offload surplus manufacturing capacity to companies looking to expand production in defence without the cost of building from scratch. Italy's Stellantis (STLAM.MI) is planning to sell an [USN:L6N45312Q TEXT:"idled Canadian factory"] to armoured-vehicle maker Roshel while earlier this month Germany's Volkswagen agreed to sell its [USN:L8N44Z0IN TEXT:"Osnabrueck plant"] to Israel's Aurelius Capital and the German state of Lower Saxony for a project with Rafael Advanced Defense Systems. Analysts said factory disposals rather than diversifying production are one of the clearest benefits from the defence boom. "There's been a lot of talk," about diversifying into defence production, said Ian Henry, director of consultancy AutoAnalysis. "But there's not been a lot of concrete action." Suppliers could also emerge as bigger beneficiaries of rising defence spending. Unlike vehicle assembly plants, their smaller and more flexible production lines can often be adapted to military programmes with limited investment. "Car assembly lines are just not geared for making components," because they are too large, AutoAnalysis' Henry said. For suppliers, the defence industry "drives growth, which the automotive market does not," Christophe Perillat, CEO of French supplier Valeo (VLOF.PA) said in July, adding that military contracts also offered higher profit margins than traditional automotive business. French supplier Forvia (FRVIA.PA) is using its existing production capacity to explore military opportunities, CFO Olivier Durand said. "The industrial investment required is very low... so it's quite an attractive prospect," he said. Forvia also recently signed a deal to transfer a factory in Germany and 300 staff to defence firm General Dynamics (GD.N) . CORE BUSINESS REMAINS VEHICLES Some automakers are pushing further into defence in the US and [USN:L1N4410EJ TEXT:"France"]. Renault (RENA.PA) plans to produce [USN:L6N42O105 TEXT:"1,000 military drones"] per month starting next year with French defence technology firm Thales (TCFP.PA) , though executives acknowledge the scale is small compared with its automotive operations. Oddo BHF auto analyst Michael Foundoukidis said Renault makes about 10,000 vehicles a day. JLR, which makes over 100,000 Defenders a year, is avoiding branching out and competing with specialist companies. JLR's Cameron said automakers would face formidable competition in unfamiliar sectors. "Our core business is vehicles," he said. "We don't want to stray into any offshoots." ($1 = 0.7413 pounds)

item.title: China in Focus as Cambodia Targets Scam ‘Masterminds’ Amid Crackdown Questions
item.description: By Poppy McPherson Cambodia is gathering evidence against suspected “masterminds” of massive cyber fraud operations, the country’s anti-scam minister said, amid criticism that the government’s crackdown has failed to reach those ultimately responsible. Legal action, “whether it involves the mastermind, the co-conspirator, owner, enabler or …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
By Poppy McPherson

Cambodia is gathering evidence against suspected “masterminds” of massive cyber fraud operations, the country’s anti-scam minister said, amid criticism that the government’s crackdown has failed to reach those ultimately responsible.

Legal action, “whether it involves the mastermind, the co-conspirator, owner, enabler or protector, it requires time and also it requires evidence,” Chhay Sinarith, who heads a government commission on combating fraud, told Reuters on the sidelines of a global anti-scam conference in the capital Phnom Penh on Thursday.

“That’s why it is of utmost importance for us to cooperate,” he said, adding that information given by international partners had enabled action against some suspects and that premature disclosure of investigations could cause suspects to flee.

Cambodia this week hosted representatives of more than a dozen countries — including the U.S. and China — at the conference, for discussions about tackling an industry that has tarnished the country’s reputation and damaged its economy.

Cambodia and other Southeast Asian nations emerged after the pandemic as hubs for industrial-sized scam centers where workers are trafficked, detained in grim conditions and forced to defraud strangers online. The U.S. said scam compounds in the region stole $10 billion from Americans alone in 2024.

Chhay declared last month that Cambodia had eradicated large-scale scam compounds since it began a year-long crackdown, though it has not provided a full list of the sites it has raided. Analysts have been skeptical, saying that the operation has left high-level figures and protectors of the industry unscathed.

“It’s clear that many large compounds remain active despite other operators clearing out and dispersing into smaller, decentralized sites,” said John Wojcik, a senior analyst at blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs. “The technology, payment rails, money-laundering networks and facilitators underpinning the industry also continue to operate at scale.”

Chhay said authorities are expanding their investigation into the financial network of Prince Group, a Cambodia-based conglomerate the U.S. alleges was a front for multi-billion-dollar online fraud and money laundering operations.

Its Chinese-born founder, Chen Zhi, was arrested and deported to China from Cambodia earlier this year.

Reporters toured two facilities outside of Phnom Penh that Cambodian authorities said were scam centers belonging to Prince Group – vast complexes that officials said housed thousands of workers. One had a fake Singaporean police station allegedly used for impersonation fraud.

A Prince Group spokesperson said the facilities “have not been and never were associated with” the company.

item.title: 日経平均は6日ぶり反落、連騰の反動で 一時6万7000円回復
item.description:
Hiroko Hamada
[東京 ２８日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は６営業日ぶりに反落し、前営業日比０...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は6日ぶり反落、連騰の反動で　一時6万7000円回復 16:02 配信

写真は2024年12月、都内の東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ２８日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は６営業日ぶりに反落し、前営業日比０．７３％（４８６円５８銭）安の６万５８７７円６２銭で取引を終えた。前週末の米市場でＡＩ（人工知能）関連株が上昇したことが支えとなり、日経平均は朝方しっかりと推移。一時、節目の６万７０００円を回復した。ただ、急ピッチで上昇したことや連騰の反動で次第に売りが優勢となり、安値引けとなった。

日経平均は前営業日比０．２１％高でスタートした後、上げ幅を拡大し、一時１．０１％（６７０円）高の６万７０３４円７４銭まで上昇。約１カ月半ぶりに節目の６万７０００円を回復した。中間配当取りの動きも相場を支えた。ただ、達成感も生じ日経平均は次第にマイナスに転じた。後場は方向感の乏しい展開が続いたが、大引けにかけてはやや下げ幅を広げた。物色面では、国内金利の先高観を背景に地銀株が堅調だった。

今週は米半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーの決算に注目が集まる。市場では「マイクロンの決算が良好で半導体株が買われれば、相場の流れが変わる可能性もあるが、それまでは積極的に動きづらい」（岡三証券のシニアストラテジスト・大下莉奈氏）との声が聞かれた。

また、国内金利が上昇する中でも相場が崩れる展開にはなっておらず、「地合いが悪いわけではなさそうだ」（大下氏）との指摘もあった。

ＴＯＰＩＸは０．４％安の４１１２．００ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比０．４４％安の２１２０．６０ポイントだった。プライム市場の売買代金は８兆２０２８億５０００万円だった。東証３３業種では、保険、銀行、電気・ガスなど４業種が値上がり。医薬品、パルプ・紙、鉱業など２９業種は値下がりした。

新興株式市場は、東証グロース市場２５０指数が３日続落し、１．１３％安の７９１．４７ポイントだった。

個別では、ニデックがストップ安。ダイヤモンドオンラインが２８日付で、ニデックが２５日に開いた臨時取締役会で、岸田光哉社長の解任を決議していたことがわかったと報じ、嫌気された。

前週買われていたイビデンは４％超安。キオクシアホールディングスも軟調だった。一方、寄与度の大きいソフトバンクグループはしっかり。リクルートホールディングスも買われた。

プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がり４６８銘柄（３０％）に対し、値下がりが１０３９銘柄（６６％）、変わらずが４６銘柄（２％）だった。

item.title: What comes next for North Korea soldiers transferred from Ukraine to South Korea?
item.description: Two North Korean soldiers captured while fighting for Russia against Ukraine are now in South Korea, raising questions over how they will be investigated, protected and resettled, and the legal basis for their transfer.
item.dc:creator: Kyu-Seok Shim, Hyun Yi
item.content:encoded: Two North Korean soldiers captured while fighting for Russia against Ukraine are now in South Korea, raising questions over how they will be investigated, protected and resettled, and the legal basis for their transfer. Here is what could happen next: WHAT PROCESS WILL THE SOLDIERS UNDERGO? The soldiers are expected to undergo questioning and security screening before the South Korean authorities decide whether to grant them protection and begin the resettlement process. Seoul's Unification Ministry said on Monday their cases would be reviewed under relevant laws and past practices, suggesting that the North Korean Defectors Protection and Settlement Support Act would apply. Under the law, the National Intelligence Service (NIS) investigates applicants in temporary protective custody, verifying their identities, reasons for leaving North Korea and security-related matters. The investigation and temporary protection may last up to 90 days, with a possible extension in unavoidable circumstances. The soldiers’ military backgrounds and firsthand knowledge of North Korea’s deployment to Russia could result in more extensive debriefing. Those granted protection usually receive resettlement training before entering South Korean society. Yu Yong-weon, an opposition lawmaker who met the soldiers in Ukraine in February 2025, said they had served in North Korean special forces and could provide information on Pyongyang's training, military capabilities and participation in the war. WHO DECIDES WHETHER THEY RECEIVE PROTECTION? The unification minister normally determines whether a North Korean arrival qualifies for protection, although the NIS director can make the decision on national security grounds. Yu told Reuters the sensitivity of the case could also keep them out of public view longer than other North Korean arrivals. Their physical and psychological condition is also likely to be assessed. Yu said when he met them they were being held separately at a Ukrainian detention facility and the prolonged isolation and uncertainty may have affected their mental health. DID UKRAINE HAVE THE RIGHT TO TRANSFER THEM? The Third Geneva Convention requires prisoners of war to be released and repatriated without delay after active hostilities end. That does not necessarily prohibit earlier release or transfer to a third country. South Korea and Ukraine have not disclosed the legal basis for their transfer, including whether it formally ends the soldiers’ POW status. Peter Ward, a research fellow at the Sejong Institute, said repatriation was a basic principle governing POWs but should not apply where it could damage their welfare or human rights. "There is ample basis under humanitarian and human rights law for these POWs to be transferred to a third country of their choice so long as that third country of their choice is prepared to take them," Ward said. Lee Shin-wha, a Korea University professor and former envoy for North Korean human rights, said the transfer could still generate legal and diplomatic friction because international law treats North Korea as a separate state, while South Korea considers North Koreans as its citizens. Their stated wish to come to the South and the risks they could face in the North provide grounds for accepting them, she said. COULD THEY HAVE BEEN RETURNED TO NORTH KOREA? International human rights law would weigh against returning the soldiers if they faced a real risk of torture, persecution or other serious mistreatment. The principle of non-refoulement prohibits sending people to a country where they face such risks. Lee said repatriation was the general rule for POWs, but international practice also recognised voluntary repatriation and barred returns that could lead to persecution or torture. North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has praised soldiers who committed suicide while fighting against Ukrainian forces in Russia's Kursk region where the pair were captured. The two men repeatedly expressed a desire to go to South Korea, including in media interviews and during a meeting with Yu. Ward said North Korea had little basis under international law to demand their return. HOW HAS SOUTH KOREA RESPONDED TO THE UKRAINE WAR? South Korea, which is a major arms producer, has faced pressure from some Western countries and Kyiv to provide Ukraine with lethal weapons but has so far focused on non-lethal aid including demining equipment. President Lee Jae Myung announced a $100 million support package for Ukraine at a NATO summit in July, while his government reiterated that lethal weapons were excluded. Seoul also pledged continued humanitarian assistance and support for reconstruction. At their July summit, Lee and Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy agreed that the North Korean POW issue should be handled in accordance with the soldiers’ free will, international law and humanitarian principles. WHY DID SOUTH KOREA WANT SECRECY? South Korea demanded an [USN:L6N45J04Q TEXT:"apology from Ukraine"] after Zelenskiy disclosed the transfer at the UN General Assembly last week, saying Kyiv had breached an agreement to keep it confidential. Seoul said confidentiality was necessary to protect the soldiers and relatives in North Korea. Kyiv has said no secrecy agreement existed.

item.title: TotalEnergies augmente ses rachats d'actions du T4 à $2,5 mds
item.description: TotalEnergies a annoncé lundi prévoir de racheter 2,5 milliards de dollars (2,20 milliards d'euros) de ses actions au quatrième trimestre 2026 et entre 2,0 et 2,5 milliards au premier trimestre 2027, le groupe présentant sa stratégie et ses perspectives 2026 à l'occasion d'une journée des investisseurs à New York.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) a annoncé lundi prévoir de racheter 2,5 milliards de dollars (2,20 milliards d'euros) de ses actions au quatrième trimestre 2026 et entre 2,0 et 2,5 milliards au premier trimestre 2027, le groupe présentant sa stratégie et ses perspectives 2026 à l'occasion d'une journée des investisseurs à New York. Le géant pétrolier et gazier, a annoncé prévoir d'une croissance de la production d'énergie de 4% par an à l'horizon 2030, ainsi qu'une hausse du free cash-flow de 10 milliards de dollars entre 2025 et 2030 à même environnement de prix. Le groupe entend maintenir un plateau de production autour de trois millions de barils équivalents par jour jusqu'en 2035, soutenu par son portefeuille de projets organiques, notamment en [USN:FWN3Z11X9 TEXT:"Namibie"], [USN:FWN45E13Y TEXT:"Nigeria"], [USN:FWN3YO1FQ TEXT:"Libye"] ou encore en [USN:FWN4340BB TEXT:"Malaisie"], et des réserves prouvées de plus de 12 ans. TotalEnergies a par ailleurs confirmé ses objectifs de croissance 2030 des productions de pétrole, de gaz et d'électricité et de free cash-flow.

item.title: Indonesia central bank reduces FX intervention in spot market, governor says
item.description: Indonesia's central bank has reduced its foreign exchange interventions in the spot market to 30% of the total because it was too costly, its governor Destry Damayanti said in a parliamentary hearing on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indonesia's central bank has reduced its foreign exchange interventions in the spot market to 30% of the total because it was too costly, its governor Destry Damayanti said in a parliamentary hearing on Monday. "We have significantly reduced costly interventions - these costly interventions are those conducted via the spot market, which now account for only about 30% of our total interventions," Destry said. Currency interventions via the non-deliverable forwards market have proven to be more effective and reduce the need to tap FX reserves, Destry added. The governor also said investment in the real sector needs to increase as well to help stabilise the rupiah. The rupiah, which has been under pressure as a result of investor concerns about fiscal risks in Indonesia, has been [USN:L6N45K0B2 TEXT:"Asia's worst-performing currency"] so far this year, declining by around 7%.

item.title: Hugo-Boss-Finanzvorstand geht nach Frasers-Aufstockung
item.description: Nach der Machtübernahme durch das britische Textil-Konglomerat Frasers nimmt der Finanzvorstand des Modekonzerns Hugo Boss den Hut. Yves Müller, der vor knapp neun Jahren von Tchibo zu Hugo Boss gekommen war, habe sein Vorstandsmandat aus persönlichen Gründen niedergelegt, teilte das Unternehmen am Montag in Metzingen mit. Müller war seit 2022 auch für das operative Geschäft mit den Bereichen IT, Logistik, Produktion und Beschaffung sowie den Einkauf zuständig. Für zehn Monate war er 2020/21 Sprecher des Vorstands. Sein Nachfolger, der zum 1. Oktober übernimmt, kommt aus der zweiten Reihe: Ivica Maric arbeitet seit 2005 für Hugo Boss, zumeist im Controlling und Rechnungswesen. Seit 2023 ist er Executive Vice President Business Operations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nach der Machtübernahme durch das britische Textil-Konglomerat Frasers (FRAS.L) nimmt der Finanzvorstand des Modekonzerns Hugo Boss (BOSSn.DE) den Hut. Yves Müller, der vor knapp neun Jahren von Tchibo zu Hugo Boss gekommen war, habe sein Vorstandsmandat aus persönlichen Gründen niedergelegt, teilte das Unternehmen am Montag in Metzingen mit. Müller war seit 2022 auch für das operative Geschäft mit den Bereichen IT, Logistik, Produktion und Beschaffung sowie den Einkauf zuständig. Für zehn Monate war er 2020/21 Sprecher des Vorstands. Sein Nachfolger, der zum 1. Oktober übernimmt, kommt aus der zweiten Reihe: Ivica Maric arbeitet seit 2005 für Hugo Boss, zumeist im Controlling und Rechnungswesen. Seit 2023 ist er Executive Vice President Business Operations. Der vom Milliardär Mike Ashley kontrollierte Frasers-Konzern (Sports Direct, Debenhams) hatte die Beteiligung an dem Herren- und Damenausstatter mit einem Übernahmeangebot auf 48 Prozent ausgebaut und greift nach der Mehrheit. Seit Mitte September ist Frasers-Chef Michael Murray auch Vorsitzender des Aufsichtsrats von Hugo Boss.

item.title: Tullow Oil swings to positive free cash flow as Ghana output, higher oil prices drive growth
item.description: West Africa-focused Tullow Oil reported a sharp improvement in first-half free cash flow on Monday, driven by strong output from its Ghana fields, stronger-than-expected new-well performance and higher oil prices stemming from the Iran war.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: West Africa-focused Tullow Oil (TLW.L) reported a sharp improvement in first-half free cash flow on Monday, driven by strong output from its Ghana fields, stronger-than-expected new-well performance and higher oil prices stemming from the Iran war. Here are details: Tullow's free cash flow swung to $4 million for the first half ended June 30 from negative $188 million a year earlier. London-listed producer posted revenue of $496 million, up from $411 million a year earlier, as realised oil price before hedging rose to $95.0 per barrel from $71.4 per barrel. Tullow reiterated that full-year production is expected at the top end of its guidance range of 34,000 to 42,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day, after working interest production averaged 43.7 kboepd in the first half. Peel Hunt analysts said Tullow's Ghana assets outperformed their expectations, supported by successful drilling results and strong uptime. Tullow has spent the past year reshaping itself around Ghana, selling non-core assets in Gabon and Kenya, refinancing its debt and securing licence extensions for its flagship Jubilee and TEN fields until 2040.

item.title: ＮＺ緑の党、支持率が過去最高の16％ 2大政党は28％に低下
item.description: [２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２８日 ロイター] - ニュージーランドで２８日公表された世論調査によると、緑の党の支持率が過去最高の１６％に上昇した。１１月７日の総選挙を前に、国民党と労働党はいずれも２８％に低下した。

１Ｎｅｗｓ／ベリアンの調査では、労働党、緑の党、マオリ党、オポチュニティ党の獲得議席は計６５となり、左派寄りの連立政権を樹立できる可能性がある。一方、国民党、ＡＣＴ党、ニュージーランド・ファースト党は計５９議席となる見込みだ。

労働党の支持率は８月から２ポイント低下し、２０２４年２月以来の低水準となった。国民党の支持率は２１年以来の低水準だった。

調査は２３─２７日に有権者１００４人を対象に実施した。１３％は投票先を決めていないか、回答を控えた。

item.title: Belgium's Agfa to merge digital printing unit with Siris’ EFI
item.description: Belgian imaging and IT firm Agfa will combine its digital printing unit with Siris' industrial inkjet maker EFI to form a jointly owned global business, the companies said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Belgian imaging and IT firm Agfa (AGFB.BR) will combine its digital printing unit with Siris' industrial inkjet maker EFI to form a jointly owned global business, the companies said on Monday. Investment firm Siris, which owns EFI, will hold a 60% stake in the joint venture, while Agfa will hold the remaining 40% under an equal partnership governance structure. Siris will buy a 19.1% stake in Agfa from Active Ownership, Agfa's largest shareholder The venture will merge EFI's packaging and textile printers with Agfa's display graphics and decor applications The combined business is expected to generate around €540 million ($615 million) in pro forma revenue in 2026 The deal is expected to close by the end of 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions ($1 = 0.8787 euros)

item.title: Konjunktur- und Zinsängste belasten Börsen in Asien
item.description: Schwache Konjunkturdaten aus China und Zinsängste nach einem erneuten Ölpreisanstieg haben die Börsen in Asien am Montag belastet. Die Börse Shanghai und der Index der wichtigsten Unternehmen in Shanghai und Shenzhen verloren rund 2,5 und zwei Prozent. Das Gewinnwachstum der chinesischen Industrie hat sich im August wegen einer anhaltend schwachen Binnennachfrage weiter verlangsamt. Während der Boom bei Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) die Gewinne in der Technologiebranche antrieb, haben Unternehmen in anderen Sektoren wegen der Kaufzurückhaltung und Überkapazitäten zunehmend Schwierigkeiten, ihre Preismacht zu behaupten. "Künftig wird es für ein stetiges Gewinnwachstum der Industrieunternehmen entscheidend sein, die Haushaltseinkommen und den Konsum zu steigern sowie die Binnennachfrage auszuweiten", sagte Ding Meng, Chefvolkswirt der China CITIC Bank International.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Schwache Konjunkturdaten aus China und Zinsängste nach einem erneuten Ölpreisanstieg haben die Börsen in Asien am Montag belastet. Die Börse Shanghai (.SSEC) und der Index der wichtigsten Unternehmen in Shanghai und Shenzhen (.CSI300) verloren rund 2,5 und zwei Prozent. Das Gewinnwachstum der chinesischen Industrie hat sich im August wegen einer anhaltend schwachen Binnennachfrage weiter [USN:L6N45K04C TEXT:"verlangsamt"]. Während der Boom bei Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) die Gewinne in der Technologiebranche antrieb, haben Unternehmen in anderen Sektoren wegen der Kaufzurückhaltung und Überkapazitäten zunehmend Schwierigkeiten, ihre Preismacht zu behaupten. "Künftig wird es für ein stetiges Gewinnwachstum der Industrieunternehmen entscheidend sein, die Haushaltseinkommen und den Konsum zu steigern sowie die Binnennachfrage auszuweiten", sagte Ding Meng, Chefvolkswirt der China CITIC Bank International. In Japan richtete sich die Aufmerksamkeit auf die Geldpolitik. Aus den Protokollen der jüngsten Sitzung der Bank of Japan (BoJ) ging hervor, dass die Währungshüter angesichts steigender Inflationsrisiken raschere Zinserhöhungen in Betracht ziehen. "Das Tempo der Zinserhöhungen könnte schneller ausfallen als von den Märkten erwartet", erklärte ein Notenbanker laut den Mitschriften. Die hartnäckige Schwäche des Yen und die durch den Nahost-Konflikt gestiegenen Importpreise für Energie heizen die Teuerung an. Dies treibt die Anleiherenditen in die Höhe, was weltweit die Finanzierungskosten verteuert und insbesondere zinssensible Technologiewerte belastet, die derzeit Milliarden für den Ausbau der Künstlichen Intelligenz (KI) aufwenden. Der 225 Werte umfassende Nikkei-Index (.N225) gab zum Wochenstart leicht auf 66.255 Punkte nach. Der breiter gefasste Topix (.TOPX) notierte mit 4127 Zählern kaum verändert. item.title: CVC drops Bodycote pursuit, clears path for Veritas' $2.5 billion takeover
item.description: Private equity firm CVC Advisers said on Monday it does not plan to make an offer for Bodycote , abandoning its pursuit of the British thermal processing services group.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Private equity firm CVC Advisers said on Monday it does not plan to make an offer for Bodycote (BOY.L) , abandoning its pursuit of the British thermal processing services group. The decision clears the way for US-based private equity firm [USN:L6N44T0JX TEXT:"Veritas Capital"], which won Bodycote's backing earlier this month for its £1.85 billion ($2.45 billion) takeover offer, including debt. Here are a few details: CVC and Veritas had been vying for the British firm, submitting near-identical proposals in August, just two months after U.S. investment firm [USN:L6N42D0AF TEXT:"Apollo"] (APO.N) retreated from its £1.52 billion approach for Bodycote. Earlier this month, Veritas pulled ahead by sweetening its bid to 940 pence a share, prompting CVC to say it would evaluate its options regarding the deal. Bodycote offers heat-treatment and metal-processing services to the aerospace, defence, automotive and energy sectors. The interest in the company reflected a wider trend of foreign buyers, particularly private equity firms, targeting UK-listed companies, which are argued to be undervalued. ($1 = 0.7557 pounds)

item.title: TotalEnergies raises share buyback targets as fuel prices drive profits
item.description: TotalEnergies said on Monday it was increasing fourth-quarter share buybacks to $2.5 billion, up from $1.5 billion in recent quarters, as high global energy prices boost returns for oil and gas majors.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) said on Monday it was increasing fourth-quarter share buybacks to $2.5 billion, up from $1.5 billion in recent quarters, as high global energy prices boost returns for oil and gas majors. The French company also said it would buy back between $2 billion and $2.5 billion in shares in the first quarter of 2027 and increase its dividend by more than 5% annually through 2030. TotalEnergies' profit has surged this year thanks to higher oil prices, strong trading results and bigger refining margins on the back of the Iran war, with its [USN:L6N43P0HN TEXT:"second-quarter earnings"] at the highest level in nearly three years. The energy major now expects its oil and gas production to grow 2% to 3% annually between 2030 and 2035, supported by its portfolio of projects nearing completion, it said in a statement published ahead of its investor day. Investors have been increasingly scrutinising oil majors' exploration pipelines and the depth of their resource base beyond 2030, as they assess companies' long-term growth prospects. TotalEnergies said in the press release it had a proved reserve life of more than 12 years. It plans net investments of $14 billion to $17 billion per year from 2027 to 2032. That is slightly lower than the annual $15 billion to $17 billion between 2027 and 2030 announced [USN:L5N3VG060 TEXT:"last year"]. TotalEnergies also said it saw a gearing ratio, which measures net debt against equity, below 10% by the end of 2026. Its shares edged 0.7% higher by 0718 GMT, largely in line with the broader index of European energy companies (.SXEP) .

item.title: 英国の街の広場に巨大な花のじゅうたん ダリア30万個で制作
item.description: 英中部ブラッドフォードのセンテナリー・スクエア（百周年記念広場）で24日、花で作られた巨大なアート作品がお目見えした。 ベルギーで1970年代から続く恒例イベント「フラワー・カーペット」が、英国で初めて開催された。 観光サイト「ビジット・ブラッドフォード」の情報によると、地元アーティストのシラーズ・アリ氏がデザインした全長約29メートルの作品には、30万個を超えるダリアの花が使われた。

item.title: ESA taps OVHcloud, CGI to build system for Earth observation data
item.description: OVHcloud and CGI have won a 30-month European Space Agency contract to build computing infrastructure to store and process Europe's Earth observation satellite data, the companies said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Leo Marchandon
item.content:encoded: OVHcloud (OVH.PA) and CGI have won a 30-month European Space Agency contract to build computing infrastructure to store and process Europe's Earth observation satellite data, the companies said on Monday. The award reflects the European Commission's push to steer strategic workloads to European providers and follows a €180 million ($205 million) cloud tender [USN:L6N4100HP TEXT:"handed exclusively"] to four European firms in April. ESA expects to hold more than 500 petabytes of Earth observation data by 2035, the companies said. The new system, called Digital EO, will pool storage, computing power and AI tools for researchers, public bodies and companies, and connect to existing national and European facilities. OVHcloud, Europe's largest cloud provider, will supply the computing, storage and network capacity. CGI, an IT consulting and systems integration firm, will act as architect and integrator. "Europe absolutely must have control over the infrastructure that runs its most strategic programmes," OVHcloud CEO Octave Klaba said in a statement. ESA is racing to upgrade how Europe handles satellite imagery. Earlier in September, it awarded parallel study contracts to teams led by Finland's ICEYE and Italy's Leonardo (LDOF.MI) to design a separate, security-focused Earth observation architecture for EU governments. The system will be deployed in Italy, France and Germany, with support operations run from Poland. It is designed to feed programmes including the European Union's Earth observation programme, Copernicus, and the EU's digital twin of Earth, DestinE. OVHcloud and CGI said the contract had a value of "multi-million" euros. ESA did not disclose a figure. ($1 = €0.8784)

item.title: Temasek buys 9% stake in Italy's FSI, commits to future funds
item.description: Singapore state investor Temasek has bought a 9% minority stake in the management company of Milan-based private equity group FSI and committed additional capital for future investments, the companies said in a joint statement on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Singapore state investor Temasek has bought a 9% minority stake in the management company of Milan-based private equity group FSI and committed additional capital for future investments, the companies said in a joint statement on Monday. The deal deepens Temasek's exposure to Italy and strengthens its partnership with FSI, which manages around €5 billion ($5.7 billion), focusing on Italian mid-sized companies, the statement said. Temasek has been [USN:L8N43P0R7 TEXT:"stepping up investment"] across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. It has [USN:L1N3T70DW TEXT:"a target"] of investing €14 billion to €17 billion in the region by 2029, and had invested about €13 billion in the two financial years to March 31, 2026. The Singapore investor, which manages a [USN:L1N43A07K TEXT:"portfolio"] worth S$518 billion ($406 billion), has been investing in Italy for over ten years and holds interests in companies including luxury groups [USN:L8N3TQ150 TEXT:"Ermenegildo Zegna"] , [USN:L8N3XP1GO TEXT:"Golden Goose"] and Moncler (MONC.MI) . It has also invested in FSI's previous funds. FSI added Temasek would also commit capital to future investment vehicles, including those focused on high-growth small and medium-sized Italian businesses. The statement did not disclose the financial terms of the deal. ($1 = 1.2772 Singapore dollars) ($1 = 0.8779 euros)

item.title: コンゴのエボラ感染者、8000人超 同国史上最悪
item.description: [２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２８日 ロイター] - 中央アフリカのコンゴ民主共和国（旧ザイール）で続くエボラ出血熱の流行で、確認された感染者数が初めて８０００人を超えた。２８日に公表された政府のデータで明らかになった。

公衆衛生研究所の最新の状況報告によると、感染者は８０６７人、死者は３９０１人となった。

今回の流行はエボラウイルスの「ブンディブギョ種」によるもので、感染者数、死者数ともに２０１８─２０年の流行を上回り、同国で過去最悪となった。

世界では１４─１６年の西アフリカでの流行に次ぐ規模となる。当時はギニア、リベリア、シエラレオネで２万８６００人超が感染し、１万１０００人超が死亡した。

item.title: Aldi to invest $1.2 billion in Britain in 2027
item.description: The British arm of German discounter Aldi said on Monday it will invest £900 million ($1.2 billion) next year including in 40 new stores and in its distribution network as it seeks to boost its share of the country's fiercely competitive grocery market.
item.dc:creator: James Davey
item.content:encoded: The British arm of German discounter Aldi said on Monday it will invest £900 million ($1.2 billion) next year including in 40 new stores and in its distribution network as it seeks to boost its share of the country's fiercely competitive grocery market. Aldi UK, Britain's fourth largest grocer after industry leader Tesco (TSCO.L) , Sainsbury's (SBRY.L) and Asda, currently trades from 1,092 stores and plans to open 30 over the next 10 weeks. Its long-term target is 1,500. The group, owned by Germany's Aldi Sud, and rival discounter Lidl have expanded rapidly over the past two decades, transforming Britain's supermarket scene and forcing the traditional players to raise their game. FLAT PROFIT IN 2025 Aldi UK said it made flat operating profit of £432.9 million in 2025, representing an operating margin of 2.3%, reflecting investment in prices, infrastructure and workers' pay. Sales, including Ireland, increased 5% to £19 billion. However, analysts reckon Aldi underperformed the wider UK grocery market at an underlying level in 2025 and has continued to do so in 2026. Monthly [USN:L8N4560GY TEXT:"industry data"] showed Aldi UK's sales rose 0.7% over the 12 weeks to September 6, giving it a UK market share of 10.6%, down 0.2 percentage points on the year. Lidl GB's sales rose 8% over the same period. Aldi UK said it has spent £340 million in reducing prices so far this year. CEO Giles Hurley said the [USN:L8N4560GY TEXT:"cost of food"] remained one of the biggest pressures on UK households. "Recent droughts at home and events overseas have highlighted just how fragile our food system is, and why food security must be a long-term national priority," he said. ($1 = 0.7555 pounds)

写真は１ドル紙幣。2021年11月撮影。REUTERS/Murad Sezer

Kentaro Sugiyama

[東京 ２８日 ロイター] -

ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 157.66／157.69 1.1382／1.1384 179.48／179.49

午前９時現在 157.41／157.45 1.1377／1.1379 179.12／179.13

ＮＹ午後５時 157.26／157.30 1.1391／1.1392 179.13／179.18

午後３時のドル／円は、前週末ニューヨーク市場終盤に比べてドル高／円安の１５７円半ばで推移している。午前は原油先物や米金利の上昇がドル買いを支援し、朝方の１５７円前半からやや水準を切り上げたが、その後は追加材料難の中で小動きとなった。

トランプ米大統領は２６日、ホルムズ海峡開放と中東での戦闘終結に向けたイランの提案を拒否したと表明した。これを受けて原油先物価格が上昇し、ドル／円は早朝につけた安値１５７．１７円から、仲値公示付近にかけて１５７．８５円へじりじり上昇した。

この日は日中に約定したスポット取引の決済日が月末となるスポット末日に当たり、仲値では売買が拮抗した。午後は１５７円後半を中心に一進一退となった。

市場では日米当局による円安けん制への警戒感もくすぶるが、「実弾介入を除けば、当局が円安を抑制する手段は口先介入が中心となる」（みなと銀行の苅谷（訂正）将吾ストラテジスト）として、過度に円高方向へ傾く材料にもなりにくいとの見方もある。

テクニカル的には２００日移動平均線が通る１５８円半ばが目先の上値めどとされる。一方、積極的にドル売り・円買いを進める材料も乏しく、ドル／円は方向感を欠きやすい。市場の関心は週後半に予定される日米の重要経済指標を見極めたいとのムードが広まっている。

item.title: South African tavern shooting death toll rises to 18 after one more victim dies
item.description: The death toll from a tavern shooting over the weekend near Johannesburg has risen to 18 after another victim died in hospital, South African police said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The death toll from a [USN:L6N45J014 TEXT:"tavern shooting"] over the weekend near Johannesburg has risen to 18 after another victim died in hospital, South African police said on Monday. The shooting happened late on Saturday when suspects armed with AK-47 rifles opened fire at the tavern in Wedela township, about 80 km (50 miles) west of Johannesburg. Police said in a statement that four of those killed had so far been identified: two South Africans and two nationals of Lesotho. Violent crime remains a major challenge in South Africa despite efforts to curb one of the world's highest per-capita murder rates. Police are still searching for the perpetrators of the shooting but said they managed to get clear pictures of them. One line of inquiry is that the incident was part of a turf war between the heavily armed gangs that control the illegal gold-mining trade in the area. Authorities are also investigating another weekend shooting near Cape Town in which 10 people were killed.

item.title: Ladbrokes owner Entain cuts online revenue outlook after Brazil online betting ban
item.description: Ladbrokes owner Entain cut its online net gaming revenue growth forecast on Monday to 4% to 6% on a constant currency basis after Brazil's move to ban online sports betting and gaming.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ladbrokes owner Entain (ENT.L) cut its online net gaming revenue growth forecast on Monday to 4% to 6% on a constant currency basis after Brazil's move to ban online sports betting and gaming. Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's executive order [USN:L1N45H0UN TEXT:"bans"] online betting operations in Brazil, less than two years after the government kicked off a legal framework allowing the industry to operate. The company expects its 2026 group underlying core profit to be at the lower end of its previous forecast of £910 million to £960 million ($1.20 billion to $1.27 billion). Its online underlying core profit margin forecast is also expected to come in at the bottom end of its 21% to 22% outlook. ($1 = 0.7557 pounds)

item.title: Einwanderer füllen Lücken in vielen Engpassberufen
item.description: Ob Gastronomie, Pflege oder Logistik: In vielen Branchen mit Fachkräftemangel in Deutschland sind Beschäftigte mit Einwanderungsgeschichte überdurchschnittlich stark vertreten. So hatten 56 Prozent der Köchinnen und Köche im Jahr 2025 eine Einwanderungsgeschichte, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Donnerstag mitteilte. Auch in der Lebensmittelherstellung (55 Prozent), bei Fahrern von Bussen und Straßenbahnen sowie Servicekräften in der Gastronomie (je 47 Prozent) war der Anteil hoch.

So hatten 56 Prozent der Köchinnen und Köche im Jahr 2025 eine Einwanderungsgeschichte, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Donnerstag mitteilte. Auch in der Lebensmittelherstellung (55 Prozent), bei Fahrern von Bussen und Straßenbahnen sowie Servicekräften in der Gastronomie (je 47 Prozent) war der Anteil hoch. Zum Vergleich: In der Gesamtwirtschaft hatte gut ein Viertel (27 Prozent) aller abhängig Beschäftigten eine Einwanderungsgeschichte. Als Engpassberufe gelten der Bundesagentur für Arbeit zufolge solche, in denen ein Fachkräftemangel herrscht oder droht. Eine Einwanderungsgeschichte hat eine Person, wenn sie selbst oder beide Elternteile seit 1950 nach Deutschland eingewandert sind. Deutlich über dem Durchschnitt liegt der Anteil auch in der Pflege mit 33 Prozent sowie bei Berufskraftfahrern im Güterverkehr (41 Prozent). Dagegen war der Anteil in anderen Mangelberufen wie dem Rettungsdienst (sieben Prozent) oder in der Landwirtschaft (15 Prozent) gering. Unterrepräsentiert sind Menschen mit Einwanderungsgeschichte den Daten zufolge auch im Polizeivollzugsdienst (acht Prozent), in der öffentlichen Verwaltung (neun Prozent) und bei Lehrkräften (neun bis zehn Prozent). Die Integration in den Arbeitsmarkt hängt den Statistikern zufolge von der Herkunftsregion und der Aufenthaltsdauer ab. So waren von den aus der EU zugewanderten Männern, die weniger als fünf Jahre in Deutschland lebten, 89 Prozent erwerbstätig. Bei den Frauen waren es hier 73 Prozent. Bei Eingewanderten aus Afrika waren es 79 Prozent der Männer und 47 Prozent der Frauen. Bei Eingewanderten aus dem Nahen und Mittleren Osten lag der Anteil bei 57 Prozent der Männer und 28 Prozent der Frauen. Mit zunehmender Aufenthaltsdauer steigen die Erwerbstätigenquoten jedoch. Nach 20 bis 25 Jahren im Land waren etwa 87 Prozent der Männer und 79 Prozent der Frauen aus dem Nahen und Mittleren Osten erwerbstätig. Zum Vergleich: In der Gesamtbevölkerung im Alter von 25 bis 59 Jahren lag die Erwerbstätigenquote bei Männern bei 88 Prozent und bei Frauen bei 81 Prozent.

item.title: Ministro Esteri saudita incontra a Washington segretario di Stato Usa
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente: 7.40 - Il ministro degli Esteri saudita, il principe Faisal bin Farhan, è arrivato a Washington per un incontro con il segretario di Stato Usa Marco Rubio. Lo ha riferito l'agenzia di stampa ufficiale saudita, mentre si intensificano le ostilità tra Riyadh e gli Houthi yemeniti. Questo mese il principe ereditario saudita Mohammed bin Salman aveva chiesto agli Stati Uniti un sostegno militare contro gli Houthi, sostenuti dall'Iran, ma Washington aveva respinto l'ipotesi di condurre attacchi diretti, accettando tuttavia di fornire supporto in termini di intelligence e identificazione degli obiettivi, secondo quanto riferito da fonti a Reuters. 7.00 - L'Iran ha ribadito domenica che solo la diplomazia può risolvere il conflitto con gli Stati Uniti e Israele, dopo che il presidente statunitense Donald Trump ha affermato di aver respinto una proposta iraniana volta a riaprire lo Stretto di Hormuz e a porre fine ai combattimenti.

item.title: VNG-Chef: Gasversorgung im Winter trotz geringer Speichermengen gesichert
item.description: Deutschland geht nach den Worten des Chefs des Gasimporteurs VNG trotz ungewöhnlich niedriger Füllstände in den Gasspeichern ohne unmittelbares Versorgungsrisiko in den Winter. "Verglichen mit 2022 ist das System in Summe deutlich robuster", sagte Vorstandschef Ulf Heitmüller in einem am Montag veröffentlichten Interview der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Er verwies unter anderem auf Importe von Flüssigerdgas (LNG). "Wir haben mehr Zugang zu LNG und wir haben uns, was die Bezugsquellen angeht, breiter aufgestellt." Die deutschen Gasspeicher sind nur zu 57 Prozent gefüllt. Dies ist ein historischer Tiefstand für Ende September und liegt deutlich unter dem europäischen Durchschnitt.
item.dc:creator: Nora Buli
item.content:encoded: Deutschland geht nach den Worten des Chefs des Gasimporteurs VNG trotz ungewöhnlich niedriger Füllstände in den Gasspeichern ohne unmittelbares Versorgungsrisiko in den Winter. "Verglichen mit 2022 ist das System in Summe deutlich robuster", sagte Vorstandschef Ulf Heitmüller in einem am Montag veröffentlichten Interview der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Er verwies unter anderem auf Importe von Flüssigerdgas (LNG). "Wir haben mehr Zugang zu LNG und wir haben uns, was die Bezugsquellen angeht, breiter aufgestellt." Die deutschen Gasspeicher sind nur zu 57 Prozent gefüllt. Dies ist ein historischer Tiefstand für Ende September und liegt deutlich unter dem europäischen Durchschnitt. Das Leipziger Unternehmen VNG, das mehrheitlich dem Versorger EnBW (EBKG.DE) gehört, ist neben den verstaatlichten Energiekonzernen Uniper (UN0k.DE) und Sefe einer der größten deutschen Gasimporteure. Sein Unternehmen habe das Portfolio so aufgestellt, dass es seine Lieferverpflichtungen auch bei einem kalten Winter erfüllen könne, betonte Heitmüller. GASPREISE IN 2026 MEHR ALS VERDOPPELT VNG bezieht Pipeline-Gas aus Norwegen und hat Verträge über Lieferungen aus Algerien und Aserbaidschan abgeschlossen. Diese Lieferanten haben seit dem Wegfall der russischen Pipeline-Lieferungen an Bedeutung gewonnen. Heitmüller wies darauf hin, dass die Gasspeicherung zwar Teil der Versorgungssicherheit sei, aber nicht der einzig entscheidende Faktor. "Es ist mehr ein Zusammenspiel aus Speichern, Importen und LNG-Verfügbarkeiten." Zusätzliche Importausfälle, eine Verknappung auf dem globalen Energiemarkt oder Störungen der Infrastruktur in Verbindung mit kälterem Wetter in diesem Winter könnten gleichwohl zu Preisspitzen führen. Die europäischen Gaspreise haben sich in diesem Jahr auf rund 75 Euro pro Megawattstunde (MWh) mehr als verdoppelt, nachdem die Schließung der Straße von Hormus im Zuge des Iran-Kriegs das weltweite LNG-Angebot eingeschränkt hatte. EU-Energiekommissar Dan Jorgensen warnte in der vergangenen Woche, der Staatengemeinschaft drohe in diesem Winter eine Energiepreiskrise. Die Bundesregierung hat Forderungen nach direkten Eingriffen zur Erhöhung der Speichermengen bisher widerstanden, unterstützt jedoch die Ausschreibung von Reservegas für das erste Quartal 2027. Heitmüller begrüßte diesen Schritt. Er schaffe Anreize zur Gasspeicherung, ohne den Markt zu verzerren.

item.title: Solarstrom-Rekord - Jahreswert von 2025 bereits übertroffen
item.description: Die Solarstromproduktion in Deutschland hat im bisherigen Jahresverlauf bereits den Wert des gesamten Vorjahres übertroffen. Von Anfang Januar bis zum Sonntag erzeugten Photovoltaikanlagen 90,2 Terawattstunden (TWh) elektrische Energie, wie der Bundesverband Solarwirtschaft (BSW-Solar) am Montag mitteilte. Im Gesamtjahr 2025 waren es 90,0 TWh gewesen. Der Verband berief sich auf Daten des Fraunhofer-Instituts für Solare Energiesysteme (ISE).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Solarstromproduktion in Deutschland hat im bisherigen Jahresverlauf bereits den Wert des gesamten Vorjahres übertroffen. Von Anfang Januar bis zum Sonntag erzeugten Photovoltaikanlagen 90,2 Terawattstunden (TWh) elektrische Energie, wie der Bundesverband Solarwirtschaft (BSW-Solar) am Montag mitteilte. Im Gesamtjahr 2025 waren es 90,0 TWh gewesen. Der Verband berief sich auf Daten des Fraunhofer-Instituts für Solare Energiesysteme (ISE). Zu dem Rekord trugen dem Verband zufolge ungewöhnlich viele Sonnenstunden und der Ausbau der Photovoltaikanlagen bei. Neben neuen Anlagen auf Dächern und Freiflächen wachse auch die Bedeutung von Batteriespeichern, mit denen der Strom flexibler vor Ort genutzt werden könne. Im vergangenen Jahr steuerte die Photovoltaik den Angaben zufolge rund ein Fünftel der heimischen Stromerzeugung bei. Solarenergie sei eine tragende Säule der Stromversorgung, erklärte BSW-Hauptgeschäftsführer Carsten Körnig. Der Bundestag berät derzeit über die Novelle des Erneuerbare-Energien-Gesetzes (EEG). Vorgesehen sind Einschnitte bei der Förderung. Körnig warnte davor, mit den Gesetzen neue Hürden aufzubauen und die Investitionsbereitschaft zu bremsen. So müsse für kleine Dachanlagen ein verlässlicher Vergütungsrahmen erhalten bleiben. Um das Regierungsziel von 215 Gigawatt (GW) installierter Leistung bis 2030 zu erreichen, müssten in den kommenden vier Jahren durchschnittlich rund 20 GW jährlich zugebaut werden. In Deutschland sind Anlagen mit einer Gesamtleistung von rund 130 GW in Betrieb.

item.title: China reducirá los aranceles sobre productos agrícolas de EEUU, pero no sobre la soja
item.description: China tiene previsto reducir los aranceles sobre una amplia gama de productos agrícolas estadounidenses, desde el maíz y el trigo hasta la carne y los lácteos, pero la soja —el principal producto de importación— quedó excluida de la lista de reducción de aranceles publicada el lunes por su Ministerio de Comercio.
item.dc:creator: Ella Cao, Naveen Thukral, Lewis Jackson
item.content:encoded: China tiene previsto reducir los aranceles sobre una amplia gama de productos agrícolas estadounidenses, desde el maíz y el trigo hasta la carne y los lácteos, pero la soja —el principal producto de importación— quedó excluida de la lista de reducción de aranceles publicada el lunes por su Ministerio de Comercio. Los mercados esperaban noticias sobre los recortes arancelarios chinos a los productos agrícolas estadounidenses tras la cumbre celebrada la semana pasada en Washington entre los líderes Xi Jinping y Donald Trump. La lista incluye el sorgo, los aceites vegetales y las harinas, entre ellos el aceite de soja y la harina de soja, además de la carne, los productos lácteos y otros artículos. Sin embargo, la soja estadounidense sigue sujeta a un arancel adicional del 10%, que, según han advertido los operadores, es demasiado elevado para que lo absorban las empresas privadas de procesamiento, a pesar de que los compradores estatales chinos han intensificado sus compras. "A pesar de que la soja no es un producto sensible en el ámbito comercial, la importancia política de la compra de soja por parte de China es enorme y conlleva importantes implicaciones políticas", dijo Feng Chucheng, fundador y socio de Hutong Research. "De ahí que se haya establecido una vía separada para la compra de soja fuera de la Bolsa de Comercio. Esto también proporciona a Pekín una baza para frenar las acciones de EEUU, especialmente de cara a las elecciones de mitad de mandato." Ambas partes han acordado crear un consejo comercial, cuya primera tarea será debatir una reducción recíproca de los aranceles sobre productos por valor de 30.000 millones de dólares, en un intento por garantizar unas relaciones económicas y comerciales estables. Las empresas agrícolas estatales chinas Sinograin y COFCO han comprado más de 12 millones de toneladas métricas de soja estadounidense, casi la mitad de los 25 millones que, según la Casa Blanca, Pekín se ha comprometido a comprar anualmente hasta 2028. El comercio de productos agrícolas y afines incluidos en la lista del lunes ascendió a unos 17.000 millones de dólares en 2024, lo que se ajusta aproximadamente al compromiso de compra declarado por China, excluyendo la soja, según los cálculos de Reuters.

item.title: Record high support for New Zealand Greens boosts chance of centre-left coalition, poll shows
item.description: Support rose to 16% for New Zealand's Green Party a poll published on Monday showed, its highest ever recorded, as National and Labour fell to 28% each ahead of a general election set for November 7.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Support rose to 16% for New Zealand's Green Party a poll published on Monday showed, its highest ever recorded, as National and Labour fell to 28% each ahead of a general election set for November 7. The poll by 1News Verian suggested Labour, the Greens, Te Pati Maori and the Opportunity Party could govern in a left-leaning coalition with 65 seats, against 59 for National, ACT and NZ First. Labour's 28% support was its lowest since February 2024, down 2 points from August. National's 28% support was its lowest since 2021. The poll surveyed 1,004 voters from September 23 to 27, with 13% undecided or declining to say. New Zealand's electoral system [USN:L6N45F00G TEXT:"favours coalitions"], with the result still too close to call. Prime Minister Christopher Luxon has previously said his National Party was unlikely to work with Opportunity because of its tax policies.

item.title: Turkey lifts asset freezes on 46 companies in market probe, media reports
item.description: Turkish authorities lifted asset-freeze orders imposed on 46 companies as part of an investigation into investment funds and market manipulation, broadcaster NTV and other media reported on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Turkish authorities lifted asset-freeze orders imposed on 46 companies as part of an investigation into investment funds and market manipulation, broadcaster NTV and other media reported on Monday. The Istanbul chief prosecutor's office said in a statement the decision was taken following new assessments and notifications from the country's Capital Markets Board (SPK), NTV reported. The companies were among dozens of legal entities, investment funds and individuals whose assets were frozen as investigators examined large stock market transactions carried out between July, when the funds reached peak assets under management, and September 16, the day before the SPK ordered the liquidation of scores of funds during a liquidity crisis. Justice Minister Akin Gurlek said last week investigators were scrutinising large share purchases and sales during that period under a probe into alleged market manipulation. Authorities had frozen the assets of 46 companies, 18 funds and 42 individuals and imposed overseas travel bans on 37 people. [USN:L8N45J00R TEXT:"At the weekend"], a deputy chair of President Tayyip Erdogan's AK Party, Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya, resigned from her party posts after an opposition politician alleged that she and her husband made substantial profits from trading Ozata Denizcilik (OZATD.IS) shares ahead of the market turmoil. Kaya said on X that she considered it necessary to take political responsibility while the allegations were examined and asked Erdogan to relieve her of all the posts she holds. She did not comment further on the specifics of the allegation. The crisis erupted after suspected price manipulation in a number of thinly traded stocks triggered heavy losses and redemption pressures at investment funds, prompting emergency measures by regulators to support financial stability.

item.title: 国連、西岸入植地関連企業リストに61社追加 計214社に
item.description:
Emma Farge
［ジュネーブ ２５日 ロイター］ - 国連人権高等弁務官事務所（国連人権事務所、ＯＨＣＨＲ
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Emma Farge

［ジュネーブ　２５日　ロイター］ - 国連人権高等弁務官事務所（国連人権事務所、ＯＨＣＨＲ ）は２５日、国連が違法と見なしているイスラエルのヨルダン川西岸入植地で活動する企業のデータベースに、新たに６１社を追加したと発表した。

３００万人以上のパレスチナ人が暮らす同地域での入植地拡大を巡り、イスラエルに圧力をかけるための不買運動や投資引き揚げ（ダイベストメント）の標的になり得るため、このデータベースは極めて機微な扱いを受けている。

２０２０年に初めて公表された同データベースには、２１４社が掲載されている。イスラエルの企業が大半を占めるが、フランス、ドイツ、中国、米国など１０カ国の企業を含まれ、旅行予約大手のエクスペディアや民泊仲介大手エアビーアンドビーも掲載されている。

新たに追加された企業は、中国系シンジェンタ・グループ傘下のイスラエルの農薬大手アダマ、イスラエルを拠点とする不動産投資持ち株会社アロニー・ヘツ、スペインの物流会社サルバット・ロジスティカなど。

国連人権事務所は、同事務所に寄せられた機密情報に基づき、エネルギー、食品、宿泊・接客、運輸、農業などのセクターで活動する企業を調査・評価した。

他の約６０社も評価対象となったが、パレスチナ人の自決権を侵害する活動への関与という国連の基準を満たさなかったため、リストには含まれなかった。

イスラエルは西岸地区を占領地ではなく「係争地」と見なし、国連のリストは合法的に活動している企業を不当に中傷するものだと主張してきた。同国の代表部は２５日、「歪んだ仕組みであり、反イスラエルが多数派となる著しく欠陥のある組織によって作られた」と指摘し、データベースは同国を「迫害」するために設置されたものだと非難した。

item.title: 豪メトリクス、上場3ファンドの売買停止 監査受け評価額引き下げ
item.description: [シドニー ２８日 ロイター] - 豪プライベートクレジット大手メトリクス・クレジット・パートナーズは２８日、オースト...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
豪メトリクス、上場3ファンドの売買停止　監査受け評価額引き下げ 15:09 配信

写真はオーストラリア証券取引所のロゴ。11日、オーストラリア・シドニーで撮影。REUTERS/Hollie Adams

[シドニー ２８日 ロイター] - 豪プライベートクレジット大手メトリクス・クレジット・パートナーズは２８日、オーストラリア証券取引所に上場する３ファンドの売買を停止し、資産評価額を引き下げると発表した。

取引を停止したのはメトリクス・リアル・エステート・マルチストラテジー・ファンド、メトリクス・インカム・オポチュニティーズ・トラスト、メトリクス・マスター・インカム・トラスト。

取引所に提出した各ファンドの開示資料で、監査法人のＫＰＭＧが暫定財務報告の前提条件について、同社とは「異なる判断」をしたためと説明した。

前提条件の見直しにより、 有形純資産額はリアル・エステート・マルチストラテジー・ファンドで１２．１６％、インカム・オポチュニティーズ・トラストで１０．０８％、マスター・インカム・トラストで１．９９％引き下げられた。

リアル・エステート・マルチストラテジー・ファンドの１口当たり有形純資産額を２．５３豪ドルから２．２２豪ドルへ引き下げた。主な要因は、非上場の商業用不動産への投資で評価額を引き下げたことだという。

メトリクスは「監査済み決算を確定する過程で、下振れシナリオや、より不利な結果となる可能性を重く見た」と説明した。

監査の結果、上場する３ファンドで貸倒引当金も積み増した。「金利やマクロ経済の状況、個別資産やポートフォリオに対する規制当局の要求水準の高まり」などを反映したとしている。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：激化する重要資源獲得競争、対中依存脱却がテーマに コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 アングル：ネパール土石流でインド人多数が行方不明、ヒンドゥー教聖地巡礼者ら アングル：アジア太平洋で非居住者の起債が活発、巨大テックの動き波及 コラム：静かに進むガソリン離れ、中国製ＥＶの世界展開が後押しか 最終更新: 9/28(月) 15:09 ロイター

item.title: 波に消えゆくカリフォルニアの砂浜、最強エルニーニョの到来で消失加速も
item.description:
海面の上昇や強力な暴風雨による波が、米カリフォルニア州の海岸線を書き換えつつある。専門家らは、勢いを強めるエルニーニョ現象と気候変動が相まって、カリフォルニア州にとって「歴史的な冬」をもたらすかもしれないと指摘する。海岸線の変化は人々の予想を上回るペースで進む恐れがあると警鐘を鳴らしている。
◇
南カリフォルニアの海岸線の多くで、陸地が海に奪われつつある。東太平洋のハリケーンやサイクロンが生み出す強大なうねりが、砂浜から砂をさらい、沿岸の建物や施設に被害を与え、地中などに姿を隠していた水辺のインフラをむき出しにしている。
そして今、強力なエルニーニョ現象が気候変動と重なり、こうした変化はさらに加速する恐れがある。専門家は、こうした変化は自然の営みだとしつつも、その影響は無視できなくなってきていると指摘する。
