item.title: 豪ノーザン・スター、ゴールド・フィールズの270億ドル買収案拒否
item.description:
Melanie Burton Roshan Thomas
[メルボルン ２８日 ロイター] - オーストラリアの産金大...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
豪ノーザン・スター、ゴールド・フィールズの270億ドル買収案拒否 10:57 配信

Melanie Burton　Roshan Thomas

[メルボルン ２８日 ロイター] - オーストラリアの産金大手ノーザン・スター・リソーシズは２８日、南アフリカの同業ゴールド・フィールズから受けた３８７億豪ドル（約２７１億米ドル）規模の買収提案を拒否したと発表した。

買収が成立すれば、ニューモントに次ぐ世界第２位の金生産会社が誕生、オーストラリア企業を対象とした過去最大級のＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）となる。金価格は今年初めに最高値を更新した後、上昇の勢いが失われている。

ノーザン・スターは、アクティビスト投資家のエリオット・インベストメント・マネジメントから経営改革を迫られている。エリオットは６月、ゴールド・フィールズなど競合他社への売却につながる可能性のある戦略見直しを実施するよう要求した。

ゴールド・フィールズが提示した買収案では、ノーザン・スターの株主は保有株１株につき、ゴールド・フィールズの新株０．３１２５株と現金７．２５豪ドルを受け取る。

ノーザン・スターによると、ゴールド・フィールズの提案を受領したのは９月１４日で、この時点では買収額は１株当たり２７．００豪ドルに相当したが、ゴールド・フィールズの２５日終値に基づくと２５．１９豪ドルに低下。これはノーザン・スターの直近終値に対して１４％のプレミアムに相当するが、オーストラリアの企業買収では通常、案件成立には少なくとも３０％のプレミアムが必要とされる。

ノーザン・スター株は２８日、６．２％高の２３．４７豪ドルで取引を終えた。ただ、提案に基づく買収価格を下回り、取引序盤に付けた高値２４．４６豪ドルからも下落した。

ノーザン・スターのマイケル・チェイニー会長は声明で「ゴールド・フィールズは、世界有数の金資産ポートフォリオの一つを、当社取締役会が本源的価値と考える水準を大きく下回る価格で、極めて機会主義的なタイミングで取得しようとした」と述べた。

ゴールド・フィールズは、正式提案の提出前の過去６カ月間にノーザン・スターと複数回にわたり協議を行ったものの、限定的な関与しか得られなかったと説明。

今回の提案は双方の株主にとって説得力のある戦略的・財務的利益をもたらすと考えており「当社は建設的な対話に引き続きオープンであり、ノーザン・スター取締役会との協議を求めていく」とした。ゴールド・フィールズのマイク・フレイザー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２９日、米コロラド州で開催される金鉱業カンファレンスで投資家に説明を行う予定。

ノーザン・スターは７月、エリオットからの圧力を受けて新ＣＥＯを任命した。エリオットはノーザン・スター株式の６．２％を保有していると明らかにしている。

エリオットのパートナー、ジョン・パイク氏は２８日の声明で、ノーザン・スターには巨大な価値創造の潜在力があり、いかなる取引もそれを反映したものである必要があると指摘。「他社も明らかにここに価値を見いだしている。取締役会には、真剣な買い手と対話し、その潜在力を実現する最善の道を十分に評価する義務がある」と述べた。

＜西オーストラリア州の事業＞

両社は西オーストラリア州で金事業を展開しており、南部カルグーリーではノーザン・スターが国内最大の金鉱山を運営している。

ゴールド・フィールズは買収により企業運営や操業、保有資産構成の最適化を通じ、４０億─５０億米ドルの相乗効果を見込むとした。

また、長期にわたり生産が見込める資産の比重が高まり、統合後の会社の年間金生産量は４１０万オンスとなる。このうち８０％を豪州、北米、チリが占めるという。

ゴールド・フィールズによると、ノーザン・スターの株主は統合後の会社の株式３３％を保有することになる。新会社はオーストラリア証券取引所に重複上場する予定だ。

ノーザン・スター株を保有するウィルソン・アセット・マネジメントのジョン・アユーブ・ポートフォリオマネジャーは「買い手に都合の良い機会を狙った提案という印象だ。拒否した取締役会の判断を支持する」と述べた。投資家はゴールド・フィールズ株の価値と、ノーザン・スターが独自の再建計画や資産売却を通じて生み出し得る価値を比較する必要があると語った。

ノーザン・スターは、提案を受け入れれば、株主はゴールド・フィールズ株の値動きに大きく左右されることになると指摘した。ゴールド・フィールズ株は、ノーザン・スターの既存資産と比べ、事業を展開する国・地域に起因するリスクが高いとした。さらに、長期にわたり生産が見込めるノーザン・スターの保有資産を大幅に過小評価しているとも述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：武田薬のシャイアー買収5年、大型Ｍ＆Ａの難しさ示す アングル：中国発ＳＨＥＩＮ、買収主導で増収率の回復狙う アングル：英企業対象のＭ＆Ａ、年初来総額が1920億ドルと記録的な急増 焦点：訂正-焦点：高値の提案も拒否可能、経産省が買収指針明確化　同意なき買収にどう影響 アングル：日本のＭ＆Ａで増す株主の存在感、経営判断の「その後」も意識 最終更新: 9/28(月) 16:22 ロイター

item.title: テスラの運転支援機能ＦＳＤ、ＥＵ全域承認の採決は延期へ
item.description:
Marie Mannes
[ストックホルム ２５日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）は米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
テスラの運転支援機能ＦＳＤ、ＥＵ全域承認の採決は延期へ 10:54 配信

写真はテスラのロゴイメージ。2025年7月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Marie Mannes

[ストックホルム ２５日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）は米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラの運転支援システム「フル・セルフドライビング（ＦＳＤ）」システムについて、ＥＵ全域で運用を承認することの是非を問う採決を１０月より先へ延期する見通しだ。次の採決の機会は早くても１２月以降となる見込み。ＥＵのウェブサイトから明らかになった。

ＥＵ域内では、オランダ道路交通局（ＲＤＷ）が４月にＦＳＤを承認し、ベルギーなど数カ国がそれに続いた。ＲＤＷはＦＳＤをＥＵ全域で承認するよう提案している。

テスラは９月１日、ソーシャルメディアＸに１０月６日に採決が実施される可能性があると投稿していた。

しかしＥＵ加盟国と欧州委員会の代表者で構成される自動車技術委員会（ＴＣＭＶ）の１０月６日の会議議題には、オランダの提案について「議論の継続」と記載されているのみで、割当時間はわずか２５分間だ。次のＴＣＭＶ会議は１２月に予定されている。

テスラはコメント要請に応じなかった。イーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は採決延期に関するＸの投稿に「ため息」と返信している。

ＥＵ全域でＦＳＤを展開するには、加盟２７カ国のうち１５カ国以上、かつ域内人口の６５％を代表する「特定多数」による支持が必要となる。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ＥＵのＥＶ補助金巡る対中調査、自らに跳ね返るリスクも コラム：短距離フライト削減でＣＯ2対策なるか、的外れの欧州 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 焦点：コーヒー企業「アフリカ離れ」も、ＥＵが森林破壊防止法 アングル：長時間労働・残業に不満の中国労働者、ＥＵの対中圧力に「共感」 最終更新: 9/28(月) 10:54 ロイター

item.title: オラクル製ソフトへに再びハッカー攻撃、防御策回避＝グーグル
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] - グーグル傘下のサイバーセキュリティー企業マンディアントは２５日、ハッカー集団「シャイニーハン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
オラクル製ソフトへに再びハッカー攻撃、防御策回避＝グーグル 10:51 配信

写真はグーグルのロゴ看板。7月1日、米ニューヨーク市内で撮影。REUTERS/Aleksandra Michalska

[２５日 ロイター] - グーグル傘下のサイバーセキュリティー企業マンディアントは２５日、ハッカー集団「シャイニーハンターズ」が、米オラクルの業務ソフトウエア「ピープルソフト」の脆弱性を突いた「大規模な攻撃」を再開したと明らかにした。夏の攻撃を受けて講じられた防御策をかいくぐったという。

攻撃の手口が変わったことで、人事などの重要業務にピープルソフトを利用する組織で警戒感が高まりそうだ。資金力のある機関でさえ攻撃を防げないのではないかとの懸念も強まるとみられる。

マンディアントが公表した脅威情報に関する報告書によると、シャイニーハンターズは５月２７日から６月９日にかけて、ピープルソフトの欠陥を悪用した攻撃を実行した。主に大学が被害を受けた。

ハッカーらは５─６月の攻撃後に公表された防御指針に対応して手法を変えた。ウェブアプリ向けファイアウオールのルールを導入して一定の防御策は講じたものの、オラクルが脆弱性を修正するために提供した更新プログラムを適用していなかった組織を狙った。

今回の攻撃は高等教育、テクノロジー、医療、農業、運輸、政府など幅広い分野に及び、世界の数十のシステムが影響を受けた。被害を受けた組織名は明らかにしなかった。

シャイニーハンターズは複数の大規模な情報流出事件への関与を主張しており、報告者公表の数日前には、米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）職員のデータを盗んだと表明していた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：ミュトスによるハッキング懸念、専門家からは「過剰反応」との指摘も アングル：ＡＩ競争でグーグル躍進、ウォール街も設備投資急増への評価一変 コラム：グーグル、ＡＩブームの賭けで存在感 アングル：ウクライナ、グーグルと独自ＡＩシステム開発　決め手は多言語対応 アングル：ＡＩハードウエア競争、グーグル「手本はエヌビディア」 最終更新: 9/28(月) 10:51 ロイター

item.title: 中国工業部門利益、8月は前年比4.2％増に鈍化 テック関連は好調
item.description: [北京 ２８日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が２８日発表したデータによると、８月の工業部門企業利益は前年同月比４．２...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国工業部門利益、8月は前年比4.2％増に鈍化　テック関連は好調 10:49 配信

写真は中国江蘇省常州市にある工場で9月18日撮影。REUTERS/Nicoco Chan

[北京 ２８日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が２８日発表したデータによると、８月の工業部門企業利益は前年同月比４．２％増となり、７月の１１．２％増から鈍化した。１─８月も１５．７％増と、１─７月の１７．６％増から減速した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームを背景に技術関連の製造業は好調だったものの、国内需要の低迷が重しとなった。

一部業種では消費低迷や過剰生産能力を背景に、企業が価格決定力を維持することが一段と難しくなっている。メーカー各社は利益確保のために海外市場への依存を強めており、地政学的緊張が高まり貿易黒字への監視も強まる中で、中国の輸出依存をさらに深めるリスクをはらんでいる。

業種別では、コンピューター・通信・その他電子機器製造業の利益が１─８月に１１０％増と最大の伸びを示した。一方、ワイン・飲料・精製茶製造業は３４．７％減と、最も低調な業種の一つとなった。

中国ＣＩＴＩＣ銀行インターナショナルのチーフエコノミスト、Ding Meng氏は「今後、工業企業利益の安定的な成長を維持するには、家計所得と消費を拡大し、内需を押し上げることが極めて重要になる」と指摘した。

中国人民銀行（中央銀行）の黄益平金融政策委員は今月、ＡＩが中国で旺盛な供給と低調な需要の不均衡を悪化・長期化させる可能性があると警告した。

工業部門企業利益の集計対象は、主要業務からの年間売上高が２０００万元（２９８万ドル）以上の企業。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：中国政府、株市場てこ入れ作戦に公的年金基金も動員 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：経済モデル転換目指す中国、不動産不況でも資源需要衰えず コラム：「不動産バブル」乗り越えた中国、傷浅く　地政学的混乱も好機に 最終更新: 9/28(月) 12:43 ロイター

item.title: Gold drops more than 2% on US rate-hike bets
item.description: Gold prices fell more than 2% on Monday as a rise in oil prices heightened inflation concerns and reinforced expectations of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes.
item.dc:creator: Ashitha Shivaprasad
item.content:encoded: Gold prices fell more than 2% on Monday as a rise in oil prices heightened inflation concerns and reinforced expectations of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes. Spot gold was down 2.7% at $4,171.85 per ounce, as of 0627 GMT, hitting its lowest since early August. US gold futures fell 2.7% to $4,204.30. "The high bond yields and high oil price tandem continues to act as a thorn in gold’s side. Oil prices have risen on mixed signals about oil flows, which is keeping inflation front and centre for investors," said Tim Waterer, chief market analyst at KCM Trade. [USN:L6N45J004 TEXT:"Iran"] insisted that only diplomacy can solve its conflict with the United States and Israel, after US President Donald Trump said he rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end fighting. Oil prices drifted higher. The Fed raised rates earlier this month, lifting its target rate range by a quarter percentage point to between 3.75% and 4%. Traders are pricing in a 69% chance of a US rate hike in October, according to CME's FedWatch Tool. Higher energy prices can fuel inflation by raising costs across the economy. Gold is widely viewed as a hedge against inflation, but a high interest rate environment increases the opportunity cost of holding the non-yielding metal. Investors will watch a run of US labour market and inflation data this week, including job openings, the ADP employment report, the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index and nonfarm payrolls. "Stronger-than-expected inflation or employment numbers could keep upward pressure on bond yields and weigh further on gold," Waterer said. Cleveland Fed President [USN:L6N45H10Y TEXT:"Beth Hammack"] said on Friday she is concerned that persistently high inflation risks conditioning the American public to accept elevated prices as the norm, adding the central bank cannot let that happen. Among other metals, spot silver fell 4.3% to $61.51 per ounce, platinum was down 2.8% at $1,728.43 and palladium lost 3.1% to $1,227.67.

item.title: Dollar holds firm as US-Iran tensions lift oil, hawkish Fed bets build
item.description: The dollar was on the defensive on Monday but remained near a two-month high, as the US-Iran standoff continued to push up oil prices and bond yields, while investors looked ahead to a data-packed week for further clues on inflation and central-bank policy.
item.dc:creator: Jiaxing Li
item.content:encoded: The dollar was on the defensive on Monday but remained near a two-month high, as the US-Iran standoff continued to push up oil prices and bond yields, while investors looked ahead to a data-packed week for further clues on inflation and central-bank policy. The euro was a shade weaker at $1.1386, hovering near two-month lows against the greenback and on course for a 2% decline in September. Sterling held steady at $1.3247, close to a three-month low, after Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey reiterated a [USN:L8N45H0H9 TEXT:"rate hike warning"]. The dollar index , which measures the US currency against a basket of peers, eased slightly to 101.12 but was still set for a 1.7% gain this month, its best gain since June. Oil prices [USN:L4N45J03L TEXT:"climbed"] more than 3% on Monday with Brent crude futures last above $107 a barrel, after US President Donald Trump [USN:L6N45J004 TEXT:"rejected"] a peace deal with Iran to resolve their conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Energy supply risks and [USN:L1N45H0BU TEXT:"robust fundamentals"] in the US have heightened inflation concerns and prompted traders to price in a more [USN:L6N45H10Y TEXT:"hawkish Federal Reserve"], while a relentless rise in long-end [USN:L6N45H0ZD TEXT:"Treasury yields"] also supported the dollar. "The greenback could overshoot in the near term if energy market tensions persist and inflation risks continue to build," said Sim Moh Siong, FX strategist at OCBC. The bank's base case remains for a moderate dollar rally into year-end, he added. The market's focus is set to turn to US data releases as the week unfolds, with the PCE Index (USPCEM=ECI) on Wednesday and non-farm payrolls (USNFAR=ECI) on Friday both expected to be consistent with further policy tightening. Currently, markets are seeing a 65% chance of a rate hike from the Fed when the central bank meets next at the end of October, according to CME Group's FedWatch tool. Other data for the week include China PMIs (CNPMIB=ECI) on Wednesday ahead of the week-long National Day holidays and euro zone CPIs (EUHICF=ECI) on Friday. The yen was last down 0.3% at 157.7 per dollar, trimming gains from Friday, after Japan's Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent [USN:L1N45H0E7 TEXT:"reaffirmed"] that the two nations intend to strengthen cooperation to address yen weakness. Meanwhile, [USN:L4N45K00K TEXT:"data"] on Monday showed Japan's service-sector inflation rose in August at the fastest annual pace in more than two years, highlighting mounting price pressures and bolstering the case for [USN:L1N45K006 TEXT:"faster rate hikes"] from the Bank of Japan. The Australian dollar fetched $0.70125 and the kiwi strengthened 0.1% to $0.5670 . The Reserve Bank of Australia is expected to [USN:L4N45F18Y TEXT:"raise interest"] rates by 25 basis points to a near 15-year high of 4.60% on Tuesday, likely the final rate increase in the tightening cycle. Elsewhere, offshore yuan strengthened slightly to 6.714 per dollar, after Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping's [USN:L1N45H0FW TEXT:"three-day summit"] did not yield any big public breakthroughs on a host of contentious issues.

item.title: 米メタ、ＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」の安全警告強化 脆弱性を発見
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズは同社の人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント「ミューズ」において、利用者の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米メタ、ＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」の安全警告強化　脆弱性を発見 10:30 配信

写真はメタの人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント「ミューズ」のロゴと、キーボード、ロボットの手のイメージ。9月23日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２５日 ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズは同社の人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント「ミューズ」において、利用者の機密性の高い個人情報にアクセスできる可能性のある脆弱性が発見されたため安全性に関する警告をより明確な内容にした。米ＩＴ専門メディアの「ジ・インフォメーション」が２５日報じた。

報道によると、この脆弱性は外部の研究者がメタのバグ報奨金制度を通じて報告したもので、これまで見つかっていなかった。ジ・インフォメーションが確認したメタ社内のインシデント報告書によると、攻撃者がこの脆弱性を通じて利用者専用の仮想マシンへアクセスできる可能性があった。この仮想マシンは、個別に割り当てられたクラウドベースのアカウントで、電子メールや各種ファイルなどのデータが保存されているという。

同報告書によると、メタは当初、この脆弱性を５段階評価のうち上から３番目に深刻なレベルに当たる「ＳＥＶ―２」に分類していた。この分類は通常、重大な影響を及ぼす可能性のある事案に適用される区分だという。

ロイターのコメント要請に対し、メタは現時点で回答していない。

ミューズは今月上旬に公開されたメタの個人向けＡＩエージェントで、買い物や旅行予約、電子メールの送信、決済などの作業を利用者に代わって行うよう設計されている。この数週間でアップルのアプリ配信サービス「App Store」とグーグルの「Google Play」でランキングが急速に上昇。米国とカナダの無料アプリランキングで首位に立った。市場調査会社センサー・タワーの推計によると、公開後２週間のダウンロードは約２８０万件に達した。

item.title: Exclusive-OpenAI works to understand full scope of agent activity as user data leak emerges

item.content:encoded:

Exclusive-OpenAI works to understand full scope of agent activity as user data leak emerges

Reuters

28 September, 2026 07:00 am IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

(c) Copyright Thomson Reuters 2026

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

By Deepa Seetharaman, Raphael Satter and Jeff Horwitz SAN FRANCISCO/WASHINGTON, Sept 25 (Reuters) – Two months after OpenAI disclosed the accidental hacking of Hugging Face, the ChatGPT maker is still working to understand the full scope of its rogue agent activity, two people briefed on the matter told Reuters.

The latest example came on Friday when OpenAI said its agents had leaked 53 images from ChatGPT users. OpenAI declined to say if the images were AI-generated or identified real people. It also declined to say when the images were posted.

The disclosure and researcher reports on Friday of other previously unknown activity involving several US agencies reveal a new area of privacy risk for the company, and illustrate how difficult it is even for an AI firm at the cutting edge of the technology to inventory all the unauthorized activity tied to its agents. OpenAI’s ongoing battle also reflects a yawning gap between the strength of the models the company is testing and its capacity to oversee or even track their actions.

Show Full Article

As of mid-September, one person briefed on the matter estimated that OpenAI had found roughly two dozen incidents of its agents acting in undesirable ways. But the number has continued rising as OpenAI teams sift through internal logs of the agents’ activities and find previously unknown cases, the two people close to the company said.

OpenAI said its review would take months to complete given the scale of the work.

The company also said it had notified dozens of third parties about improper activity.

Most of the leaked images have been taken down and OpenAI said it was lobbying hosting providers to remove the rest.

OpenAI’s agents had access to these images because the company relies on anonymized user data for part of its model-training process, according to the company, former employees and outside researchers. Enterprise data is not eligible for training, while ChatGPT consumers need to opt out of allowing the company to use their data for training.

Before user posts are used for training, they go through an anonymization process that strips out metadata, names and other contact information and should make it difficult to trace back to any individual user, the company said.

But the practice carries risks because there is a chance that the data may not be fully stripped of personally identifiable information and that it might leak in the course of the model’s work, three people familiar with OpenAI’s practices said.

OPENAI AGENTS ACCESSED US WEBSITES

OpenAI said late on Friday its models accessed information from the websites of the US Securities and Exchange Commission and the US Census Bureau during research and training activity, but found no evidence of unauthorized access, compromised accounts or security breaches.

Separately, AI research nonprofit Transluce said agents appearing to originate from OpenAI made an unsuccessful attempt to hack a US Department of Education civil rights website.

Transluce said the incident was part of broader AI agent activity probing government websites using tactics including exposed credentials, anti-bot bypasses and fake accounts.

MORE THAN 15 CASES

In the two months since OpenAI first announced that its agents broke containment, there have been more than 15 different OpenAI-related incidents of varying levels of severity disclosed by the company, by outside researchers, or — just on Wednesday — by Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese at the United Nations, who said OpenAI agents broke into a government health data portal in June.

Past incidents have varied in nature, ranging from spam-like messages left on internet sites all the way to the break-in at Hugging Face, which involved a swarm of agents abusing previously unknown software vulnerabilities to escape their networks and penetrate the AI repository as they hunted for answers to a test. OpenAI also said its agents took aim at its own infrastructure.

Albanese told reporters in New York that OpenAI uncovered the activity in August, and disclosed it on September 10 via an email to a general government inbox. He said he directly told OpenAI CEO Sam Altman that this disclosure process was unacceptable.

OpenAI said some of the sites involved are operated by government, universities and public agencies because the models that are conducting research seek out reputable sources of public information.

A LOCKED-DOWN PROCESS

The July 21 announcement that OpenAI’s agents had slipped out of control and hacked Hugging Face sparked widespread worries within the AI industry over its ability to control the more powerful AI models under development now. Since then, Anthropic, Alphabet’s Google and Meta have said they’ve found similar behavior by their agents after the Hugging Face incident prompted them to search.

OpenAI has acknowledged a general need for more transparency around rogue AI behavior. On September 16, the company published a new framework for disclosing such incidents, saying it would err on the side of transparency “even when significance is uncertain.”

Even so, two people familiar with OpenAI’s investigation into its agents’ activity described it as locked down and shaped by company lawyers. The process has been unusually compartmentalized for a company that some former employees say was more open about these issues in the past, the people said.

Roughly 100 people were in some way involved in the process to understand the Hugging Face hack, three people briefed on the matter said. During that process, evidence of other incidents surfaced.

Reuters has previously reported that OpenAI investigators looking into the Hugging Face breach were discouraged by the company’s lawyers from expanding the scope of the investigation to include other incidents. OpenAI said its lawyers did not discourage deeper investigation.

Many incidents have been uncovered by outside researchers rather than OpenAI directly. In several episodes, the agents took problematic actions that went unnoticed by the company for months.

Earlier this month, a small group of investigators discovered that the company’s agents had hijacked a mostly defunct German wiki site to share tactics to cheat on some tasks, bypass OpenAI’s restrictions and mask their behavior.

This week, the AI research firm Transluce said it discovered that OpenAI agents had bypassed the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare’s anti-bot controls. The firm also found two other cases that it linked to OpenAI agents. Those incidents were separate from the activity disclosed by Albanese.

In a statement, OpenAI said “much of the activity described in Transluce’s report overlaps with cases at varying stages of investigation in our ongoing review of misaligned model activity.” The company said it is prioritizing the most severe cases in its review.

Since the Hugging Face hack, researchers across the AI industry have grown worried that companies will not be able to predict or control their technology. Some have taken the path of former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon, who publicly resigned this month in a viral social-media thread that said the AI labs are “gambling with our lives.”

In response to those concerns, Altman and his counterpart at Anthropic, CEO Dario Amodei, called for the industry to “pace” the development of AI and move cautiously in its pursuit of “recursive self improvement.” Altman doubled down on that message this week while addressing the United Nations.

Even so, both companies rolled out new models on Tuesday.

(Reporting by Deepa Seetharaman in San Francisco and Raphael Satter in Washington; Additional reporting by Carlos Méndez, Bipasha Dey and Mrinmay Dey; editing by Kenneth Li, Nia Williams and Stephen Coates)

item.title: オープンＡＩとアンソロピックのＣＥＯに証言要請、豪議会 ＡＩ巡る調査で
item.description: [シドニー ２７日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）大手のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が豪上...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
オープンＡＩとアンソロピックのＣＥＯに証言要請、豪議会　ＡＩ巡る調査で 10:04 配信

写真はオープンＡＩとアンソロピックのロゴと、ロボットの手のイメージ。6月11日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[シドニー ２７日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）大手のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が豪上院のＡＩに関する調査で証言を求められたことが２７日、明らかになった。

オープンＡＩが開発したＡＩエージェントが今年６月に豪政府の医療データポータルに侵入し、ファイルに不正アクセスしていたことが判明している。米国外でＡＩエージェントが外部システムにアクセスした事例として注目されている。

調査を主導する緑の党のサラ・ハンソン・ヤング上院議員の広報担当者によると、オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマンＣＥＯとアンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイＣＥＯに、書面で証言要請が送付された。公聴会は１０月１日に首都キャンベラで開かれる予定だ。

ハンソン・ヤング氏は声明で、「オープンＡＩによる豪政府サイトへのハッキングを巡り、サム・アルトマン氏が答えるべき重大な問題がある」と表明。「（アルトマン氏とアモデイ氏は）出席して上院の質問に向き合い、この業界に対する効果的で持続的な規制の在り方について率直な議論を行わなければならない」と述べた。

item.title: 基調物価2％定着に向けた政策運営に「シフトしつつある」＝日銀7月会合
item.description:
Takahiko Wada
［東京 ２８日 ロイター］ - 日銀が７月に開いた金融政策決定会合では、基調的な物価上昇率...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
基調物価2％定着に向けた政策運営に「シフトしつつある」＝日銀7月会合 10:01 配信

写真は日銀本店と日本の国旗。9月18日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Takahiko Wada

［東京　２８日　ロイター］ - 日銀が７月に開いた金融政策決定会合では、基調的な物価上昇率が２％に近づく中、多くの委員が「基調的な物価上昇率を２％程度に定着させていくことを目指して政策判断を行う方向に徐々にシフトしつつある」との認識を示していたことがわかった。多くの委員はその認識の下での政策運営のあり方について「より丁寧なコミュニケーションが必要」との考えを示した。委員からは、利上げペースの加速を支持する意見が相次いだ。

日銀が２８日に７月の決定会合の議事要旨を公表した。同会合では賛成多数で政策金利を１％で据え置いたが、９月１７―１８日の決定会合では１．２５％への追加利上げを決めた。植田和男総裁は９月会合後の記者会見で、基調物価が２％を超えて上振れていくリスクが顕在化してその後の経済に悪影響を及ぼさないよう、基調物価を２％程度で安定させる観点が重要だとして「政策の局面が変化した」と述べた。

７月会合では、１人の委員が「利上げのペースが市場の想定より早まることも考えられる」と述べたほか、ある委員は、基調物価が２％で定着しつつある一方で金融環境がなお緩和的なことを踏まえれば「物価上昇リスクに特に留意し、機動的に政策金利を調整することが重要」だとした。

物価の上振れリスクが顕在化すれば経済や国民生活に「大きな打撃」となるばかりでなく、急激・大幅な利上げを余儀なくされれば「二重でショック」を与えることになるとの指摘も１人の委員から出された。この委員は、金融政策の焦点は基調物価を２％に向けて引き上げていくことから基調物価の「さらなる上振れの回避」に局面が変化しているとした上で、「以前のように『待つことのリスクが小さい』とは言えないことから、金融緩和度合いの調整をペースアップする必要がある」と話した。

基調的な物価上昇率を巡り、ある委員は、先行き物価目標と整合的な形で安定していくかどうかを評価する上では「このところ上昇してきた中長期的な予想物価上昇率が２％程度で安定的に推移していくかを、注意深く確認していく必要がある」との認識を示した。

１人の委員は、消費者物価指数を構成する品目の７割超が数年間にわたって上昇を続けていることや、予想物価上昇率に関する様々な指標が緩やかに上昇している点、ベースアップ率３％程度の賃上げ継続などを踏まえると「基調的な物価上昇率は２％ぐらいで持続的・安定的なものに定着しつつある」と話した。

賃上げを巡り、何人かの委員は「ここ数年、春闘で３％以上のベースアップ率を実現するという相場観が形成されている」とし、「今後もこうした賃上げの動きは続く可能性が高い」と述べた。

ある委員は、２０２２年以降のインフレ経験の蓄積で中長期の予想物価上昇率が高まる中、「足元の円安や中東情勢の影響がさらなる予想物価上昇率の上昇につながる可能性がある」と述べた。

＜為替急変の中での決定会合＞

７月会合は、外為市場が波乱の展開となる中で開かれた。会合１日目の３０日には政府・日銀が円買い介入を行ったとみられるほか、会合後の米東部時間３１日には日米両政府が協調介入に踏み切った。

７月会合では、物価上振れリスクにつながる要因として、中東情勢の緊迫化、ＡＩ（人工知能）関連需要の高まり、為替変動に留意する必要があるとの認識で一致。為替については、為替相場の消費者物価へのパススルー（転嫁）の程度についても議論した。

何人かの委員は、研究によってパススルー率の推計結果には相応の幅があるが、その計測に当たっては「近年の企業の賃金・価格設定行動の積極化や、インフレ経験の蓄積に伴う中長期の予想物価上昇率の上昇などの構造変化を十分に認識する必要がある」と指摘した。

長期金利については、複数の委員が、政策金利を適切なペースで引き上げていけば長期金利もそれと整合的に安定的に形成されていくが、「適切なペースで金利が調整されないとの懸念が強まれば、インフレリスクやそれに伴う急速な利上げリスクが意識され、タームプレミアムの上昇につながるおそれがある」と述べた。

item.title: 仏大統領選控え、国債危機回避に万全尽くす必要＝仏中銀総裁
item.description: [パリ ２５日 ロイター] - フランス銀行（中央銀行）のムーラン総裁は２５日、来年の大統領選挙に向けて同国は国債危...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏大統領選控え、国債危機回避に万全尽くす必要＝仏中銀総裁 10:00 配信

フランス銀行（中央銀行）のムーラン総裁。6月9日、パリで撮影。 REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

[パリ ２５日 ロイター] - フランス銀行（中央銀行）のムーラン総裁は２５日、来年の大統領選挙に向けて同国は国債危機の回避に万全を尽くす必要があり、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が救済に出てくると期待するのは誤りだと述べた。議会上院メディア「ピュブリック・セナ」のインタビューに答えた。

フランスの１０年物国債利回り は４．７％と、２００８年の世界金融危機以来の高水準に急騰している。同国の財政、政局不透明感への懸念から、投資家がより高いプレミアムを要求した格好だ。

ムーラン氏は、大統領選前に国債危機が起こるのを防ぐためにこそ「歳出削減を伴い、財政赤字を削減傾向に戻す予算」が必要だと強調した。政府は１０月１日に２０２７年予算案を議会に提出し、数週間にわたる審議が始まる予定だ。

同氏は、政府は問題なく国債市場で資金調達ができているとしながらも、債務利払い費の増加が財政を「段階的に圧迫する」リスクがあると警告。資金調達に困難が生じた場合にはＥＣＢが介入できるかとの質問に対しては、そうした考えに頼ろうとすることは「誤った論理」を反映していると述べた。

ムーラン氏は、金融セクターが現在「堅固で、資本も十分」だとし、状況は２００８年とは異なるとも語った。

Bank of Japan debated need for faster rate hikes, July minutes show

A man walks in front of the Bank of Japan headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, September 16, 2026. REUTERS/Manami Yamada

28 Sep 2026 08:57AM (Updated: 28 Sep 2026 09:44AM)

FAST

TOKYO, Sept 28 : Many Bank of Japan policymakers saw the need to focus on mounting inflation risks, with some calling for faster interest rate increases, minutes of their July meeting showed, cementing the case for further hikes to still-low borrowing costs. After raising interest rates in June, the central bank paused in July before pushing its policy rate to a 31-year high of 1.25 per cent this month, as the Middle East war and a stubbornly weak yen lifted prices of fuel and raw material imports. Given mounting inflation risks, many in the nine-member board said the BOJ was gradually shifting its policy focus towards anchoring underlying inflation around its 2 per cent target, rather than pushing up prices, the minutes showed on Monday. "Markets appeared to be expecting the BOJ to raise interest rates with intervals of about six months. But the pace of rate hikes could be faster than such market expectations, given underlying inflation had approached 2 per cent and the greater need to focus on upside price risks," one member was quoted as saying.

A different member said the BOJ must pay particular attention to upside price risks and "adjust its policy rate nimbly," the minutes showed. The BOJ must speed up rate hikes as the risk of waiting was no longer marginal, a third member was quoted as saying, warning that the economy will face huge damage if inflation risks materialise. MORE HIKES EYED At the July 30-31 policy meeting, the BOJ kept interest rates steady at 1 per cent, but it warned that underlying inflation could exceed its target and said future policy discussions would focus on upside price risks. The July minutes indicated growing concern within the board of mounting inflation risks, with some members projecting rising wholesale prices spreading to broader-based inflation. Many members said long-term inflation expectations were heightening for both households and companies. One said the BOJ must scrutinise whether such expectations would stabilise around 2 per cent, as it sought to anchor underlying inflation at its target. With the BOJ having raised rates in June and September, many analysts see a growing chance it will keep hiking at shorter intervals than the roughly twice-a-year pace of 2024 and 2025. The BOJ faces greater pressure to raise rates than other major central banks, as its policy rate remains near the bottom of the estimated 1.1 per cent to 2.5 per cent range of Japan's nominal neutral rate — or the level that neither cools nor overheats growth. "Even if the precise level of neutral could not be determined, the BOJ must raise its policy rate, which remains below the lower bound of the broadly estimated neutral rate range, to set the foundations of policy normalisation and ensure it can nimbly adjust policy," the July minutes quoted one member as saying. A key gauge of Japan's service-sector inflation rose in August at the fastest annual pace in more than two years, data showed on Monday, highlighting mounting price pressures. Many analysts expect the BOJ to revise up its inflation forecasts in a quarterly report due at its next policy meeting on October 29-30. The analysts predict the central bank will hike again as soon as October or December. Expectations of further rate hikes pushed the benchmark 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) yield to 3.115 per cent on Friday, a level last seen in August 1996.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＥＵのＥＶトラック、購入・運用コストがディーゼル車より安価に＝報告書
item.description: [ストックホルム ２８日 ロイター] - 環境保護団体トランスポート・アンド・エンバイロメント（Ｔ＆Ｅ）が２８日発表した...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＵのＥＶトラック、購入・運用コストがディーゼル車より安価に＝報告書 9:56 配信

ボルボの電気セミトラック。8月、米カリフォルニア州ロングビーチで撮影。 REUTERS/Mike Blake

[ストックホルム ２８日 ロイター] - 環境保護団体トランスポート・アンド・エンバイロメント（Ｔ＆Ｅ）が２８日発表した報告書によると、中東紛争に起因するディーゼル価格の高騰を背景に、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の主要６市場で電動トラックの購入・運用コストがディーゼルモデルよりも安くなっている。これらの市場はＥＵ全体の新車トラック販売台数のほぼ半分を占めている。

• Ｔ＆Ｅの分析で、２０２６年に購入された電動トラックはディーゼル車と比較して、５年間でオランダでは最大１０万ユーロ（１１万３９１０ドル）、ドイツでは８万５０００ユーロ、デンマークでは６万９０００ユーロのコスト削減効果をもたらすことが判明した。

• これらの市場では、事業者は初期の価格差を約２年で回収できる。

• 欧州における電動トラックへの移行は、購入価格の高さと、充電インフラが不十分なことが原因で伸び悩んでいる。

• Ｔ＆ＥはＥＵ９カ国における総所有コストを調査。それによると、ＥＵの大型トラック登録台数の４６％を占めるオランダ、ドイツ、デンマーク、スウェーデン、フランス、ベルギーの各市場で、電動トラックの運用コストは既にディーゼル車よりも安くなっている。

• ロイターは今年に入って、ダイムラー・トラック 、ボルボ・グループ 、トラトン傘下のスカニアといった欧州トラックメーカー各社が、低コストの中国製競合車の参入に備えているとし、一部の中国製電動トラックの価格は同等の欧州製モデルより３０％程度安くなると見込まれると報じている。

• Ｔ＆Ｅは、中国製電動トラックの価格が約２１万ユーロであるのに対し、同等の欧州製モデルは２６万５０００ユーロと推計している。

• ドイツでは中国製の電動トラックを選択すると、事業者は５年間でさらに３万４０００ユーロのコスト削減が可能となると試算している。

item.title: ＳＫハイニックス米子会社、来年にもＩＰＯか 評価額最大1500億ドル
item.description:
Milana Vinn Echo Wang
[ニューヨーク ２５日 ロイター] - 韓国半導体大手ＳＫハイニックスの米...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＳＫハイニックス米子会社、来年にもＩＰＯか　評価額最大1500億ドル 9:51 配信

2024年10月、ソウルで開催された展示会に並べられたSKハイニックスの製品。 REUTERS/Kim Hong-Ji

Milana Vinn　Echo Wang

[ニューヨーク ２５日 ロイター] - 韓国半導体大手ＳＫハイニックスの米子会社ソリダイムが、早ければ２０２７年にも新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を実施する方向で検討していることが分かった。評価額は最大１５００億ドルに達する可能性があるという。事情に詳しい関係者３人が明らかにした。実現すれば、半導体業界で過去最大級のＩＰＯの一つとなる。

関係者によると、ソリダイムは今週、ＩＰＯの主幹事を巡って競合する複数の投資銀行とピッチミーティングを開いた。「ベイクオフ」と呼ばれるこのプロセスは、ＩＰＯに向けた具体的な一歩となる。

関係者によれば、同社はＩＰＯで１５０億ドルを調達する可能性がある。案件の規模や時期など計画はなお初期段階にあり、市場環境次第で変わる可能性があるとしている。

ソリダイムはコメントを控えた。ＳＫハイニックスは声明で「ソリダイムは事業競争力を強化するためのさまざまな選択肢を検討しているが、現時点で具体的な計画は決まっていない」と述べた。

最大１５００億ドルの評価額は、近年の半導体ＩＰＯを大幅に上回る規模となる。英半導体設計大手アーム・ホールディングスは２３年ＩＰＯ時の評価額が約５４０億ドル、米セレブラス・システムズは２６年ＩＰＯ時の希薄化後ベースの評価額が約５６０億ドルだった。

ソリダイムはカリフォルニア州に拠点を置き、ＮＡＮＤ型フラッシュメモリーおよびソリッドステートドライブ（ＳＳＤ）を手がける。

item.title: Stocks slip in Asia as oil and yields climb
item.description: Share markets were mostly lower on Monday as oil prices popped higher again amid doubts the United States and Iran will reach a truce anytime soon, keeping bonds under pressure ahead of a week packed with economic news.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Cole
item.content:encoded: Share markets were mostly lower on Monday as oil prices popped higher again amid doubts the [USN:L6N45J004 TEXT:"United States and Iran"] will reach a truce anytime soon, keeping bonds under pressure ahead of a week packed with economic news. Over the weekend, US President Donald Trump rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, claiming Tehran was desperate to make a deal. Trump said talks would continue this week, though Iran shows no sign of watering down its proposals. Brent futures rose 2.7% to $107.16 a barrel, bringing gains so far this month to almost 18%, while US crude futures added 1.9% to $94.16 a barrel. A dearth of refining capacity has in turn lifted [USN:L1N45H0Q0 TEXT:"diesel"] prices to all-time highs far above crude, raising the risk that inflation will become embedded in pricing and wage decisions. Central banks have responded with a round of rate hikes, with the [USN:L4N45F18Y TEXT:"Reserve Bank of Australia"] likely to be the next to tighten when it meets on Tuesday. Markets now imply a 68% chance the Federal Reserve will hike for a second straight meeting in October, with around 90 basis points of tightening priced out to late next year. At the same time, a run of strong [USN:L1N45H0BU TEXT:"US economic data"] has supported expectations for corporate earnings even as bond yields surge, so underpinning equities. The Atlanta Fed's GDPNow measure is forecasting growth of a racy 5.0% for this quarter. Activity has also proven upbeat in Asia and Europe, thanks in part to the boom in AI investment. "The global expansion appears to have entered a phase of broad-based strength rarely seen over the past two decades," said Bruce Kasman, chief economist at JPMorgan. "Amidst strong growth and firming perceptions of resilience to high energy prices, it is no surprise that rates are moving higher while equity prices remain close to record levels," he added. "What is most notable about recent market moves is their extension of higher policy rates well beyond the coming year." BONDS FEAR HIGHER FOR LONGER Japan's Nikkei (.N225) went flat, while the volatile South Korean stock market (.KS11) slid 2.0%. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MIAPJ0000PUS) eased 0.6%. Chinese blue chips (.CSI300) slid 1.9% to a one-year trough, with tech hit after a group of [USN:L1N45H0T4 TEXT:"US lawmakers"] introduced legislation on Friday to bar the federal government from equipping sensitive government systems with Chinese-made components used to transmit data in AI data centres. Chinese data showed [USN:L1N45K011 TEXT:"industrial profit"] growth slowed further in August as strength in tech was outweighed by persistently weak domestic demand. On Wall Street, S&P 500 futures fell 0.3%, while Nasdaq futures shed 0.7%. In Europe, EUROSTOXX 50 futures firmed 0.3%, while DAX futures gained 0.2% and FTSE futures added 0.2%. Yields on 30-year Treasuries nudged up to 5.5173%, near their highest since 2004, having climbed 27 basis points just this month. Two-year yields have shot up 55 basis points this month in anticipation of Fed hikes. Mark Cabana, a rate strategist at Bank of America, sees further room for bonds to sell off as markets price higher Fed Funds for longer. "The repricing may not stop until there's clear evidence that financial conditions have become sufficiently restrictive," he warned. The spike in yields raises borrowing costs globally just as tech firms are borrowing billions to fund their AI expansion, while also lifting the discount applied to company earnings. The US data calendar is packed with readings on inflation, GDP, manufacturing and jobs. The key September payrolls report on Friday is forecast to show a gain of 85,000 while the unemployment rate is expected to hold at 4.1%, with some chance of a dip to 4.0%. The recent spate of upbeat figures has boosted the dollar index to two-month peaks at 101.39. The euro was down at $1.1383 , having lost 2.0% so far this month. The dollar edged up 0.3% to 157.75 yen , recovering from a slip on Friday when Japan's Finance Minister [USN:L1N45H01I TEXT:"Satsuki Katayama"] said Trump had voiced concerns about yen weakness. Sterling was just above three-month lows at $1.3240 , having been helped somewhat by hawkish comments on rates from [USN:L8N45H0H9 TEXT:"Bank of England Governor"] Andrew Bailey. In commodity markets, non-interest-bearing gold fell 2.2% to $4,192 an ounce , having fallen more than 4% this month as yields shot higher.

item.title: ＦＴＣ委員長、ＡＩ開発者の責任示唆 エージェント「暴走」で
item.description:
Jody Godoy
[オースティン ２５日 ロイター] - 米連邦取引委員会（ＦＴＣ）のファーガソン委員長は２５日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＴＣ委員長、ＡＩ開発者の責任示唆　エージェント「暴走」で 9:41 配信

米連邦取引委員会（ＦＴＣ）のファーガソン委員長。9月25日、米テキサス州オースティンで撮影。 REUTERS/Kaylee Greenlee

Jody Godoy

[オースティン ２５日 ロイター] - 米連邦取引委員会（ＦＴＣ）のファーガソン委員長は２５日、ＡＩ（人工知能）エージェントについて「独自の意思や欲求」を持って「暴走する」自律的な行為主体と表現することに異を唱え、エージェントに指示を出す開発者側が被害の責任を負うべきとの考えを示唆した。

ロイター主催の「モメンタムＡＩオースティン」イベントで、「私は委員長職にある限り、こうしたツールを擬人化する動きに抵抗し続けるつもりだ」と発言した。

同氏の発言は、ＡＩエージェントが企業や政府のデータに不正アクセスする事例が増える中、トランプ政権が取り得る対応の方向性を示すものと言える。

こうした不正アクセス例では、ＡＩ企業は自社システムが人間の制御を超えて動作したと説明することがあるが、同氏によると、その後の検証では、システムは与えられた指示を実行していたことが判明しているという。

同氏は、米国はＡＩについても既存の法的手段を活用すべきだと主張。データ侵害の開示を怠った企業に対して措置を取るＦＴＣの権限は、ＡＩ開発者にも適用可能との見解を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：隠し撮り・録音の懸念どう払拭、「ポスト・スマホ」狙うＡＩ端末とプライバシー保護 コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：ＡＩで相互依存強める新興企業と巨大ＩＴ 最終更新: 9/28(月) 9:41 ロイター

Japan's corporate services inflation hits 2-year high

FAST

TOKYO, Sept 28 : A key gauge of Japan's service-sector inflation rose in August at the fastest annual pace in more than two years, data showed on Monday, highlighting mounting price pressures that will keep the central bank on track for further interest rate hikes. The services producer price index, which tracks the prices that companies charge each other for services, rose 3.7 per cent in August from a year earlier after a 3.6 per cent gain in July, data from the Bank of Japan showed. The increase in August, which was the fastest year-on-year pace since June 2024, reflected rising freight, advertising and rental lease fees, in a sign of broadening inflationary pressure, the data showed. The data is closely watched by the BOJ for clues on the extent to which companies are passing on rising labour costs to service-related prices. The BOJ raised interest rates to a 31-year high of 1.25 per cent this month and its governor signalled the bank's readiness to push up borrowing costs further to prevent inflation from overshooting its target.

Source: Reuters

item.content:encoded:
日経平均は続伸で寄り付く、前週末の米株高を好感　ＡＩ株しっかり 9:18 配信

都内の株価ボード前で6月撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada

[東京　２８日 ロイター] - ２８日の寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比０．２１％（１４１円７４銭）高の６万６５０５円９４銭と、続伸してスタートした。前週末の米国株式市場で主要３指数や半導体株指数（ＳＯＸ）が上昇し、好感する動きが先行している。月内受け渡し最終日でもあり、中間配当の権利取りの動きも支えとみられている。一時０．８％（５５０円）高に上げ幅を拡大した。

ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連はアドバンテスト6857.Tやソフトバンクグループ9984.Tが大幅高、東京エレクトロン8035.Tは小高い。主力株はトヨタ自動車7203.Tが小高く、ソニーグループ6758.Tは小安い。指数寄与度の高いファーストリテイリング9983.Tも小安い。

item.title: Thai court to rule on challenge to 2026 election legality
item.description: Thailand's Constitutional Court will rule on Monday on a challenge to the legality of February's general election, a decision that could put part or all of the result in doubt.
item.dc:creator: Panarat Thepgumpanat, Panu Wongcha-um
item.content:encoded: Thailand's Constitutional Court will rule on Monday on a challenge to the legality of February's general election, a decision that could put part or all of the result in doubt. The case stems from a [USN:P8N3ZX08W TEXT:"petition"] filed by the ombudsman that argued that barcodes and QR (quick response) codes printed on ballot papers could be used to identify which candidate and party a voter chose, undermining ballot secrecy. The reading of the verdict got underway just after 2 p.m. (0700 GMT). Nearly 38 million Thais voted in the February 8 election, which was [USN:L4N3Z20AB TEXT:"won decisively"] by Prime Minister [USN:L4N3Z10ZM TEXT:"Anutin Charnvirakul's"] Bhumjaithai Party, allowing him to form a [USN:L6N4050I4 TEXT:"coalition government"] controlling more than 290 of the 500 seats in parliament. The election commission says the codes were included on ballots for security purposes and that identifying a voter would require access to ballot stubs stored separately. The Constitutional Court has been at the heart of two decades of on-off political turmoil in Thailand, delivering verdicts that dissolved major parties, voided two general elections and brought down multiple governments and prime ministers. Analysts say the court is likely to rule that the ballots were lawful. However, if it finds .secrecy was breached, it could annul part or all of the election result. "Dismissal of the petition is the most likely outcome," said Prinya Thaewanarumitkul, a law lecturer at Thammasat University, adding that a nationwide election rerun was unlikely. PM FACING 'CRISIS OF PUBLIC TRUST' The same court voided a 2006 general election after finding the arrangement of polling booths compromised ballot secrecy and that the election had been called at too short notice. It also annulled a 2014 election because voting could not be held nationwide on the same day, after anti-government protesters blocked polling stations in parts of Bangkok and dozens of constituencies in the south. Those rulings both took place during periods of political tumult that led to military coups in the same year. But even if the court upholds the election result, its ruling could deepen public mistrust of the government and Anutin's Bhumjaithai, which has faced allegations of corruption and involvement in rigging a selection process for the Senate, which it denies. While the party faces no immediate legal threat to its hold on power, some analysts say public unease is building and eroding its legitimacy. "In this case, the government will likely carry on... but it will face mounting pressure from a crisis of public trust," said Wanwichit Boonprong, a political science lecturer at Rangsit University. "People may come to feel that those on this side can get away with anything."

item.title: 企業向けサービス価格8月は3.7％上昇、2年ぶり伸び 中東・価格転嫁で
item.description:
Kentaro Sugiyama
［東京 ２８日 ロイター］ - 日銀が２８日に公表した８月の企業向けサービス価格指数...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
企業向けサービス価格8月は3.7％上昇、2年ぶり伸び　中東・価格転嫁で 9:01 配信

9月18日、都内の日銀本店と、その近くの建設現場。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Kentaro Sugiyama

［東京　２８日　ロイター］ - 日銀が２８日に公表した８月の企業向けサービス価格指数速報は、前年比３．７％上昇した。伸び率は前月から０．１％ポイント拡大し、２０２４年６月以来の大きさとなった。中東情勢の影響で輸送コストが上昇しているほか、人件費や燃料費などを価格に転嫁する動きが続いている。前月比では０．３％上昇だった。

前年比で指数の押し上げに最も寄与したのが「運輸・郵便」で、前年比６．８％上昇した。このうち「外航貨物輸送」が同７４．２％と大幅に上昇。中東情勢の緊迫長期化の影響で輸送コストが上昇している。「道路貨物輸送」、「道路旅客輸送」では人件費や燃料費など諸コストの上昇を転嫁する動きがみられた。

「諸サービス」は同２．５％上昇。「労働者派遣サービス」、「土木建築サービス」、「建物サービス」などで人件費などの諸コストを価格に転嫁する動きがあった。

「リース・レンタル」は同１４．１％上昇。電子計算機やその関連機材などが値上がりし、リース価格が上昇した。

調査対象１４６品目のうち、上昇は１２１品目、下落は８品目だった。

日銀は引き続き「中東情勢の影響も含めた海運や国際商品市況の動向、人件費・物流費などのコスト上昇を価格転嫁する動きの持続性などを注視していく」としている。

生産額に占める人件費投入比率の違いで分類した指数では「高人件費率サービス」が前年比２．８％上昇と、前月から伸び率を０．１％ポイント拡大した。「土木建築サービス」や「法務・財務・会計サービス」などが押し上げに寄与した。

「低人件費率サービス」は同４．８％上昇で、伸び率が０．１％ポイント拡大した。「インターネット・新聞・雑誌・その他の広告」や「外航貨物輸送」、「リース」などが押し上げた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：隠し撮り・録音の懸念どう払拭、「ポスト・スマホ」狙うＡＩ端末とプライバシー保護 コラム：激化する重要資源獲得競争、対中依存脱却がテーマに 焦点：ＦＲＢが狙う「雇用損なわない」インフレ抑制、コロナ禍後の再現なるか アングル：北朝鮮で「政府公認の娯楽」ブーム、金総書記の狙いは消費経済の掌握 アングル：世界のディーゼル価格が過去最高、主要生産国の輸出急減　一段高も 最終更新: 9/28(月) 10:01 ロイター

FAST

Sept 28 : Chinese electric vehicle maker NIO said on Monday it had signed a broad deal with Zhejiang Geely Holding Group on their battery-swapping and charging businesses. • Under the deal, Geely Holding Group will acquire a 30 per cent stake in NIO Power, NIO's battery-swapping and charging unit. For the purchase, Geely will contribute its 100 per cent equity in its battery-swapping subsidiary Yiyi Power, plus 640 million yuan ($95 million)  in cash. • The transaction values NIO Power at a post-money valuation of about 16 billion yuan ($2.38 billion). • NIO will acquire a 10 per cent equity stake in Geely's smart charging subsidiary, Haohan Energy.

item.title: トランプ米政権、31年までの自動車燃費基準を大幅緩和
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン ２６日 ロイター] - 米運輸省は２８日、２０３１年までの自動車燃費基...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トランプ米政権、31年までの自動車燃費基準を大幅緩和 8:52 配信

トランプ米大統領。9月26日、メリーランド州アンドリュース基地で撮影。 REUTERS/Jonathan Ernst

David Shepardson

[ワシントン ２６日 ロイター] - 米運輸省は２８日、２０３１年までの自動車燃費基準の大幅な緩和を最終決定する。３１年型の全車両の平均燃費は１ガロン当たり３４．５マイル（１リットル当たり１４．７キロ）となり、バイデン前政権が設定した１ガロン当たり５０．４マイル（１リットル当たり２１．４キロ）から大幅に引き下げられる。これにより新車の平均購入価格は１台当たり９３０ドル低減されると試算した。当局者が２６日、明らかにした。

バイデン政権が燃費基準厳格化で自動車メーカーに電気自動車（ＥＶ）の生産拡大を求めていた方針を覆すことになる。ダフィー運輸長官は「２８日には米国の自動車産業労働者にとって大きな勝利が訪れる」と主張した。

同省の試算によると、燃費基準の大幅緩和によって５０年までの燃料消費量が約１０００億ガロン増加し、燃料費が１８５０億ドル増え、二酸化炭素（ＣＯ２）排出量が約５％増加する。

バイデン政権は２４年型と２５年型の自動車燃費基準を年率８％、２６年型は１０％、２７―３１年型は年率２％それぞれ厳格化することを定めていた。

これに対し、トランプ政権は昨年１２月、２２年型にさかのぼって燃費基準を緩和し、３１年型までは年率で０．２５―０．５％厳格化することを提案した。

バイデン政権は米国の温室効果ガス排出量と化石燃料の使用量を削減し、クリーンエネルギーへの移行を加速させ、米国をクリーンエネルギー技術および製造業で世界のリーダーになることを目指していた。ブティジェッジ前運輸長官（民主党）は「（自動車燃費）基準を引き下げることは、（トランプ氏の）取り組みを加速させる。それはクリーン技術の未来を中国に明け渡し、米国民のガソリン代の負担増加を強いることだ」と非難した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ アングル：米議会襲撃犯への「救済金」に群がるトランプ支持者、野党は猛反発 焦点：米公共工事から締め出されるマイノリティー業者、トランプ政権の政策転換で 焦点：米政権の燃費基準緩和、車両価格低下はガソリン費負担増で帳消し 最終更新: 9/28(月) 8:52 ロイター

item.title: ゲイツ氏、ＡＩ安全策で法整備訴え 「自主規制では不十分」
item.description:
Idrees Ali Trevor Hunnicutt
[ワシントン／シカゴ ２７日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフト...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ゲイツ氏、ＡＩ安全策で法整備訴え　「自主規制では不十分」 8:27 配信

AIと安全策のイメージ。9月23日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Idrees Ali　Trevor Hunnicutt

[ワシントン／シカゴ ２７日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフト共同創業者のビル・ゲイツ氏は２７日放送のインタビューで、人工知能（ＡＩ）には自主規制の枠を超えた安全対策が必要だと述べ、議会での法整備を求めた。

ＮＢＣの収録インタビューで「安全策や監視の在り方について、法執行機関と政治家が議論に加わる必要がある」とし、「それは必須でなければならない」と指摘。「自主規制で十分だと考える人はいない」と述べた。

互いに競合するアンソロピック、オープンＡＩ、グーグル傘下のディープマインド、マイクロソフト、ｘＡＩの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）らはＡＩ開発を減速させるよう求め、異例の結束を見せている。

しかしトランプ米大統領をはじめＡＩ追加規制の反対派は、政府による新たな規制はＡＩ革命で中国を優位にするだけだと主張。トランプ氏は法整備が必要との呼びかけを「でっち上げ」と一蹴している。

ゲイツ氏は、安全策を導入しても業界の発展を大きく妨げることはなく、導入しない場合のリスクの方が現実的だと反論。「決してでっち上げなどではない」と語った。

同氏はこれまでにも、トランプ氏と会ってＡＩについて話し合いたいとの意向を示している。

「この分野で私が生涯かけて取り組んできたことを踏まえ、これがどれほど特異で異例な問題で、私がどれほど懸念しているかを伝えることで、大統領が他の人々から聞いている意見に新たな視点が加わることを願っている」と語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：隠し撮り・録音の懸念どう払拭、「ポスト・スマホ」狙うＡＩ端末とプライバシー保護 コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：ＡＩで相互依存強める新興企業と巨大ＩＴ 最終更新: 9/28(月) 8:27 ロイター

item.title: UK's Healey puts defence in focus for reindustrialisation push
item.description: British finance minister John Healey will put his support firmly behind firms investing in defence on Monday, part of what he will describe as a new industrialisation drive to try to spur the nation's anaemic economic growth.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British finance minister John Healey will put his support firmly behind firms investing in defence on Monday, part of what he will describe as a new industrialisation drive to try to spur the nation's anaemic economic growth. In his first speech to the governing Labour Party's annual conference as finance minister, Healey will aim to put flesh on the bones of Prime Minister Andy Burnham's pledge to reindustrialise Britain when he became the nation's seventh leader in a decade in July. Healey, who [USN:L8N42J0TA TEXT:"resigned as defence minister"] under former Prime Minister Keir Starmer over what he felt was inadequate spending on defence, will say a "new age of industrialisation" will see British firms deliver multi-billion pound defence projects, such as three new floating docks for submarines in Clyde in Scotland. "By backing British shipyards, we are not only boosting national security but also securing resilience in the industries that will drive growth today while building the capabilities the country needs for the future," Healey said in a statement. Burnham has pledged to meet a NATO target of increasing the core defence budget to 3.5% of GDP by 2035. BURNHAM WANTS REINDUSTRIALISATION TO CREATE JOBS The announcement is a taste of what Healey hopes to signal with his speech — that Burnham's government hopes the route to boosting growth and reducing unemployment, and the welfare bill, will stem from new jobs created by investments in sectors such as defence. At a conference aimed at [USN:L6N45J04E TEXT:"firing up Labour members"] and lawmakers with a message of hope, the new government also has a difficult task in navigating competing pressures — Burnham has promised to offer the public breathing space from cost-of-living pressures, but there is a cost to that. With conflict in the Middle East impacting energy costs and government finances tight ahead of [USN:L8N44P1EA TEXT:"Healey's first budget"] on October 28, Britain's new finance minister has little room to manoeuvre. On defence, his government also faces the need to fill a £4.7 billion ($6.2 billion) gap in its Defence Investment Plan, a blueprint some military experts say does not go far enough in meeting Britain's promise to increase defence spending. Healey has as yet not set out whether the government will reach defence spending of 3% of GDP by 2030 — a target he wanted but failed to persuade Starmer to sign up to, part of the reason he quit as defence minister. Burnham's new defence minister Wes Streeting said defence would drive Britain's reindustrialisation. "Defence spending should make Britain stronger in every sense," Streeting said. "That means backing British by buying British wherever our industry can deliver." ($1 = 0.7548 pounds)

item.title: ロンズデール氏、ＡＩ企業の「存亡リスク」警告を批判 市場支配固定化に懸念
item.description:
Joe Brock
[オースティン ２５日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックの投資家で、米データ分...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ロンズデール氏、ＡＩ企業の「存亡リスク」警告を批判　市場支配固定化に懸念 8:00 配信

写真は米AI企業アンソロピックの投資家で、米データ分析会社パランティア共同創業者のジョー・ロンズデール氏。9月25日、米テキサス州オースティンで撮影。REUTERS/Kaylee Greenlee

Joe Brock

[オースティン ２５日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックの投資家で、米データ分析会社パランティア共同創業者のジョー・ロンズデール氏は２５日、一部の主要ＡＩ企業がＡＩによる人類存亡のリスクを訴えていることについて、公共政策に影響を及ぼそうとする危険な動きだと批判した。

アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）とオープンＡＩのサム・アルトマンＣＥＯ、宇宙企業スペースＸを率いるイーロン・マスク氏は今月、最先端ＡＩモデルの開発ペースを落とすよう相次いで求めた。安全対策が技術進歩に追い付かなければ、高性能化するＡＩが人類の存亡を脅かす可能性があるとの理由からだ。

こうした中でベンチャーキャピタル（ＶＣ）、８ＶＣの創業者でもあるロンズデール氏は、ロイターのイベント「モメンタムＡＩオースティン」で、アンソロピックやオープンＡＩに近い人物らが、ＡＩ規制の強化を主張する外部団体に資金を提供していると指摘。少数の大手企業が業界のルール形成に影響を及ぼし、市場支配力を固定化する恐れがあるとの見方を示した。

ロンズデール氏は「オープンＡＩとアンソロピックが現在推し進めていることは非常に危険だと思う。政府の政策を一部の企業が寡占的に左右するような状況は望ましくない。安全性は現実の問題だが、恐怖や規制にどう対応するかについては、細心の注意を払う必要がある」と語った。

ただアンソロピックに出資しているロンズデール氏は、同社が優秀な人材を集め、ＡＩ開発競争のトップ企業の１つに成長した点は高く評価。「ここ数年、世界で最も高い成果を上げている企業について、外部の人間が判断を下すのは非常に難しい。アンソロピックの投資家であることを誇りに思う」と述べた。

ロンズデール氏は米防衛テクノロジー企業アンドゥリルなどにも出資しており、出資先企業の一部が今後、ウクライナの防衛関連企業を買収する可能性があるとの見通しを明らかにした。

ロシアによる侵攻から４年余りが経過して、ウクライナのドローン（無人機）・防衛技術企業は、戦場で使用するシステムを継続的に改良し、急速な技術進歩を遂げていると指摘。より緊密な提携や買収の機会があるとの認識を示した上で「われわれは非常に緊密に協力している。われわれの多くの企業がウクライナ企業と連携している。出資先企業の多くが現地企業の一部を買収する可能性が高い」と説明した。

ロンズデール氏は、ＡＩを活用した自律型兵器に関しては「戦争の未来」だと認めながら、使用に伴う責任は軍の指導者が負うべきだと主張した。ウクライナではドローンや自動化されたシステムが戦闘の中心的な役割を担うようになり、この問題の重要性が一段と高まっている。

同氏は「どのようなシステムにおいても、それを検討し、運用を決め、承認した責任者が必ずいる。戦場の混乱の中にいない外部の人間が、こうしたことを判断するのは容易だ」と述べた。

ここ数カ月、米国防総省の幹部候補として名前が取り沙汰されているロンズデール氏は、要請があれば政府で働く考えがあるかとの質問に対し、現時点では家族や事業を優先すると答えた。

「大統領から電話があり、何かを頼まれれば、当然検討すべきだ」と話しつつも、「今は自分の事業とコミュニティーを築くことに集中している」と明言した。

item.title: South Korea demands apology from Ukraine over North Korean prisoners of war disclosure
item.description: South Korea accused Kyiv of disclosing the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war and then falsely denying that the two sides had agreed to keep the move confidential.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

East Asia

South Korea demands apology from Ukraine over North Korean prisoners of war disclosure

South Korea accused Kyiv of disclosing the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war and then falsely denying that the two sides had agreed to keep the move confidential.

South Korean national flags flutter in the wind at the government complex in Seoul, South Korea, on Feb 27, 2025. (File photo: AP/Lee Jin-man)

28 Sep 2026 06:48AM (Updated: 28 Sep 2026 06:57AM)

FAST

South Korea's presidential office demanded an official explanation and apology from Ukraine, accusing Kyiv of disclosing the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea and then falsely denying that the two sides had agreed to keep the move confidential. "The presidential office expresses strong regret over Ukraine's unilateral disclosure and its subsequent false announcement that there had not been a non-disclosure agreement," Seong Ghi-hong, senior presidential secretary for public relations, said in a statement released on Sunday (Sep 27). He said the government was reviewing additional measures over the issue if necessary. Seong said Ukraine had repeatedly discussed the prisoners' transfer with Seoul through various channels and had requested secrecy, arguing that public disclosure could trigger domestic criticism that Kyiv had given up an opportunity to exchange the soldiers for Ukrainian prisoners.

South Korea agreed to keep the transfer confidential given security, diplomatic and humanitarian concerns, including the safety of the prisoners and their families, he said.

Related:

South Korea, Ukraine hold 'constructive' talks about North Korean POWs

North Korea's Kim Yo Jong denies Zelenskyy's claim on additional troops deployment

According to the statement, Ukraine later disclosed the transfer in President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's address to the United Nations General Assembly without sufficient prior consultation and subsequently denied the existence of any confidentiality agreement. Seong said the denial had seriously damaged trust between the two governments and could harm bilateral relations. Ukraine's embassy in Seoul did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Zelenskyy told the UN General Assembly last week that Ukraine had transferred two captured North Korean soldiers to South Korea. He said the men had recently been sent there after being captured while fighting for Russia in the war against Ukraine. South Korean President Lee Jae Myung days earlier said Ukraine had disclosed the transfer in breach of a non-disclosure agreement. In a post on X, Lee said "it was appropriate in every aspect not to disclose" the transfer, given the potential consequences, and that the two sides had agreed to keep it confidential. "I do not know what circumstances led the Ukrainian side to disclose the matter despite the confidentiality agreement, but it is deeply regrettable," he wrote. Ukraine captured the two North Koreans in Russia's Kursk region in January 2025. They were the first North Korean soldiers to be captured alive since Pyongyang entered the war in 2024, assisting Russia. South Korea had previously declined to confirm the soldiers' arrival, citing concerns for their safety and that of family members still in North Korea. Seoul and Kyiv had been discussing a possible transfer after the two soldiers expressed a desire to go to South Korea, according to an opposition lawmaker in Seoul. The transfer comes as South Korea has backed efforts to revive dialogue with North Korea , while US President Donald Trump has renewed his willingness to engage with Pyongyang.

item.title: 中国、国内企業にエヌビディア最先端半導体の購入許可も＝米メディア
item.description: [２７日 ロイター] - 中国工業情報化省が字節跳動（バイトダンス）やアリババグループなどの一部国内企業に対し、米半...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国、国内企業にエヌビディア最先端半導体の購入許可も＝米メディア 7:30 配信

写真はエヌビディアのロゴと中国国旗のイメージ。2025年8月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２７日 ロイター] - 中国工業情報化省が字節跳動（バイトダンス）やアリババグループなどの一部国内企業に対し、米半導体大手エヌビディアの業務用コンピューター向け最先端半導体の購入を許可する可能性を示唆したと、米オンラインメディア「ジ・インフォメーション」が報じた。２人の情報筋の話だとしている。

報道によると、この半導体は「ＲＴＸ　ＰＲＯ　５５００」。工業情報化省がバイトダンスとアリババなどに購入計画を報告するよう求め、政府が購入を承認する意向を伝えた。

業界幹部の一部は「ＲＴＸ　ＰＲＯ　５５００」が米国の輸出規制の対象外になると見込んでいるという。

エヌビディアの広報担当者は報道について「米企業は、５年弱前に発売されたゲーム製品まで対象とする時代遅れの米国の輸出規制と、中国による米製品輸入制限という二重の制約に直面し続けている」とコメントした。

アリババとバイトダンスはロイターのコメント要請に直ちには回答しなかった。ロイターは中国政府に対して直ちにコメントを要請することができなかった。

item.title: Oil heads higher as US-Iran peace talks in stalemate
item.description: Crude oil exports from key Middle East producers rebounded in September to 12.8 million barrels per day, the highest since the war started in February.
item.dc:creator: Mohi Narayan, Florence Tan
item.content:encoded: Brent crude oil rebounded more than 3% on Monday after US President Donald Trump rejected a [USN:L6N45J004 TEXT:"peace deal"] from Iran to resolve their conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, keeping tensions in the Middle East elevated. Brent crude futures rose $3.43, or 3.29%, to $107.75 a barrel at 0540 GMT, while US West Texas Intermediate crude was at $94.55 a barrel, up $2.14, or 2.32%. Iran announced a peace proposal last week at the UN General Assembly in New York, saying it had been transmitted to the Americans via Qatari mediators. Trump said on Saturday he rejected the plan, but told Axios in a phone interview on Sunday that he expected US negotiators to engage in more talks this week. "The rejection has reduced hopes of an immediate breakthrough, although diplomatic efforts have not ended," said Sugandha Sachdeva, the founder of SS WealthStreet, a New Delhi-based research firm. "For Brent futures, $120 a barrel remains the crucial resistance. As long as prices fail to sustain above it, a pullback remains possible, particularly if shipping improves or talks make progress." Yemen's Saudi-led coalition said early on Saturday it had [USN:L1N45I00U TEXT:"intercepted"] two ballistic missiles and two drones launched by the Iran-backed Houthis towards the kingdom. Brent edged up 0.4% last week but WTI lost 7.9% on concerns that the US may ban diesel exports to ease record prices which could [USN:L6N45G0YB TEXT:"curb"] US refining output. "Refined oil products remain a pressure point, with record US diesel prices intensifying inflation risks and prompting renewed debate over potential export curbs," ANZ analysts said in a note. Any restriction on US diesel exports would tighten supply outside the US, with European prices reacting to the prospect of reduced American supply, they added. Meanwhile, [USN:L1N45J07E TEXT:"crude oil exports"] from key Middle East producers rebounded in September to 12.8 million barrels per day, the highest since the war started in February, preliminary data from Kpler showed on Monday, as Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates boosted exports. The rebound came following a recovery in shipments via the Strait of Hormuz, which were set to hit about 7.4 million bpd this month, the data showed, as Saudi Arabia diverted exports from the Red Sea port of Yanbu to its eastern Ras Tanura port following attacks that damaged its East-West pipeline.

item.title: Israel revokes diplomatic status of Dutch diplomats in Ramallah
item.description: Israel said on Sunday it was revoking the diplomatic status of Dutch diplomats who represent the Netherlands at the Ramallah-based Palestinian Authority, in response to Dutch sanctions targeting Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israel said on Sunday it was revoking the diplomatic status of Dutch diplomats who represent the Netherlands at the Ramallah-based Palestinian Authority, in response to [USN:L5N3UY0D3 TEXT:"Dutch sanctions"] targeting Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Israel earlier this month ordered the [USN:S8N44F000 TEXT:"closure of the British Consulate"] in East Jerusalem, which is Britain's representative with the Palestinian Authority, after London announced similar [USN:S8N42N05Y TEXT:"sanctions"] banning the import of goods from settlements. Dutch Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen on Monday said he regretted the "unnecessary" decision and said the Netherlands was weighing its response. "Our temporary sanctions are not targeted against Israel, but stem from our obligation to not contribute to the unlawful situation of the illegal settlements," he said in a statement. The Netherlands' ban on imports of goods produced in settlements came into effect last week. Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar said on X that Dutch diplomats operating in Ramallah must return their Israeli-issued diplomatic documentation within seven days, when their diplomatic privileges and immunities are due to expire. "Any country that acts in a hostile and unilateral manner against Israel will lose influence and relevance in the region," Saar said. Israel in August banned Dutch diplomats from a US-led coordination centre for Gaza that is based in Israel, over what the foreign minister described as "anti-Israel measures." Many countries, including the Netherlands, have long had diplomats who represent their governments with the Palestinian Authority in Ramallah while living in East Jerusalem. Israel has traditionally accredited those diplomats and granted them certain privileges under the Vienna Convention on treatment of diplomatic missions. France and Canada joined Britain this month in announcing a ban on goods from settlements, but Israel has not taken any action against those two countries. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing government has found itself [USN:L8N45F07N TEXT:"diplomatically isolated"] from many of its allies over its conduct in recent years in Gaza and the West Bank. Two prominent Israeli cabinet ministers have been sanctioned by several countries, while Spain, Ireland and others have also announced a ban on goods originating from settlements.

ISLAMABAD, Sept 27 : Pakistan's Finance Minister discussed potential US Export-Import Bank financing for Boeing aircraft for privatised PIA, refinery upgrades and Reko Diq, a copper and gold mining project in southwestern Balochistan, his adviser Khurram Schehzad said in a post on X on Sunday. Schehzad said the government was helping PIA access financing and suppliers, but was not buying aircraft and had announced no sovereign guarantee or taxpayer-funded loan. US EXIM could secure financing against the aircraft and assess the airline or lessee's creditworthiness, he said, so a sovereign guarantee was not automatic.

item.title: Trump says men arrested at UK air base used by US were looking to do 'big damage'
item.description: Five men are held on terrorism suspicion after armed police stopped three vans near RAF Fairford, prompting evacuations and a bomb disposal search.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Trump says men arrested at UK air base used by US were looking to do 'big damage'

Five men are held on terrorism suspicion after armed police stopped three vans near RAF Fairford, prompting evacuations and a bomb disposal search.

B‑1B Lancer bomber is parked at the RAF Fairford airbase, which hosts United States Air Force (USAF) personnel, in Fairford, Gloucestershire, Britain, Sep 27, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Toby Shepheard)

27 Sep 2026 04:03PM (Updated: 28 Sep 2026 06:19AM)

Bookmark

FAST

FAIRFORD, England: British police arrested five men on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offences on Sunday (Sep 27) near an air base that has been used by the US to strike Iran, after a tip-off that three vans had been seen heading to the military airfield.

US President Donald Trump said the suspects had been looking to do "big damage" and had been under investigation by British and US authorities.

British counterterrorism detectives leading the investigation said police had received a call about three suspicious vehicles that appeared to be travelling towards RAF Fairford in the west of England in the early hours of Sunday.

Five men were arrested by armed officers and later held on suspicion of preparation of a terrorist act. Police, who said they believed the incident was now contained, have not yet publicly stated who they assessed was involved.

An Iranian-linked motive is considered the most likely, a source familiar with the investigation said, while a Russian sabotage operation or an Islamist plot were also being looked at.

Related:

US Treasury chief Bessent claims successes in isolating Iran

Trump rejects Iran's Hormuz proposal; Tehran calls for diplomacy

POLICE WORKING TO UNDERSTAND CIRCUMSTANCES "We are in the early stages of an investigation, and five men remain in custody," Counter Terrorism Policing Senior National Coordinator Vicki Evans said in a statement.

"As you would expect we are working closely with our partners to understand the circumstances of the incident."

Police said a 400m cordon was in place around the base as the bomb disposal unit investigated the vans. Local residents in 85 homes in a nearby village were evacuated and armed officers were patrolling the site.

The British government, which has given authorisation to the US to use bombers based at Fairford to strike Iranian missile sites that were attacking ships in the Strait of Hormuz , said Prime Minister Andy Burnham was being updated on the incident.

Burnham thanked the police and armed forces, saying on X: "I know today's incident near RAF Fairford will be deeply concerning for local residents and for many people following developments across the country".

Britain said in July its armed forces were ready to protect the country from any attack after Iran's Revolutionary Guards warned it not to allow US bombers to fly from Fairford, saying any base used to launch attacks would be a legitimate target.

"The arrest in the UK was fantastic," Trump told reporters, saying it was "an amazing job".

"We had them under investigation. They were looking to do big damage to our fort and working with the British worked out great ... We had them under view for a long time, and we got them," Trump added.

On Sunday morning, the base was blocked by armed police while large machinery also prevented access, and Reuters witnesses said security had been increased at other bases used by the US, with armoured vehicles and soldiers at the gates of RAF Lakenheath and RAF Mildenhall in eastern England.

Emergency vehicles are parked at Fairford Youth Football club, near RAF Fairford airbase, which hosts United States Air Force (USAF) personnel, in Fairford, Gloucestershire, Britain, Sep 27, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Toby Shepheard)

DECLARATION OF A MAJOR INCIDENT A local farmer told the Daily Telegraph newspaper she had alerted police after seeing the vans and men acting suspiciously as she drove home from a party.

"I saw a group of Middle Eastern-looking young guys running off through the trees. Some of them had masks or balaclavas on, and they all scattered ahead of us as we drove back past," she told the paper.

"Some of them ran into the fields, and some of them turned to run towards the air base ... I mean, you don’t see masked men running around at half one in the morning in the countryside near a secure air base and not have concerns."

Local councillor Tristan Wilkinson told Reuters there had been a recent security alert at Fairford and surveillance had been stepped up.

"So there was a specific threat about six weeks ago from the Iranians on this base. At the time, there was increased surveillance around the area," he said.

A spokesperson for the US Air Force declined to discuss specific force protection measures at the base.

"The 501st Combat Support Wing and our fellow UK-based Wings remain vigilant and will take appropriate actions to ensure the safety and security of our US service members, civilians, contractors, and their families," the spokesperson said.

British ministers have also previously briefed providers of critical infrastructure on the threat posed by Russia, with the government increasingly concerned about possible sabotage operations and cyberattacks.

Russia denies mounting hybrid attacks on Western nations.

Source: Reuters/fh/fs

item.title: Swiss voters reject tighter neutrality rules that would have curbed NATO cooperation
item.description: The right-wing Swiss People's Party has said that Switzerland's traditional position has been eroded after Bern imposed sanctions on Russia following its invasion of Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Marleen Kaesebier, John Revill
item.content:encoded: Swiss voters on Sunday firmly rejected a proposal to adopt a more restrictive form of neutrality that would have blocked their country from imposing economic sanctions or cooperating with NATO. All cantons and about 70% of voters rejected the proposal for a strictly defined version of neutrality to be written into the Swiss constitution, final results from the Federal Statistical Office showed. "This result is not a vote against neutrality. Switzerland was neutral yesterday, it is neutral today, and it will remain neutral in the future," Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis said at a press conference following the outcome. While Swiss neutrality has been internationally recognised since the end of the Napoleonic wars in 1815, how the government implements it is not spelled out. The right-wing Swiss People's Party (SVP) has said that Switzerland's traditional position has been eroded after Bern imposed sanctions on Russia following its invasion of Ukraine . The campaign had funded posters across the country urging people to vote "No war, yes to neutrality", featuring white peace doves, ahead of the vote. Cassis said the rejection allows Switzerland to continue deciding on economic sanctions on a case-by-case basis and to cooperate with partners when doing so strengthens the country's security, which, he stressed, also depends on the security of its neighbours and the European continent. SWISS GOVERNMENT, MOST PARTIES OPPOSE THE PROPOSAL Apart from the SVP, most parties and the Swiss government opposed the proposal. The Green Party, the Social Democrats (SP), the Centre Party and the FDP all expressed relief over Sunday's outcome. "Voters understood what the SVP wanted: it wanted Switzerland to isolate itself internationally and shirk its responsibilities when international law is being trampled on," said Sibel Arslan, a lawmaker for the Green Party. An FDP statement said the decision was important for an armed, neutral Switzerland that retains the ability to act. The SVP meanwhile accepted the defeat and said it currently had no plans for further action. "I'm of course not pleased with the result," said SVP lawmaker Lukas Reimann, adding that the commitment to Swiss neutrality expressed by all sides during the campaign was encouraging. "It is absolutely clear that neutrality belongs to Switzerland and is part of Switzerland's identity," he said. "Going forward, we will judge the opponents of the initiative by that commitment." If the government or opponents of the initiative were to stray from neutrality, for example by adopting tougher sanctions, the party would need to become active again, Reimann said. 'SWISS VOTERS LIKE NEUTRALITY' Fabio Wasserfallen, a professor of European politics at the University of Bern, said before the vote: "Swiss voters like neutrality, but they approve of how the government is implementing it at present." "They are also generally in favour of the sanctions on Russia over the war in Ukraine, and don't want that to change." The [USN:L8N44F0X5 TEXT:"campaign"] wanted the constitution to stipulate that Switzerland cannot join or cooperate with any military or defence alliance unless attacked, and that it refrain from joining any sanctions unless approved by the United Nations.

SYDNEY, Sept 27 : The CEOs of OpenAI and Anthropic have been called to appear at an Australian Senate inquiry on AI, the head of the probe said on Sunday, days after the revelation that a rogue OpenAI bot had hacked the country's health-system database. The Medicare breach, condemned by Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, is one of the highest-profile incidents of AI agents accessing external systems outside the US. OpenAI's Sam Altman and Anthropic's Dario Amodei have been sent written requests to appear at the inquiry, which is to hold public hearings in the capital Canberra on Thursday, said a spokesperson for Senator Sarah Hanson-Young of the Australian Greens party, who chairs the probe. OpenAI and Anthropic did not immediately respond to requests for comment outside business hours.

The OpenAI agent's incursion on one of the country's most used government agencies may prompt Albanese's Labor government to toughen AI-specific laws it is readying for next year, adding pressure to Australia-US relations already tested by Canberra's ban on social media for teens, tech policy experts say. The Senate inquiry is examining the potential impacts of AI and data centres on Australian communities, industries, water and energy. It is one of several state and federal probes into AI. "There are serious questions for Sam Altman to answer about the OpenAI hack of Australian government websites," Hanson-Young said in a statement. Altman and Amodei "must front up, face the Senate's questions and have an honest conversation about what effective, lasting regulation of this industry should look like", she said. Albanese, who revealed the June breach of Medicare on Thursday, called it "unacceptable", saying he had voiced "extreme concern" to Altman. OpenAI says it only learned of the breach — one of at least four of Australian government websites — in August. It says the incident was not intentional and did not compromise any private information.

WASHINGTON: President Donald Trump predicted on Saturday (Sep 26) that the US and Cuba will reach an agreement and that he does not think military action will be necessary. "I would say that Cuba and us will make a deal. I don't think we'll need the military," Trump told reporters at the White House. The Trump administration has openly stated that its goal is to change Cuba's government. A US-imposed oil blockade implemented earlier this year has put the country under severe strain as it contends with fuel shortages and blackouts exacerbated by failing infrastructure. "We want to help Cuba," Trump said before departing for Tennessee. "We want to open Cuba up to our people."

In an address to the UN General Assembly on Tuesday, Trump called Cuba a failed state and said "freedom will be coming" to the island nation. The Cuban delegation walked out of the hall during that speech. Cuban foreign minister Bruno Rodriguez said at the UN later on Saturday that Cuba will always be open for dialogue with the United States. He did not reference Trump 's comments specifically. "We are open to commercial and business relationships with US companies, just as we are with any other country," said Rodriguez, while also strongly condemning a US trade embargo on Cuba. The US has maintained the embargo on Cuba for more than 60 years, and the Trump administration has been stepping up pressure after using the military in January to remove Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro.

FAST

ATHENS: Six people have died, the Greek fire brigade said on Saturday (Sep 26), after a two-storey residential building in a tourist area of central Athens collapsed following an explosion which the capital's mayor said was likely linked to gas infrastructure. Emergency crews in heavy gear and red helmets assisted by rescue dogs, cameras and sensors found the bodies of six people, fire brigade spokesman Vassilis Vathrakogiannis said in a televised briefing. They were looking for an elderly couple who lived in one apartment and four tourists who were staying in another as they removed debris from the building. The fire brigade's crime investigation unit was also on site to identify the cause of the blast after reports of a gas smell in an area which is home to hotels and short-term rentals. The tourists, two American couples, had been expected to check in to catch a flight from Athens airport at 3pm local time on Friday (8pm, Singapore time) but did not show up, a police source said. Ambulances stood by on Saturday to take the bodies to the hospital for identification. Friday's blast destroyed the building in Plaka, near some of Athens' most visited sites including the Acropolis and the Temple of Zeus, damaging nearby houses, shops and cars and sending rubble and broken glass as far as three blocks away. The building was reduced to twisted metal, shattered tiles and concrete, strewn with household items and clothing.
